Okukwasa kitegeeza okuwaayo, okwesiga omulala ddala. Kale, bwe tumuwa ebigezo byaffe, alibyetikka. Bwe tutambulira mu butuukirivu alituyisaamu. “Noolwekyo mwewombeeke wansi w’omukono gwa Katonda ogw’amaanyi, naye alibagulumiza ng’obudde butuuse.” Waliwo emikono ebiri awo—omukono gwa Katonda ogutunyigiriza wansi, ne gututoowaza, n’oluvannyuma omukono gwa Katonda ogutusitula waggulu. Mumutwalirenga byonna bye mweraliikirira, olwo omukono gwe gulibasitula, ne gubagulumiza ng’obudde butuuse. Mu lunyiriri luno mulimu okufaayo kwa ngeri bbiri—okufaayo kwammwe n’okufaayo kwe. Mu lulimi olwasooka byawukana. Ekimu kitegeeza okweraliikirira, ekirala kitegeeza okufaayo kw’Ayinzabyonna. Mumutwalire okweraliikirira kwammwe, mutwale okufaayo kwe okw’Ayinzabyonna mu kifo kyakwo. Temuddangamu kufaayo ku buzibu, wabula mukkirize nti asobola okubawanirira mu bwo. Okufuga kuli ku bibegabega bye. Mukkirize nti, bwe mumwesiga ne mumugondera, ne mutuukiriza by’ayagala, alirabirira ebibafaako. Muwanyisiganye bugya emigugu. Mwetikke ekikoligo kye, mumuleke abalabirire.

Maayi 27

“Okufuga kunaabanga ku bibegabega bye” (Isaaya 9:6).

Toyinza kuwummuza mutima ng’oguyimiriza okukuba. Eddagala erya belladonna lisobola okukola ekyo, naye okwo si kuwummula. Ka omukka ogw’obulamu gujje—obulamu bwa Katonda n’amaanyi ge—olwo wanaabaawo okuwummula okuwooma. Enkolagana ey’omu maka n’okwagala kw’ab’omu nnyumba tebikuleeta. Okununulibwa mu buzibu tekukuleeta. Emitima mingi egyagezesebwa gigambye nti: “Singa obuzibu buno obunene bwandiggwaawo, nandiwummudde.” Naye obumu bwe buggwaawo obulala buba bujja. Empeewo ennaku efumitiddwa ku lusozi, erowooza nti singa yandisobodde okunaaba mu kagga k’oku lusozi ak’edda, yandiwummudde. Naye akasaale kali mu nnyama yaayo era tewali kuwummula gy’eri okutuusa ekiwundu lwe kiwona. Kirumira mu nnyanja y’oku lusozi nga bwe kirumira mu lusenyi. Tetulifuna kuwummula kwa Katonda na mirembe mu mutima okutuusa nga tuwaddeyo byonna eri Kristo—n’omulimu gwaffe—ne tukkiriza nti abitutte byonna, era ffe kye tulina okukola kwe kusirika busirisi n’okwesiga. Kyetaagisa okutambulira mu buwulize obutukuvu ne tumuleka okufuga kubeere ku bibegabega bye. Pawulo yagamba kino nti: “Kino ekimu kye nkola.” Waliwo ekkubo limu efunda eri ffe ffenna—okwagala kwa Kristo n’omulimu gwe eri ffe.

Maayi 28

“Yeetoowaza” (Abafiripi 2:8).

Ekimu ku bintu ebisinga obuzibu eri obuntu obw’ekitiibwa era obw’oku ntikko kwe kubeera wansi w’obuyinza, okwefiiriza okwagala kwe, n’okutwala ekifo eky’okugondera. Naye Kristo yeeteekako ekifaananyi ky’omuddu, n’aleka obwetwaze bwe, obuyinza bwe obw’okwesanyusa, eddembe lye ery’okwerondera, era ng’amaze okuva emirembe n’emirembe egy’edda nga tamanyi kirala okuggyako okulagira, ne yeewaayo okugondera kwokka. Oluusi ndabye omusajja eyali mugagga ng’akozesa abalala ng’afuuse omukozi wa bulijjo mu dduuka lye limu. Kyali si kifo kyangu wadde eky’ekitiibwa, nkukakasa. Naye Yesu yali muweereza atuukiridde nnyo, Kitaawe n’okugamba n’agamba nti: “Laba Omuweereza wange, gwe njagala ennyo asanyusa emmeeme yange.” Mu bulamu bwe bwonna ekigambo ekyamukulemberanga kyali nti, “Omwana w’Omuntu yajja kuweereza.” “Wano mu mmwe nze muweereza wammwe.” “Siyinza kukola kintu kyonna ku bwange.” “Si nga Nze bwe njagala, wabula ky’oyagala kye kiba kikolebwa.” Mmwe abaagalwa, muyize ekifo ky’omuweereza?

Era nate, “N’aba muwulize n’okutuukira ddala ku kufa, ate okufa okw’okukomererwa ku musaalaba.” Obulamu bwe bwonna bwali kufa, era ku nkomerero yawaayo byonna eri okufa, era n’eri ensonyi, okufa okw’okukomererwa. Kino ekisembayo kye kyali okutuukirira kw’okwagala kwe.

Maayi 29

“Omubiri gwa Mukama, ne Mukama wa mubiri” (1 Abakkolinso 6:13).

Kale, nga Kristo yennyini bwe yatuwa obutuukirivu, era Kristo yennyini bwe yafuulibwa okutukuzibwa kwaffe, bwe kityo lwa kwegatta naye ffe kennyini lwokka lwe tusobola okufuna obulamu buno obw’omubiri n’okununulibwa kwagwo. Mazima, si kukwatibwako kwa maanyi ku mubiri gwaffe okuguzzaawo, n’oluvannyuma ne kuguleka eri amaanyi n’obulamu obwa buzaaliranwa byokka mu biseera eby’omu maaso; wabula kwe kwegatta okw’obulamu era okw’amazima okw’omubiri gwaffe ogufa n’omubiri ogwazuukira ogwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, obulamu bwe bwennyini ne bujja mu mubiri gwaffe, ye yennyini n’afuulibwa gye tuli amaanyi, obulamu obulungi n’okununulibwa okujjuvu okw’omubiri.

Mulamu emirembe n’emirembe era yeetoowaza n’abeera mu nnyumba zino ez’ebbumba. Abo abamusembeza bwe batyo bayinza okumumanya ng’abo abamuggya mu mibiri gye yeekolera bwe batayinza kumumanya n’akatono. Kino kye kimu ku byama by’Enjiri eby’obuziba era eby’omuwendo. “Omubiri gwa Mukama, ne Mukama wa mubiri.” “Oba temumanyi ng’omubiri gwammwe ye Yeekaalu ya Mwoyo Mutukuvu Katonda gwe yabawa, era n’emibiri gyammwe si gyammwe ku bwammwe? Kubanga mwagulibwa na muwendo, noolwekyo emibiri gyammwe gigulumizenga Katonda.” (Enkyusa Empya)

Maayi 30

“Ndibawa Omwoyo wange” (Ezeekyeri 36:27).

“Ndibawa Omwoyo wange alibakubiriza okugoberera ebiragiro byange n’okukuuma obulungi amateeka gange.” “Ndibassaamu omwoyo oguntya, muleme kuddayo kunvaako.” Woowe, mukwano gwange, ekyo tekyandibadde kya mukisa, tekyandibadde kuwummula kwa kitalo gy’oli, ggwe akooye ddala olw’okulwana kuno mu maanyi go ggwe? Toyagala musajja w’amaanyi okuwangula omusajja ow’amaanyi ow’obwannannyini n’ekibi? Toyagala mukulembeze? Toyagala Katonda yennyini kubeera naawe, okubeera mu ggwe ng’omutuuze? Toyagala kuwummula? Tomanyi kwetaaga kuno? Woowe, okuwulira kuno okw’okuzzibwa emabega, ng’oyaayaana, ng’oyagala, naye nga totuukiriza. Ekyo ky’ajja okukola; “Muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako.” Ekisinga ekyo, “Muliweebwa amaanyi ga Mwoyo Mutukuvu ng’abakkako.” Eyo y’enkyusa entuufu, era ddala yawukana nnyo ku endala. Toliweebwa maanyi ggwe kennyini, abantu ne bagamba nti: “Ng’omusajja oyo alina amaanyi mangi. Tolibeera na maanyi gonna n’akatono, wabula oliweebwa amaanyi ga Mwoyo Mutukuvu ng’akukkako, ye nga y’alina amaanyi, ekyo kyokka.”

Maayi 31

“Noolwekyo buli eyeetoowaza ng’omwana ono omuto” (Matayo 18:4).

Tolifuna mutima mwetoowaze okutuusa nga guzaaliddwa okuva waggulu, okuva mu mutima gwa Kristo. Kubanga omuntu yafiirwa obuntu bwe, era woowe, emirundi mingi nnyo abeera na mutima gwa ddayimooni. Katonda ayagala ffe, ng’Abakristaayo, tubeere abaangu, ab’obuntu, abasemberwa era ng’abaana abato. Abakristaayo be tumanyi era be twagala ennyo, era abasinga okuba okumpi ne Mukama, be basinga okuba abaangu. Buli lwe tufuuka abeekuluntaza tuba tusaanira kuteekebwa mu kisenge ky’ebifaananyi kyokka, era tuba ba mugaso ku ntobo y’ekifaananyi kyokka; naye, bwe tuba tugenda okubeera mu bantu ne tubaagala ne tubalokola, tuteekwa okuba abasemberwa era ab’obuntu. Obukakanyavu bwonna ngeri ndala ya kwerowoozaako. Saba Kristo omutima ogw’obuntu, akamwenyumwenyu akanaabeera aka buzaaliranwa ng’ak’omwana wo omuto ng’ali mu maaso go. Woowe, Kristo yakola bingi nnyo mu bikolwa ebitono! Teyandituuse ku mukazi Omusamaliya singa yajja gy’ali nga nnabbi. Yatuula, ng’omusajja akooye, n’agamba nti: “Mpa ku mazzi nnyweko.” Era bwe kityo, mu bulamu bwe bwonna, obuntu bwe obwangu n’okwagala kwe bye byamutwala eri abalala, ne bibatwala gy’ali n’eri obulokozi bwe obungi.
fields.body_text: Maayi 1 “Ekibala eky’Omwoyo kye kisa” (Abaggalatiya 5:22). Obukambwe bw’obutonde busaanuuse, era kaakano obutonde bumasamasa n’akamwenyumwenyu k’ekiseera eky’okumera, era buli kintu ekitwetoolodde kitunyumiza mu kaama ku buwombeefu bwa Katonda. Ekibala kino ekirungi kituukagana bulungi nnyo n’omwezi guno omuwombeefu, gwe kirimu ng’eddoboozi erikulu. Omwoyo Omutukuvu atukulembere, abaagalwa, mu nnaku zino, atuyingize mu buwoomi bwe, mu bukkakkamu bwe ne mu buwombeefu bwe, ng’ajeemulula buli mpisa enkalu, ey’obutassaamu balala kitiibwa, enkambwe era etali ntukuvu, n’atufuula ng’Oyo agambibwa nti, “Taliyomba so talireekaana, era tewaliba n’omu aliwulira eddoboozi lye mu nguudo.” Omusajja ajjuziddwa Yesu mu mazima anaabeeranga bulijjo omusajja ow’empisa ennungi. Omukazi abatiziddwa mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu anaabeeranga n’empisa ez’obuzaaliranwa ez’omukyala ow’ekitiibwa atuukiridde, ne bw’aba nga yazaalibwa mu bwavu era nga teyayigirizibwa nnyo mu masomero g’empisa ez’ensi. Abaagalwa, tufune era tulage obuwombeefu bwa Kristo, omwoyo gw’omwana omuwere omutukuvu, okutuusa ensi lw’eritwogerako, nga Chesterfield, omusajja ow’empisa ennungi naye atakkiriza, bwe yayogera lumu ku Fenelon omutukuvu nti, “Singa nnasigala mu nnyumba ye olunaku olulala, nandibadde nfuuka Omukristaayo.” Mukama, tuyambe leero twewaayo eri Omwoyo Ejjiba omuwombeefu, obulamu bwaffe bulyoke bubeere ng’obulamu bwe. Maayi 2 “Atuwanguzisa bulijjo” (2 Abakkolinso 2:14). Ebigambo bino nga bituyamba! Bilowoozeeko abantu bwe bakunyiiza, Setaani bw’akufumita obusaale bwe obw’omuliro, omwoyo gwo ogw’obuyinike era ogw’obwannannyini bwe gunyiiga oba ne gweraliikirira; eddoboozi eppomu liwulirwe waggulu w’olutalo, nga lyogera mu kaama nti, “Sigala muwoomu, sigala muwoomu!” Era bw’onooligondera mangu, onoowonyezebwa okugwa emirundi lukumi, n’okuumibwa mu mirembe egituukiridde. Kituufu, toyinza kwekuuma nga oli muwoomu, naye Katonda anaakukuuma bw’anaalaba nga kye kigendererwa kyo ekinywevu era ekimalirivu okukuumibwa nga oli muwoomu, n’okugaana okweraliikirira oba okukwata ensaalwa oba okwesasuza. Ekizibu kiri nti osangamu essanyu mu kunyiiga okutono ne mu kwennyamira. Oyagala okukuuma akasaalwa ako akatono, n’okusaasira enneewulira zo ezirumiziddwa, n’okulabirira ekyekubiira kyo ekitono. Mikwano gyange, Katonda anaabawa okwagala kwonna kwe mwagala ddala era kwe mulonda n’obwesimbu. Oyinza okubeera n’ekyekubiira kyo, oba oyinza okubeera n’emirembe egisukkiridde okutegeera kwonna; naye toyinza kubeera na byombi. Mu bigambo bino ebibiri ebitono mulimu eddagala ly’obulumi bw’omutima obw’emirundi lukumi, n’eggulu ery’emirembe n’amaanyi—SIGALA MUWOOMU. Maayi 3 “Mbawa emirembe gyange” (Yokaana 14:27). Wano we wali ekyama eky’emirembe egy’olubeerera—emirembe gya Katonda. Twewaayo eri Katonda, Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’atwala ekifuba kyaffe. Mazima giba “Mirembe, Mirembe.” Naye mu kiseera ekyo kyennyini Setaani w’atandikira okutukyusa, era akikola ng’ayita mu birowoozo byaffe, ng’abiwugula oba ng’abitaataaganya ng’ekiseera bwe kimwetaagisa. Kino kye kiseera eky’okukakasa obwesimbu bw’okwewaayo kwaffe n’obumu bw’omutima gwaffe. Bwe tuba twegomba ddala Okubeerawo kwe okusinga ebirala byonna, tujja kukyuka okuva ku buli kirowoozo ekiwakanya ne tutunuulira Yesu obutakyusa maaso. Naye bwe tuba twegomba okumatiza okwegomba kwaffe okusinga Okubeerawo kwe, tujja kugondera ekigambo eky’obusungu oba ekirowoozo ekitaliimu oba eky’okwesanyusaamu eky’ekibi, era bwe tudda, Omusumba waffe aba agenze, ne twewuunya lwaki emirembe gyaffe gitulese. Okulemererwa kutera okubaawo mu kantu akatono, era okulemererwa kw’omwoyo kubaddewo mu kantu akatono, okusinga ekirowoozo oba ekigambo, era omwoyo ogwandibadde tegutya kulinnya lusozi gwesittadde ddala ku kasubi. Ekyama ekituufu eky’okuwummula okutuukiridde kwe kubeera nga tufa ku Yesu n’obunyiikivu, era nga tumulowoozaako bulijjo ng’empisa. Maayi 4 “Oyo ali mu mmwe wa maanyi okusinga oyo ali mu nsi” (1 Yokaana 4:4). Setaani ayagala nnyo okutwesittaza ku bintu ebitono. Ensonga y’ekyo eri nti okutera kuba buwanguzi bunene gy’ali, era kiraga nti asobola okututaataaganya n’akapapajjo n’okutusuula wansi n’akasubi. Kwe kwenyumiriza okw’edda okw’Abayebusi, bwe baagamba Dawudi nti basobola okukuuma Yerusaalemi n’eggye ery’abazibe b’amaaso n’abalema. Abasinga obungi mu ffe tukola bulungi mu ntalo zaffe ennene okusinga mu ntono zaffe. Adamu yagwa olw’ekibala ekitono eky’apo, naye ensi yonna n’ezikirira. Mwegendereze, abaagalwa, ebyesittaza ebitono, era temuleka Setaani kubasekerera, n’ategeeza abaweereza be engeri gye yabesittaza n’ekikuta ky’omucungwa. Era nate, Setaani bw’aba ayagala okuziyiza omukisa omunene mu bulamu bwaffe, atera okugusuulako ekisiikirize ekibi n’agufuula nga tegusanyusa gye tuli. Nga bangi mu ffe abaabadde beewala amazima, ebifo n’abantu Katonda mwe yeeraze nate, ekyo ekyandibadde omukisa ogusinga obunene mu bulamu bwaffe, era Setaani asobodde okutwewalisa byo olw’ekyekubiira ekikyamu oba eky’obusirusiru! Maayi 5 “Nga bwe mwazuukirira” (Abakkolosaayi 3:1). Katonda alindiridde ku makya gano okutuusa ku buli mutima omwetegefu era ogwagala, mu ssaawa ezisooka, okukoma kw’obulamu n’amaanyi okunaayimusa obulamu bwaffe okutuuka ku ssanyu erisingako, ne kussa mu maaso gaffe ensalosalo ez’essuubi n’obuweereza obutukuvu ezisingako obunene. Tetuutege kunoonya wala okuzuula Mukama waffe eyazuukira. Yakulembera n’oyo eyasooka okumunoonya ku makya g’Okuzuukira ago, era anaatulindirira ng’obudde tebunnakya n’okulamusa kwe okw’essanyu nti “Mirembe,” bwe tuba n’amaaso agalaba n’emitima egimwaniriza era egimugondera. Bubaka ki bw’atutumidde mu kiseera kino eky’okumera? “Nga bwe mwazuukirira awamu ne Kristo, munoonyenga ebintu ebiri mu ggulu, Kristo gy’atudde ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda. Kubanga mwafa era n’obulamu bwammwe bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda.” Si kuyimuka buyimusi ne Kristo, wabula kuzuukizibwa. Si kulinnya katono waggulu mu bulamu obukadde, wabula kuzuukira mu bafu. Okuzuukira tekuliba na makulu gasukka ku ago okufa ge kubadde nako. Tuliba balamu naye okutuuka awo wokka we tuba tufudde ddala. Maayi 6 “Nammwe mwerowoozenga okuba abalamu eri Katonda” (Abaruumi 6:11). Okufa kwa kaseera buseera. Obulamu bwa mirembe gyonna. Kale mubeere abalamu, mmwe abaana b’okuzuukira, ku bulamu bwe obw’ekitiibwa, nga mweyongera bulijjo mu bugagga bwabwo, n’okujjula kw’obulamu bwammwe kunaagoba okuyingira kw’ekyeggya n’ekibi, ne kuwangula ekibi n’ekirungi, era obulamu bwammwe tebuliba kwekuba bugumu okw’ennaku okw’okulwana kwammwe mmwe, wabula amayengo agasukkulukuka ag’obulamu bwa Kristo obuwangula obwa nnamaddala. Lumu mu lukuŋŋaana lw’eddiini ow’oluganda omwagalwa yatuwa okwogera okusanyusa ennyo ku bulamu obw’okuzuukira. Awo ow’oluganda omulala n’ayimirira n’ayogera ebbanga ddene ku bwetaavu bw’okwekomerera. Entuuyo ennyogovu zaatukwata ffenna, era twali tetusobola kutegeera lwaki. Naye bwe yamala, mwannyinaffe omulungi n’annyonnyola embeera yonna ng’agamba nti “Omusumba S. yali atuggye ffenna mu ntaana n’okwogera kwe, ate Omusumba P. atuzzeeyo nate.” Toddayo mu ntaana nate ng’omaze okuvaamu, naye beera mulamu nga Ye, “omulamu era eyali afudde, naye laba! kaakano mulamu emirembe gyonna, era alina ebisumuluzo eby’okufa n’amagombe.” Beera wabweru w’entaana, oluggi lusigale nga lusibiddwa, n’ebisumuluzo biri mu mikono gye egyazuukira. Maayi 7 “Nnumirwa nate ng’alumwa okuzaala, okutuusa Kristo lw’alibumbibwa mu mmwe” (Abaggalatiya 4:19). Kiba kiseera kya mukisa bwe tuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri, omutima omuggya ne gutondebwa mu ffe mu kifaananyi kya Katonda. Kiba kiseera kya mukisa gusingako, Kristo yennyini bw’azaalibwa mu mutima guno omuggya, ekiseera kya Ssekukkulu ne kiddamu okubaawo mu ffe, nga ffe, mu ngeri ey’amazima, tufuuka abo Kristo omulamu mw’abeera mu mubiri. Ge makulu g’Obukristaayo agasinga obuziba n’obutukuvu. Gayogerwa mu kusaba kwa Pawulo eri Abaggalatiya. “Baana bange be nnumirwa nate ng’alumwa okuzaala, okutuusa Kristo lw’alibumbibwa mu mmwe.” Wakyaliwo ekiseera eky’ekitiibwa ekisingako, ffe, nga Ye, lwe tulikyusibwa ne tufuulibwa mu kitiibwa kye, era mu kuzuukira ne tubeera, mu mwoyo, mu bulamu ne mu mubiri, nga Ye bw’ali. Tubeere abalamu, wansi w’amaanyi g’ekirowoozo kino ekikubiriza, nga ffe Kristo mw’abeera mu mubiri; nga tetubeera bulamu bwaffe, wabula obulamu bwa Kristo, era nga tulaga ebirungi, si ebyaffe ffe, wabula eby’Oyo eyatuyita “okuva mu kizikiza n’atuyingiza mu butangaavu bwe obutenkanika”; bwe kityo obulamu bwaffe bulibeera eri bonna okuddamu okubeera obulamu bwa Kristo mu kifo kyaffe, nga bwe yandibubadde, singa yali wano. Maayi 8 “Empeke y’eŋŋaano bw’egwa mu ttaka efa, bwe tefa ebeera yokka” (Yokaana 12:24). Okufa n’okuzuukira bye birowoozo ebikulu eby’obutonde n’eby’Obukristaayo. Tubiraba mu kukyusibwa kw’ekiwojjolo nga kiva mu kisusu kyakyo, mu nsigo eziikiddwa ng’emera n’efuuka omutunsi n’ekimuli eky’ekiseera eky’okumera, mu kukyusibwa kw’olugoye olw’okuziika olw’ekiseera eky’obunnyogovu ne lufuuka engoye ez’amabala amangi ez’ekiseera eky’okumera. Tukiraba mu Bayibuli yonna mu kabonero k’okukomolebwa, n’amakulu gaako ag’okufa n’obulamu, mu kusomoka Ennyanja Emyufu ne Yoludaani, okumu nga kufulumya n’okulala nga kuyingiza, ne mu Musaalaba gwa Kalvaali n’entaana eyaggulwa ku makya g’Okuzuukira. Tukiraba mu buli bulamu obw’omwoyo obw’obuziba. Buli bulamu obw’amazima buzaalibwa mu kufa, era okufa gye kukoma okuba okw’obuziba, obulamu gye bukoma okuba obw’amazima. Tetubuusabuusa nti emyezi egibadde giyitawo gitulaze ffenna ebifo bingi awandibadde entaana, n’ebisasiro bingi eby’obuzaaliranwa n’eby’ekibi ebikyasigaddewo, bye twandiyagadde n’essanyu okuteeka mu ntaana etaliiko bukomo. Katonda atuyambe okusala omusango gw’okufa ogutakyusibwa, era tuleke Omwoyo Omutukuvu, omuziisi omukulu, afuule okuziika okwo okw’emirembe gyonna. Olwo obulamu bwaffe bunaabeeranga nga bumera era nga bumulisa, nga buyiwa akaloosa ku byonna. Maayi 9 “Mirembe” (Matayo 28:9). Kwali kulamusa okukubiriza Mukama w’Obulamu kwe yayogera eri abayigirizwa be abaasooka ku makya g’okuzuukira. Kigambo kimasamasa era kitangaala kye twandyagadde okwogera mu linnya lye eri abaana be abaagalwa ku ntandikwa y’olunaku olulala. Kitegeeza bingi okusinga ebirabika kungulu. Mazima kwe kusaba olw’obulamu bwaffe obw’omubiri, naye tewali ayinza kukitegeera mu bujjuvu wabula abo abakkiriza okuwonyezebwa kw’omubiri. Mukwano gwange omulowooza lumu yagamba nti ekigambo “hail” mu Lungereza kitegeeza ddala obulamu obulungi obw’omubiri, era y’engeri enkadde ey’Olusaakisoni ey’ekigambo ekyo. Ffenna tumanyi nti omuntu “hale” ye muntu alina obulamu obulungi. Obubaka bwa Mukama waffe, noolwekyo, mu makulu gaabwo bwali kulamusa okwo kwe tulamusaganya okuva edda n’edda bwe tusisinkana. “Obulamu bwo buli butya?” “Oli otya?” oba, ekisingako obulungi, “Nkwagaliza obulamu obulungi.” Kristo ky’ayagaliza kyenkana ekisuubizo n’ekiragiro. Kifaanana nnyo n’omukisa Omutume Yokaana gwe yasabira mukwano gwe omwagalwa Gayo, era naffe twandyagadde okuguddiŋŋana eri mikwano gyaffe abaagalwa okusinziira ku kujjula kw’okwagala kwa Mukama waffe. Maayi 10 “Ndi mulamu emirembe gyonna” (Okubikkulirwa 1:18). Buno bwe bubaka bwa Kristo ow’omusaalaba, ne Kristo ow’okuzuukira ow’ekitiibwa ekisingako era ow’omuwendo ogusingako. Kirungi era kizzaamu amaanyi okulaba ekitangaala n’ekitiibwa ebigambo bino ebyangu bye biyambaza omusaalaba. Tekigambibwa nti Nze eyali afudde era omulamu, wabula nti “Nze omulamu, nnali nfudde naye kaakano ndi mulamu emirembe gyonna.” Obulamu bwogerwako okufa nga tekunnayogerwako. Waliwo engeri bbiri ez’okutunuulira omusaalaba. Emu ya ku ludda lw’okufa, endala ya ku ludda lw’obulamu. Emu ye Ecce Homo, endala ye Yesu agulumizibbwa ng’alina enkovu z’emisumaali n’ey’effumu zokka. Bwe tutyo bwe tulina okutunuulira omusaalaba. Tetulina kutambula nga twetisse obuvundu bw’entaana, wabula ekitiibwa ky’okuzuukira. Si Ecce Homo, wabula Kristo Omulamu. Bwe kityo okukomererwa kwaffe kulina okuba okujjuvu ennyo nga kubulira mu kuzuukira kwaffe, ne twerabira n’ennaku yaffe, ne twetikka ekitangaala n’ekitiibwa eky’enkya ey’emirembe n’emirembe. Kale tubeere mu bulamu obuzaalibwa mu kufa, obuggya bulijjo era obujjudde obulamu obutayinza kufa, kubanga “bwafa, naye kaakano bulamu emirembe gyonna.” Maayi 11 “Buli ayagala okulokola obulamu bwe, alibufiirwa” (Lukka 9:24). Okusookera ddala, Kristo ayigiriza okuzuukira n’obulamu. Amaanyi g’Obukristaayo bwe bulamu. Tebutuleetera mateeka gokka, oba obuvunaanyizibwa, oba ekyokulabirako, awamu n’okuyigiriza n’okubuulirira okwa waggulu era okutukuvu. Butuleetera amaanyi ag’okugoberera ekiruubirirwa ekya waggulu, n’obulamu obukola ebyo ebiragirwa ku bwabwo. Naye si bulamu bwokka, wabula bulamu bwa kuzuukira. Era butandika n’akaseera ak’ensalo ak’amazima, ekikolwa ekitegeerekeka obulungi, akaseera akategeerekeka ng’emmambya bw’esala. Si kufa okutaggwaawo na kulwana okutaggwaawo okuba abalamu. Wabula byonna byogerwa mu ngeri ey’okwogera eraga ekintu ekikakafu, ekinywevu era ekikoleddwa ne kiggwa. Twafiira ddala mu kaseera akagere, era mu kaseera ako twatandikira ddala okubeera mu bulamu obw’okuzuukira. Twerowoozenga okuba abaafiira ddala eri ekibi, naye abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. Era okufa kkubo bukubo era mulyango, Eri obulamu obutalifa nate; N’omusaalaba gutwala eri engule ey’olubeerera, Yoludaani eri olubalama lwa Kanani olumasamasa.Maayi 12 “Ntegeeza gy’owumuliza endiga zo mu ssaawa ez’omu ttuntu” (Oluyimba 1:7). Abaagalwa, temwegomba kasiriikiriro ka Katonda, ebisenge eby’omunda, ekisiikirize kya Katonda Ayinzabyonna, ekyama eky’okubeerawo kwe? Obulamu bwammwe, oboolyawo, bubadde bwa kwekubiriza n’okukola buli kiseera, oba oboolyawo bwa kwekaka, okulwana, okwegomba nga temufuna. Woowe, okuwummula! okugalamira ku kifuba kye n’okumanya nti mulina byonna mu ye, nti buli kibuuzo kiddiddwamu, buli kubuusabuusa kumaliriziddwa, buli kye mufaako kiri mirembe, buli kusaba kuddiddwamu, buli kwegomba kumaliddwa. Muyimuse eddoboozi nti, “Ntegeeza ggwe gwe njagala, gy’oliisiza ekisibo kyo, ne gy’owumuliza endiga zo mu ssaawa ez’omu ttuntu”! Erinnya lye litenderezebwe! Alina kino ku lwaffe, okwagala kwe okw’enjawulo—okwagala buli muntu kinnoomu kw’awulira mu ngeri emu nti kwonna kwa ye yekka, mw’asobola okugalamira yekka ku kifuba kye n’okuba n’ekifo ekitali mulala yenna ayinza kumuwakanya; ate era omutima gwe munene nnyo nga gusobola okukwata obukadde lukumi nga bonna bali kumpi bwe batyo, era buli mutima ne gulabika ng’amulina yekka ku bubwe, nga n’obudiba obutono olukumi obw’amazzi ku lubalama lw’ennyanja bwe busobola okulaga ekifaananyi ky’enjuba, era buli kadiba akatono ne kalabika ng’akalina enjuba yonna ekwekeddwa mu buziba bwako obulungi. Era Kristo asobola okutuyigiriza ekyama kino eky’okwagala kwe okw’omunda ennyo. Maayi 13 “Mubeere mu Nze” (Yokaana 15:4). Obukristaayo buyinza okutegeeza enteekateeka y’eddiini bweteeka. Obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo buyinza okutegeeza okufuba okw’amazima era okw’obwesimbu okugoberera n’okukoppa Kristo, nga tewali kirala. Obulamu bwa Kristo businga bino, era bulaga okwegatta kwaffe okw’amazima ne Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, era awatali kubuusabuusa ali mu ffe ng’obulamu era ensibuko y’ebyo byonna bye tuyitamu ne bye tukola. Endowooza eno ey’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo obusingayo waggulu ya ngu era ya kitiibwa okusinga endala yonna. Mu mpapula zino tetuyigiriza nti ekigendererwa ky’okununula kwa Kristo kwe kutuzzaayo mu butuukirivu bwa Adamu obujjuvu, kubanga singa tubufuna twandibufiiriddwa enkya; wabula kwe kutwegattira ku Adamu Owookubiri, n’okutulinnyisa ku mutindo ogwa waggulu okusinga bazadde baffe abaasooka gwe baali bamanyi. Kino kye kintu kyokka ekisobola okutabaganya ebitundu ebiwakana eby’enjigiriza ez’enjawulo ku bikwata ku bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo. Omwoyo wa Katonda ajja kutukulembera obutaba na mpaka ku ndowooza bulowooza, wabula okunywerera ku muntu n’obulamu bwa Yesu Kristo yennyini, n’omukisa ogw’okwegatta naye, n’okubeera nga twesigamye bulijjo ku maanyi ge agakuuma ne ku kisa kye. Maayi 14 “Naye Katonda” (Lukka 12:20). Kiki ekirala kye twetaaga ddala? Kiki ekirala ky’agezaako okututegeeza? Eddiini ya Bayibuli ya maanyi ga Katonda gokka, agasukka obuntu. Ekintu ekimu okukkiriza kwe kwesigama bulijjo abadde Katonda omulamu, era ye yekka. Abaana ba Isirayiri baali beesigamye ddala ku Yakuwa nga batambula mu ddungu, era ensonga emu abalabe baabwe kye baava babatya ne banguwa okwewaayo, kwe kuba nti baategeera nga wakati mu bo mulimu eddoboozi lya kabaka ery’omwanguka, n’okubeerawo kw’Oyo amaanyi gaabwe gonna bwe gageraageranyizibwa gy’ali nga tegaliimu. “Si lwa kubanga onooba ogenze naffe,” Musa bwe yabuuza, “ne tuba ba njawulo, nze n’abantu bo, nga twawukana ku bantu bonna ab’oku nsi?” Ekkanisa eyeesigama ku magezi g’abantu, ku bugagga oba ku byo bwe balina, ereka okuba omubiri gwa Kristo n’efuuka ekibiina eky’ensi. Bwe tuguma ne twesigama ku Katonda yekka era awatali kubuusabuusa, ebikozesebwa ebisinga obwetoowaze n’obunafu bijja kufuuka “bya maanyi mu Katonda olw’okuwangula ebigo.” Omwoyo Omutukuvu atuwenga bulijjo endowooza ye yennyini ku bigambo bino ebibiri ebikulu, “Naye Katonda.” Maayi 15 “Nduubirira okutuuka awawakanirwa” (Abafiripi 3:14). Tulowoozezza nnyo ku bye tufunye. Kaakano tulowooze ku bintu bye tetunnafuna, ku bibya ebimu ebitannajjuzibwa, ku bifo ebimu mu bulamu bwaffe Omwoyo Omutukuvu by’atannatwalira Katonda, n’okubissaako akabonero k’ekitiibwa kye n’okubeerawo kwe. Emyezi egijja ginaaba gya kusiiga n’obunyiikivu era n’okwekebera omutima “amafuta ag’omuzeeyituuni aganaabanga gasigadde” ku bisoboka ebitannatuukibwako mu bulamu bwaffe ne mu buweereza bwaffe? Tumanyi obujjuvu bw’ekisa kye mu bulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo? Tulegeddeko ku kitiibwa kye? Tukkirizza ekisuubizo kye eri ebirowoozo, emmeeme, omwoyo? Tumanyi byonna by’asobola okukolera omubiri? Tumugezezza mu maanyi ge ag’okufuga ebibaawo mu bulabirizi bwe, n’okukyusa emitima gy’abantu n’egy’amawanga? Atuggulidde eggwanika lya Katonda, n’atuukiriza ebyetaago byaffe eby’ensimbi nga bw’ayinza? Tutandise n’okutegeera obuweereza obw’okusaba, nga Katonda bw’ayagala tubukole? Katonda atuwe “amafuta ag’omuzeeyituuni aganaabanga gasigadde”! Maayi 16 “Omuntu si y’aluŋŋamya amakubo ge” (Yeremiya 10:23). Ng’ogattiddwa ku Yesu Kristo ng’Omununuzi wo, okkiriziddwa mu Mwana, gw’ayagala ennyo. Takoma ku kutwala kifo kyange ng’omuntu n’okusasula amabanja gange. Akola ekyo n’ebisingawo. Ajja okuwa ekyokulabirako ekituukiridde eky’ekyo omuntu ky’asaanidde okuba. Ye muntu ow’ekyokulabirako, si w’okukoppa, kubanga ekyo kyandireese kuggwaamu maanyi n’okulemererwa okujjuvu; wabula ajja kujja yeekoppe mu ffe. Kristo bw’abeera mu nze, mba Kristo omulala. Simufaanana, naye nnina endowooza y’emu. Kristo yennyini ali mu nze. Guno gwe musingi gw’obutukuvu obw’Ekikristaayo n’okuwonya okwa Katonda. Kristo akuza obulamu obutuukiridde mu ffe. Abamu bagamba nti omuntu tasobola kutuukirira n’akatono. “Omuntu si y’aluŋŋamya amakubo ge.” Ffenna tuli balemereddwa. Kino kituufu, naye tusaanidde okweyongerayo. Tuteekwa okukkiriza Katonda ky’atutegekedde olw’okulemererwa kwaffe, ne tukusukkulumako olw’ekisa kye. Tuteekwa okutwala Yesu ng’akyusa ekifo ky’omuntu waffe ow’omunda omunaku. Tuteekwa okuleka ebirungi awamu n’ebibi ne tumutwala ye mu kifo kyabyo. Kizibu gye tuli okuyiga nti n’ebirungi ddala biteekwa okugenda, naye tuteekwa okuba n’okukubirizibwa okuva eri Katonda mu kifo ky’ebyo bye tutuuseeko ebisinga obulungi. Maayi 17 “Oyo awangula ndimuwa” (Okubikkulirwa 2:17). Ekyama eky’omuwendo eky’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo kwe kuba nga Yesu abeera munda mu mutima n’awangula ebintu bye tutandisobodde kuwangula. Kye kyama kyokka eky’amaanyi mu bulamu bwo ne mu bwange, abaagalwa. Abantu tebasobola kukitegeera, n’ensi terikikkiriza; naye kituufu nti Katonda alijja n’abeera munda mu ffe, n’aba amaanyi, n’obulongoofu, n’obuwanguzi, n’essanyu ery’obulamu bwaffe. Kaakano tekikyali nti, “Ekisinga obulungi kye nsobola okukola kye kiruwa?” wabula ekibuuzo kiri nti, “Ekisinga obulungi Kristo ky’asobola okukola kye kiruwa?” Kitusobozesa okugamba, awamu ne Pawulo, mu kitundu ekyo ekirungi ennyo mu Abafiripi nti, “Mmanyi okubeera nga sirina kantu, era mmanyi okuba nga nnina buli kimu. Mu buli ngeri ne mu bintu byonna nayiga ekyama ekiri mu kukkusibwa ne mu kuba omuyala, mu kuba n’ebingi ne mu bwetaavu. Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi.” N’okumanya kuno ngenda okusisinkana ebigezo byange, era ekyama kino kinnyamba. Kinkuuma nga ndi mulongoofu era omukkakkamu, nga nze bwe nnandiremeddwa okwekuuma. Kristo yasisinkana omulabe n’amuwangulira nze. Katonda yeebazibwe atuwanguza ffe ku bwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Maayi 18 “Kubanga mwafa” (Abakkolosaayi 3:3). Kaakano, okwambulamu kuno okw’omuntu waffe okutegeerekeka, okujjuvu era okw’enkomerero mu kikolwa eky’okufa, kye kintu kye tutasobola kwekolera ffekka. Si kwebonyaabonya, wabula kwe kufiira wamu ne Kristo. Tewali kisobola kukikola okuggyako Omusaalaba gwa Kristo n’Omwoyo wa Katonda. Ekkanisa ejjudde abantu abafudde ekitundu, abamaze emyaka nga bagezaako, nga Nero omunaku, okwetta, naye nga tebafunanga buvumu bwa kukuba kikonde ekitta. Woowe, singa beeteeka ku bigere bya Yesu, ne bamuleka ye akikole, wandibaddewo okutuukiriza n’okuwummula. Ku musaalaba ogwo yategeka okufa kwaffe awamu n’obulamu bwaffe, era omugabo gwaffe kwe kuleka okufa kwe kussibwe ku muntu waffe ow’edda nga bwe kwassibwa ku bibi byaffe eby’edda, oluvannyuma ne tumulekera Yesu, ne tutamulowoozaako nate, ne tumubala ng’afudde, nga tetukyamutwala nga ffe, wabula ng’omulala, nga tugaana okumuwuliriza oba okumutya, okwegatta naye, oba n’okugezaako okumulongoosa, wabula nga tumubala ng’ali mu mikono gya Mukama ddala, era ng’afudde gye tuli emirembe gyonna, era mu bulamu bwaffe obuggya bwonna nga twesigama ku Mukama buli mukka gwe tussa, ng’omwana omuwere azaaliddwa bw’ayesigama ku bulamu bwa nnyina. Maayi 19 “Alirongoosa lyeyongerenga okubala” (Yokaana 15:2). Gye buvuddeko twayita ku nnimiro y’ebimuli. Omulimi yali yakamala okusalira ebimera bye, era ebiwundu by’akambe n’eby’omusumeeno byali byakatandika okuwona, ng’omusana gwa Apuli ogw’ebbugumu gukyaliisa mpola ekimera ekyali kisaliddwa, ne gukizzaamu obulamu obuggya n’amaanyi. Bwe twatunuulira ekimera ekyo, twalowooza nga bwe kyandibadde eky’obukambwe okuddamu wiiki eddirira n’okitema. Kaakano omulimu gw’omulimi kwe kukizzaamu amaanyi n’okukiriisa kibeere kiramu. Omulimu gwakyo si kufa, wabula kuba kiramu. Bwe tutyo, twalowooza, bwe kiri n’okukangavvulwa kw’emmeeme. Nayo erina essaawa yaayo ey’okufa; naye teteekwa kubeera nga efa bulijjo: Wabula twerowoozenga okuba abaafiira ddala eri ekibi, naye abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe. Okufa kaseera buseera. Kale mubeere balamu, mmwe abaana b’okuzuukira, ku bulamu bwe obw’ekitiibwa, nga mweyongera okubufuna mu bujjuvu, n’obujjuvu bw’obulamu bwammwe bulisindiikiriza ebweru obwannannyini n’ekibi ebiyingirira, ne buwangula ekibi n’ekirungi, era obulamu bwammwe tebuliba kuziyiza kwa nnaku okw’okufuba kwammwe mmwe, wabula buliba amayengo agalinnya ag’obulamu bwa Kristo obuwangula obw’obwabwo era obutaggwaawo. Maayi 20 “Emibiri gyammwe si gyammwe ku bwammwe” (1 Abakkolinso 6:19). Nga mukisa gwa kitalo nti tusobola okwewaayo eri Katonda! Nga kisa kya kitalo nti Katonda akkiriza okututwala, ffe ensiriŋŋanyi ezitaliimu mugaso! Nga mu bigambo ebyo, “Siri wange ku bwange,” mukwekeddwa okuwummula n’okubudaabudibwa kungi! Sivunaanyizibwa ku bulokozi bwange, sizitoowereddwa bye nneeraliikirira, sigwanidde kubeerawo lwa bye nneegomba, wabula ndi wuwe ddala byonna; nnanunulibwa, ndi wuwe, nnalokolebwa, njagalibwa, nkuumibwa mu mikono egy’amaanyi egitakyuka egy’okwagala kwe okutaggwaawo. Woowe, okuwummula okuva mu kibi ne mu bwannannyini ne mu kweraliikirira okuzimbulukusa, okwewaayo okw’amazima kwe kuleeta! Okusobola okumuwa obulamu bwaffe obunafu obw’ennaku, n’ebyo ebisobola okubuggwaamu eby’entiisa n’obutasobola bwabwo ddala, ne tumanya nti alibukkiriza, n’asanyuka era n’akwatibwa ekitiibwa okubufuula ekisinga byonna ekisoboka eky’omukisa, eky’amaanyi n’eky’omugaso; okuwaayo byonna, ne tuzuula nti mu kukola ekyo tufunye byonna; okwewaayo gy’ali mu kwewaayo okujjuvu, ng’agwanidde okutulabirira nga bw’alabirira ye kennyini. Tuba tweteeka mu mikono gya Kitaffe ow’okwagala, afaayo ku bulungi bwaffe okusinga ffe bwe tusobola okufaayo, era ayagala kyokka tumugondere ddala, alyoke abeere n’eddembe erisingawo okutuwa emikisa. Maayi 21 “Tunajjanga ne tubeera mu ye era tunaatuulanga mu ye” (Yokaana 14:23). Bayibuli ebadde bulijjo eraga ebisuubizo bibiri ebikulu ebikwata ku Kristo. Ekisooka, Ndijja gye muli; n’ekyokubiri, Ndijja mu mmwe. Okumala emyaka enkumi nnya ensi yalindirira okutuukirira kw’ekisooka. Ekirala kye kyama Pawulo ky’agamba nti kyakwekebwa okuva edda n’edda lyonna, n’emirembe n’emirembe, naye kaakano kibikkuliddwa abatukuvu be, ekyama ekyo ye Kristo abeera mu mmwe, era ly’essuubi ery’ekitiibwa. Kino kibikkulirwa kya Katonda kikulu nga bwe kiri okufuuka omuntu kwa Yesu, kubanga kikufuula okufaanana Kristo, nga tolina kibi nga ye bw’atalina. Kristo bw’abeera mu ggwe, biki ebinaava mu ekyo? Kale, alikuggyawo ddala. “Nze” ali mu ggwe aligenda. Onoogamba nti, “Si ku bwange, wabula ku bwa Kristo.” Kristo akulwanira entalo zo. Kristo afuuka obulongoofu n’ekisa n’amaanyi mu ggwe. Tofuba kutuuka ku bintu ebyo, wabula omanyi nti obifunye mu ye. Kuwummula kwa kitiibwa awamu ne Mukama waffe. Yesu tagamba nti, “Kaakano tuteekwa okubala ebibala, tuteekwa okusaba ennyo, tuteekwa okukola kino oba kiri.” Temuli kuwaliriza kwonna, okuggyako nti tuteekwa okubeera mu ye. Eyo y’ensibuko y’essanyu lyonna n’obuyambi bwonna. Maayi 22 “Lwananga okulwana okulungi okw’okukkiriza” (1 Timoseewo 6:12). Woowe, abaagalwa, Katonda anaawulira atya ku ffe, ng’amaze okutuwa omusaayi gw’omutima gwe, n’atuteekera emikisa emingi mu kkubo lyaffe, n’atumalirako ekisa kingi n’okufaayo kungi, singa tumulemesa. Kireetera omwoyo okukaaba nti, “Ebyo ani abisobola?” Bulijjo ndaba mu maaso gange ekiseera ggwe nange we tuliyimirira ku lubalama olw’emitala eri ne tutunula emabega ku myaka egyayita, emyaka gino emitono emimpi egy’obulamu buno. Woowe, ka twesuule ku bigere bya Yesu tugambe nti: “Emirundi mingi twesittadde; entalo nnyingi enzibu zizze, naye ggwe onkuumye era onnyweredde; Katonda yeebazibwe, ampanguza ku bwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo.” Okuva mu ttale ly’olutalo olwa Peninsula, akabinja k’abaserikale abakadde kaavaayo, ne baweebwa buli omu omudaali nga guliko amannya g’entalo zaabwe zonna ku ludda olumu, ate ku ludda olulala nga guliko akagambo kano akatono, “Nnaliwo.” Woowe, essaawa eyo bw’erituuka, kibeere ekirowoozo eky’essanyu lingi ddala okutunula emabega ku bigezo ne ku bye twewaddeyo mu nnaku zino, ne tujjukira nti, “Nnaliwo, era olw’obuyambi bwa Katonda n’ekisa kya Yesu, ndi wano.” Maayi 23 “Omukisa gwa Kristo mu bujjuvu” (Abaruumi 15:29). Abakristaayo bangi balemererwa okulaba emikisa gino nga bwe gisibuka mu ye. Baagala okufuna omukisa ogw’obulokozi, naye ogwo si ye Kristo. Baagala okufuna omukisa ogw’ekisa kye okubayamba, naye ogwo si ye. Baagala okufuna okusaba okwanukulwa okuva gy’ali basobole okumukolera. Oyinza okuba n’ebyo byonna nga tolina mukisa gwa Kristo yennyini. Abantu bangi nnyo beesiba bweesibi ku nteekateeka y’enjigiriza. Bagamba nti, “Yee, nfunye amazima; nzikiriza ekituufu.” Ekyo si ye Kristo. Kiyinza okuba ng’ekifaananyi ekinnyogovu ekikoleddwa mu jjinja ekiri mu nsulo, amazzi nga gayita mu mikono gyakyo n’emimwa gyakyo eginnyogovu, naye nga temuli bulamu. Abantu abalala bangi nnyo baagala okufuna omukisa ogw’essanyu, naye ogwo si mukisa gwa Kristo yennyini. Abantu bangi nnyo beesiba nnyo ku kkanisa yaabwe ne ku musumba waabwe, oba ku mikwano gyabwe Abakristaayo abaagalwa, naye ekyo si ye Kristo. Omukisa gwokka ogulijjuza omutima gwo ebirala byonna bwe biriggwaawo gwe mutima gwa Yesu ogw’okwagala ogugattiddwa naawe, ensulo y’emikisa gyo gyonna era atalemererwa, byonna bwe biwotoka ne biggwaawo—Yesu Kristo yennyini. Maayi 24 “Ekkubo eridda mu nnyumba omusana gye gusula liri ludda wa” (Yobu 38:19). Amayinja ag’omuwendo, ku bwago, tegalina muwendo, okuggyako nga gatuusibwa ku kitangaala. Bwe gateekebwa mu bifo ebimu, gayolesa obulungi bw’enjuba. Awatali ekyo tegalina bulungi bwonna. Dayimanda ekyali mu kasenge kaayo ak’ekizikiza oba wansi mu kirombe ekiwanvu, teraga bulungi bwonna n’akatono. Kiki ekiri mu yo okuggyako ekitundu ky’amanda, akatundu ka kaboni eya bulijjo, okuggyako nga efuuka ekyolesa ekitangaala? Era bwe kityo bwe kiri n’amayinja amalala ag’omuwendo. Amabala gaago ag’enjawulo si kintu awatali kitangaala. Bwe gaba n’enjuyi nnyingi, gayolesa ekitangaala ekisingawo, ne garaga obulungi obusingawo. Bw’oteeka ejjinja ery’obulimba ku mabbali ga dayimanda, terimasamasa n’akatono. Mu mbeera yaayo etannalongoosebwa teyolesa kitangaala n’akatono. Bwe tutyo naffe tuli mu mbeera etannalongoosebwa era tetulina mugaso n’akatono okutuusa Katonda lw’ajja n’atwakira. Ekitangaala ekiri mu dayimanda si kyayo ku bwayo; bulungi bwa njuba. Bulungi ki obuli mu mwana wa Katonda? Bulungi bwa Yesu bwokka. Tuli bantu ba Katonda bennyini, abaalondebwa okutenda ebirungi by’oyo eyatuggya mu kizikiza n’atuyingiza mu butangaavu bwe obutenkanika. Leero ka twolese ekitangaala kye n’okwagala kwe. Maayi 25 “Mmumanye” (Abafiripi 3:10). Kirungi okumanya Yesu yennyini okusinga okumanya amazima agamukwatako, olw’ebintu ebya Katonda eby’obuziba nga bwe bibikkulwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Kwe kwali okwegomba kwa Pawulo okukulu, “Mmumanye,” si kumanya bimukwatako, si byama bya nsi ey’ekitalo, oba eby’enjigiriza za Katonda ez’obuziba n’ez’oku ntikko, wabula okuyingira mu Watukuvu w’Awatukuvu, Kristo gy’ali, ekitiibwa kya Shekina gye kyakira ne kifuula ekifo ekyo eky’ekitiibwa olw’obutukuvu bwa Katonda, n’oluvannyuma okuyingira mu kyama kya Mukama yennyini. Ekyo Yakobo kye yafuba okufuna e Penieri, bwe yeegayirira Katonda nti, “Mbuulira erinnya lyo.” Atubuulidde erinnya lye, ng’atuwa “ekitangaala eky’okumanya ekitiibwa kya Katonda ekirabikira mu Yesu Kristo.” Ekyo kye kyama. Ye Mukama yennyini, so si kirala kyonna; kwe kumanyagana ne Katonda; kwe kumanya Yesu Kristo nga bwe tutamanyi mulala yenna; kwe kusobola okugamba, si “Mmukkiriza” kyokka, wabula “Mmumanyi”; si bimukwatako, wabula mmumanyi. Ekyo kye kyama ekisinga ebirala byonna Katonda ky’ayagala tubeere nakyo; kye ky’atuteekeddeteekedde olw’ekitiibwa n’amaanyi, era kiweebwa buwa oyo akinoonya n’omutima omulamba. Maayi 26 “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga” (Abafiripi 4:6). Okukwasa kitegeeza okuwaayo, okwesiga omulala ddala. Kale, bwe tumuwa ebigezo byaffe, alibyetikka. Bwe tutambulira mu butuukirivu alituyisaamu. “Noolwekyo mwewombeeke wansi w’omukono gwa Katonda ogw’amaanyi, naye alibagulumiza ng’obudde butuuse.” Waliwo emikono ebiri awo—omukono gwa Katonda ogutunyigiriza wansi, ne gututoowaza, n’oluvannyuma omukono gwa Katonda ogutusitula waggulu. Mumutwalirenga byonna bye mweraliikirira, olwo omukono gwe gulibasitula, ne gubagulumiza ng’obudde butuuse. Mu lunyiriri luno mulimu okufaayo kwa ngeri bbiri—okufaayo kwammwe n’okufaayo kwe. Mu lulimi olwasooka byawukana. Ekimu kitegeeza okweraliikirira, ekirala kitegeeza okufaayo kw’Ayinzabyonna. Mumutwalire okweraliikirira kwammwe, mutwale okufaayo kwe okw’Ayinzabyonna mu kifo kyakwo. Temuddangamu kufaayo ku buzibu, wabula mukkirize nti asobola okubawanirira mu bwo. Okufuga kuli ku bibegabega bye. Mukkirize nti, bwe mumwesiga ne mumugondera, ne mutuukiriza by’ayagala, alirabirira ebibafaako. Muwanyisiganye bugya emigugu. Mwetikke ekikoligo kye, mumuleke abalabirire. Maayi 27 “Okufuga kunaabanga ku bibegabega bye” (Isaaya 9:6). Toyinza kuwummuza mutima ng’oguyimiriza okukuba. Eddagala erya belladonna lisobola okukola ekyo, naye okwo si kuwummula. Ka omukka ogw’obulamu gujje—obulamu bwa Katonda n’amaanyi ge—olwo wanaabaawo okuwummula okuwooma. Enkolagana ey’omu maka n’okwagala kw’ab’omu nnyumba tebikuleeta. Okununulibwa mu buzibu tekukuleeta. Emitima mingi egyagezesebwa gigambye nti: “Singa obuzibu buno obunene bwandiggwaawo, nandiwummudde.” Naye obumu bwe buggwaawo obulala buba bujja. Empeewo ennaku efumitiddwa ku lusozi, erowooza nti singa yandisobodde okunaaba mu kagga k’oku lusozi ak’edda, yandiwummudde. Naye akasaale kali mu nnyama yaayo era tewali kuwummula gy’eri okutuusa ekiwundu lwe kiwona. Kirumira mu nnyanja y’oku lusozi nga bwe kirumira mu lusenyi. Tetulifuna kuwummula kwa Katonda na mirembe mu mutima okutuusa nga tuwaddeyo byonna eri Kristo—n’omulimu gwaffe—ne tukkiriza nti abitutte byonna, era ffe kye tulina okukola kwe kusirika busirisi n’okwesiga. Kyetaagisa okutambulira mu buwulize obutukuvu ne tumuleka okufuga kubeere ku bibegabega bye. Pawulo yagamba kino nti: “Kino ekimu kye nkola.” Waliwo ekkubo limu efunda eri ffe ffenna—okwagala kwa Kristo n’omulimu gwe eri ffe. Maayi 28 “Yeetoowaza” (Abafiripi 2:8). Ekimu ku bintu ebisinga obuzibu eri obuntu obw’ekitiibwa era obw’oku ntikko kwe kubeera wansi w’obuyinza, okwefiiriza okwagala kwe, n’okutwala ekifo eky’okugondera. Naye Kristo yeeteekako ekifaananyi ky’omuddu, n’aleka obwetwaze bwe, obuyinza bwe obw’okwesanyusa, eddembe lye ery’okwerondera, era ng’amaze okuva emirembe n’emirembe egy’edda nga tamanyi kirala okuggyako okulagira, ne yeewaayo okugondera kwokka. Oluusi ndabye omusajja eyali mugagga ng’akozesa abalala ng’afuuse omukozi wa bulijjo mu dduuka lye limu. Kyali si kifo kyangu wadde eky’ekitiibwa, nkukakasa. Naye Yesu yali muweereza atuukiridde nnyo, Kitaawe n’okugamba n’agamba nti: “Laba Omuweereza wange, gwe njagala ennyo asanyusa emmeeme yange.” Mu bulamu bwe bwonna ekigambo ekyamukulemberanga kyali nti, “Omwana w’Omuntu yajja kuweereza.” “Wano mu mmwe nze muweereza wammwe.” “Siyinza kukola kintu kyonna ku bwange.” “Si nga Nze bwe njagala, wabula ky’oyagala kye kiba kikolebwa.” Mmwe abaagalwa, muyize ekifo ky’omuweereza? Era nate, “N’aba muwulize n’okutuukira ddala ku kufa, ate okufa okw’okukomererwa ku musaalaba.” Obulamu bwe bwonna bwali kufa, era ku nkomerero yawaayo byonna eri okufa, era n’eri ensonyi, okufa okw’okukomererwa. Kino ekisembayo kye kyali okutuukirira kw’okwagala kwe. Maayi 29 “Omubiri gwa Mukama, ne Mukama wa mubiri” (1 Abakkolinso 6:13). Kale, nga Kristo yennyini bwe yatuwa obutuukirivu, era Kristo yennyini bwe yafuulibwa okutukuzibwa kwaffe, bwe kityo lwa kwegatta naye ffe kennyini lwokka lwe tusobola okufuna obulamu buno obw’omubiri n’okununulibwa kwagwo. Mazima, si kukwatibwako kwa maanyi ku mubiri gwaffe okuguzzaawo, n’oluvannyuma ne kuguleka eri amaanyi n’obulamu obwa buzaaliranwa byokka mu biseera eby’omu maaso; wabula kwe kwegatta okw’obulamu era okw’amazima okw’omubiri gwaffe ogufa n’omubiri ogwazuukira ogwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, obulamu bwe bwennyini ne bujja mu mubiri gwaffe, ye yennyini n’afuulibwa gye tuli amaanyi, obulamu obulungi n’okununulibwa okujjuvu okw’omubiri. Mulamu emirembe n’emirembe era yeetoowaza n’abeera mu nnyumba zino ez’ebbumba. Abo abamusembeza bwe batyo bayinza okumumanya ng’abo abamuggya mu mibiri gye yeekolera bwe batayinza kumumanya n’akatono. Kino kye kimu ku byama by’Enjiri eby’obuziba era eby’omuwendo. “Omubiri gwa Mukama, ne Mukama wa mubiri.” “Oba temumanyi ng’omubiri gwammwe ye Yeekaalu ya Mwoyo Mutukuvu Katonda gwe yabawa, era n’emibiri gyammwe si gyammwe ku bwammwe? Kubanga mwagulibwa na muwendo, noolwekyo emibiri gyammwe gigulumizenga Katonda.” (Enkyusa Empya) Maayi 30 “Ndibawa Omwoyo wange” (Ezeekyeri 36:27). “Ndibawa Omwoyo wange alibakubiriza okugoberera ebiragiro byange n’okukuuma obulungi amateeka gange.” “Ndibassaamu omwoyo oguntya, muleme kuddayo kunvaako.” Woowe, mukwano gwange, ekyo tekyandibadde kya mukisa, tekyandibadde kuwummula kwa kitalo gy’oli, ggwe akooye ddala olw’okulwana kuno mu maanyi go ggwe? Toyagala musajja w’amaanyi okuwangula omusajja ow’amaanyi ow’obwannannyini n’ekibi? Toyagala mukulembeze? Toyagala Katonda yennyini kubeera naawe, okubeera mu ggwe ng’omutuuze? Toyagala kuwummula? Tomanyi kwetaaga kuno? Woowe, okuwulira kuno okw’okuzzibwa emabega, ng’oyaayaana, ng’oyagala, naye nga totuukiriza. Ekyo ky’ajja okukola; “Muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako.” Ekisinga ekyo, “Muliweebwa amaanyi ga Mwoyo Mutukuvu ng’abakkako.” Eyo y’enkyusa entuufu, era ddala yawukana nnyo ku endala. Toliweebwa maanyi ggwe kennyini, abantu ne bagamba nti: “Ng’omusajja oyo alina amaanyi mangi. Tolibeera na maanyi gonna n’akatono, wabula oliweebwa amaanyi ga Mwoyo Mutukuvu ng’akukkako, ye nga y’alina amaanyi, ekyo kyokka.” Maayi 31 “Noolwekyo buli eyeetoowaza ng’omwana ono omuto” (Matayo 18:4). Tolifuna mutima mwetoowaze okutuusa nga guzaaliddwa okuva waggulu, okuva mu mutima gwa Kristo. Kubanga omuntu yafiirwa obuntu bwe, era woowe, emirundi mingi nnyo abeera na mutima gwa ddayimooni. Katonda ayagala ffe, ng’Abakristaayo, tubeere abaangu, ab’obuntu, abasemberwa era ng’abaana abato. Abakristaayo be tumanyi era be twagala ennyo, era abasinga okuba okumpi ne Mukama, be basinga okuba abaangu. Buli lwe tufuuka abeekuluntaza tuba tusaanira kuteekebwa mu kisenge ky’ebifaananyi kyokka, era tuba ba mugaso ku ntobo y’ekifaananyi kyokka; naye, bwe tuba tugenda okubeera mu bantu ne tubaagala ne tubalokola, tuteekwa okuba abasemberwa era ab’obuntu. Obukakanyavu bwonna ngeri ndala ya kwerowoozaako. Saba Kristo omutima ogw’obuntu, akamwenyumwenyu akanaabeera aka buzaaliranwa ng’ak’omwana wo omuto ng’ali mu maaso go. Woowe, Kristo yakola bingi nnyo mu bikolwa ebitono! Teyandituuse ku mukazi Omusamaliya singa yajja gy’ali nga nnabbi. Yatuula, ng’omusajja akooye, n’agamba nti: “Mpa ku mazzi nnyweko.” Era bwe kityo, mu bulamu bwe bwonna, obuntu bwe obwangu n’okwagala kwe bye byamutwala eri abalala, ne bibatwala gy’ali n’eri obulokozi bwe obungi.

fields.title: Juuni
fields.body_html:
Juuni 1

“Eby’obutuukirivu mu mateeka biryoke bituukirire mu ffe” (Abaruumi 8:4).

Mikwano gyange abaagalwa, mumanyi ensobi abamu ku mmwe gye mukola? Abamu ku mmwe mugamba nti: “Tekisoboka nze okuba omulungi; tewali muntu eyali atuukiridde, era tekingasa kugezaako.” Eyo y’ensobi bangi ku mmwe gye mukola. Nzikiriziganya n’ekigambo ekisooka, “Tewali muntu eyali atuukiridde”; naye sikkiriziganya na ky’okubiri, “Tekigasa kugezaako.” Waliwo obutuukirivu obwa Katonda bwe tuyinza okufuna. Sitegeeza obwo bwokka obusonyiwa ebibi byo — n’ekyo nkikkiriza — naye ntegeeza ekisingawo nnyo; ntegeeza obwo obuyingira mu mwoyo gwo ne bwegatta n’obuwuzi bwonna obw’obulamu bwo; ntegeeza Kristo; obulamu bwo, obulongoofu bwo, akufuula okuwulira nga Kristo bw’awulira, okulowooza nga Kristo bw’alowooza, okwagala nga Kristo bw’ayagala, okukyawa nga Kristo bw’akyawa, era okuba “abagabanira awamu obuzaaliranwa bw’obwakatonda.” Obwo bwe butuukirivu bwa Katonda; “eby’obutuukirivu mu mateeka biryoke bituukirire mu ffe,” si ffe, wabula mu ffe; si mikono gyaffe n’ebigere byaffe byokka, wabula obuzaaliranwa bwaffe bwennyini, okwegomba kwaffe kwennyini, n’obutonde bwaffe bwennyini nga bumera nga bukwatagana n’obubwe. Mumufunye, mikwano gyange abaagalwa? Alijja n’atuukiriza byonna ebituufu mu mmwe singa leero mwanjululiza omutima gwammwe.

Juuni 2

“Nga bwe mwaweebwa Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe, mutambulirenga mu ye” (Abakkolosaayi 2:6).

Wano we wali ensigo yennyini ey’obulamu obw’omwoyo. Si mbeera ya munda gy’owulira nnyo, wabula bulamu obuli mu mutima. Kristo ku lwaffe gwe musingi gw’obulokozi bwaffe era ye nsibuko y’okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwaffe; Kristo mu ffe ye nsibuko y’okutukuzibwa kwaffe. Kino bwe kifuuka ekya nnamaddala, “Mwafa”; embeera yo, ebyo by’oyitamu n’obusobozi bwo tebikyeesigibwa okusinga eby’omuntu afudde, naye “obulamu bwammwe bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda.” Tebukulabikira na bulijjo. Bukwekeddwa era bubikkiddwa ne busibibwa mu ye n’okutuusa nga bulabika era ne bunywera bw’obeera mu ye bwokka. Weewaawo, “Kristo atuwa obulamu,” ye yennyini ateekwa okubukuuma bulijjo, era afuulibwe gy’oli, okuva eri Katonda, byonna by’weetaaga. Noolwekyo, obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo si kujja eri Kristo akulokole, olwo n’ogenda mu maaso n’okola okutukuzibwa kwo ggwe wekka, wabula “nga bwe mwaweebwa Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe, mutambulirenga mu ye,” nga weesigamye era ng’omwesiga mu bwangu nga bwe wamwesiga olw’okusonyiyibwa n’obulokozi bwo.

Ai mikwano, nga kyandyanguyizza emirimu gyaffe Egy’olunaku olwakatandika, Okutambula obulamu bwaffe omutendera gumu gumu N’obudde bwaffe akaseera akamu akamu.

Juuni 3

“Muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8).

Waliwo amaanyi gye tuli bwe tuba n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Katonda ayagala twogere eri abantu mu ngeri ebawuliza, mu ngeri gye batalyerabira. Katonda ategeka buli Mukristaayo okuba ow’omugaso, okubalibwa mu bikolwa ne mu bibala ebya nnamaddala eby’omulimu gw’Ekikristaayo. Mikwano gyange abaagalwa, Katonda yakutuma wano obeere maanyi ggwe kennyini. Tewali n’omu ku mmwe atali nnamuziga w’omugaso mu kyuma kino, era asobola okutuukiriza byonna Katonda by’akuyita okukola. Nzikiriza n’obwesimbu nti tewali kintu Katonda ky’asuubira mu muntu, Katonda ky’atalimuwa maanyi kukola. Tewali kintu Katonda ky’atwetaagako, nze oba ggwe, ky’atalikakasa, era alituwa ky’alagira. Nzikiriza nti Kristo Yesu bwe yabeerawo, n’afa, n’atuweereza Omwoyo Omutukuvu, yaweereza ebyetaagisa byonna olw’obwetaavu bwaffe bwonna, era nti tewali kifo kya kulemererwa mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo bwe tunaakkiriza okutwala ebyo Katonda by’atuwa. Yesu, Oyo eyalinnya mu ggulu, n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, amaanyi, obulamu n’obusobozi bwa Katonda obubeera mu ffe, bamala olw’ebizibu byonna ebiyinza okutuuka. Kino okikkiriza? Bw’okikkiriza, muleke ayingire mu mutima gwo, awatali kwekuumako, era mukkirize akufuge era akolere mu ggwe leero n’amaanyi ge.

Juuni 4

“Nga tutunuulira Yesu” (Abaebbulaniya 12:2).

Wateekwa okubaawo okutunuulira Yesu obutayosa, oba, nga Bayibuli ey’Olugirimaani bw’egyogera, okuggya amaaso ku birala n’ogassa ku Yesu; kwe kugamba, okuggya amaaso ku kibi, okugaana okukiraba, obutakkiriza birowoozo kukiwummulako na kaseera. Twandibadde n’ebikowe eby’omu birowoozo nga bwe tulina eby’omubiri, ebikozesebwa ng’engabo, ne bitakkiriza kintu kibi kuyingira; oba ng’olusiisira olwazimbibwako ekikomera mu kibira, olugoba olulumba olusooka olw’omulabe. Guno gwe mugaso gw’ebikowe by’amaaso gaffe, era bwe kityo bwe kyandibadde n’omwoyo. Bangi balabika nga tebamanyi nti balina amaaso ag’omwoyo. Bayita mu nsi ng’abasaliddwako ebikowe, ne batunulira ebirungi n’ebibi kyenkanyi. Setaani ajja n’ebifaananyi bye ebibi n’abagamba batunule. Tetuyinza kutunuulira kibi ne tutayonoonebwa. Oluusi, nga tutambula mu luguudo, okulaba ebimu ku bifaananyi ebiri mu kkubo kusuula obucaafu bwabyo ku mwoyo, ne tuwulira nga twetaaga okunaazibwa mu musaayi gwa Yesu essaawa nnyingi okutukuzibwa. Tewabaddewo kukkiriza kibi, naye okukiraba kwonoonye. Tewali kya kutuyamba okuggyako okutunuulira Kristo mu munda n’obumalirivu era obutakyukakyuka.

Juuni 5

“Omutima gwange munywevu, Ayi Katonda” (Zabbuli 57:7).

Tetuwulira ssanyu bulijjo, naye tuteekwa bulijjo okukibala ng’essanyu. Ekigambo kino okubala kye kimu ku bigambo ebikulu eby’Ebyawandiikibwa. Kye kigambo kye kimu ekikozesebwa ku kufa kwaffe. Tuwulira n’obulumi nti waliwo ekintu ekyandisanyukidde okudda mu bulamu. Naye tuteekwa okwetwala ng’abaafa, ne tutatya so ne tutagondera butonde obukadde. Bwe tutyo tuteekwa okubala ekintu ekituuka ng’omukisa; tumaliridde okusanyuka, okugamba nti, “Omutima gwange munywevu, Mukama; nnaakutenderezanga n’ennyimba.” Okusanyuka kuno okw’okukkiriza mangu kulifuuka omuze, era bulijjo kulireeta mangu omwoyo ogw’essanyu n’okutendereza okuyiika okw’obwannakyewa.

Olwo, wadde omutiini tegutojjera, so n’emizabbibu nga tegiriiko bibala, amakungula g’emizeeyituuni ne gabula, ennimiro ne zitabala mmere n’akamu, endiga nga ziweddemu mu kisibo, nga n’ente tezikyalimu mu biraalo, kyokka tulijaguliza Mukama, ne tusanyukira mu Katonda Omulokozi waffe.

Wadde ensozi ez’emirembe n’emirembe N’ensi yennyini nga biggibwawo, Tewali kiyinza kukyusa kisa kye Oba okwagala kwe okw’emirembe n’emirembe.

Juuni 6

“Yeewaayo” (Abafiripi 2:8, Enkyusa Empya).

Omutendera ogusooka eri obutuukirivu bw’obwakabaka kwe kuba “abaavu mu mwoyo.” Olwo oguddako guba gwa wansi katono, “abali mu nnaku.” Kubanga kaakano oteekwa okufuuka omugonvu, oteekwa okumenyeka, oteekwa okufaanana ng’ekyuma mu muliro, Mukama ky’asobola okubumba; bwe kityo, tekimala kulaba butali butuukirivu bwo, wabula okubuwulira nnyo, okubwejjusa nnyo, okubukungubagira nnyo, okukkiriza nti si kintu kitono ekibi okuyingira mu bulamu bwo. Bw’atyo Katonda bw’akulembera omwoyo okutuuka ku butuukirivu bwe. Emirundi mingi agukulembera ng’aguyisa mu kugezesebwa n’ebibonyoobonyo ebimu. Kino kitera okujja oluvannyuma lw’okukyuka. Sirowooza nti kyetaagisa omwoyo okubonaabona ennyo era ekinene nga tegunnalokoka. Ndowooza nti aliguteeka mu muliro bw’amanya nti gulokose; bwe gutegeera nti gukkiriziddwa; bwe gutatya kukangavvulwa; nga si mukono gwa busungu, wabula mukono gwa kwagala. Ai, olwo, Katonda akussa wansi n’akufuula omwavu mu mwoyo, n’akukungubaza okutuusa lw’otuuka ku mutendera ogw’okusatu, kwe kuba omwetoowaze, amenyese, eyeewaddeyo, omuwulize, eyeetegefu, eyeewaayo byonna, era agalamidde wansi ku bigere bye, ng’akaaba nti: “Nkole ki, Mukama wange?”

Juuni 7

“Bwe muliba musitula, temulivaayo ngalo nsa” (Okuva 3:21).

Bwe tuba tuggiddwamu ddala byonna, ayagala tujjuzibwe ye yennyini n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Kya muwendo nnyo okumanya nti tewali kirungi mu ffe; naye, ai, tumanyi n’obulungi bwe obungi? Tuyinza okuba abeetegefu okukkiriza obutasobola bwaffe, naye tuli beetegefu kyenkanyi okukkiriza obusobozi bwe? Waliwo Abakristaayo bangi abasobola okugamba nti, “Obwesige obwo tebuva mu ffe ku lwaffe”; naye omuwendo, ntya, muto nnyo ogw’abo abasobola okugamba nti, “Obwesige bwaffe buva eri Katonda.”

Okakasa nti asobola okukuwa buli ky’weetaaga, oba owulira nti oteekwa okukifuna ggwe kennyini? Okkiriza nti Katonda kaakano awa buli ekibulawo mu mutima gwo ne mu bulamu bwo, okwesittala kwonna ne kuggyibwawo, n’oweebwa amaanyi ag’okumuweereza, nga Erisa bwe yatwala ebintu ebyereere n’abijjuza nga tebinnaterekebwa okukozesebwa? Omulokozi waffe, e Kaana, yalagira amasuwa g’amazzi gajjuzibwe okutuuka ku migo. Olwo amazzi ne gafuulibwa omwenge, naye nga amasuwa gamaze okujjula. Katonda ayagala abaana be babeere n’omutima omujjuvu bulijjo.

Juuni 8

“Empeke eteekwa okuseebwa okuvaamu omugaati” (Isaaya 28:28).

Omulimi takungula ssubi na muddo gwa nte n’agubetenta n’ekyuma ekizito. Naye eŋŋaano agifaako nnyo. Bw’atyo Katonda afaayo nnyo ku abo abagenda okuba ab’omugaso omungi gy’ali. Mu bo mulimu obutonde obwetaaga okukangavvulwa kuno. Teweewuunya singa empeke ey’omugaati ekwatibwa n’obwegendereza obw’amagezi, obw’enjawulo, obulyoke bugifuule emmere. Amanyi ekkubo ly’akwata, era waliwo obukwatampola obutakoma mu kulabirira kw’awa. Atunuulira ekikoomi mw’oli, ebbugumu lireme okuyitirira. Ayagala libeere ddene okumala okulongoosa, olwo ne liggyibwawo. Amanyi nga bwe twakolebwa. Taalekenga kukemebwa kutuukako okutali kwa bantu, naye awamu n’okukemebwa alitulaga n’ekkubo ery’okubiwangula, tulyoke tusobole okubigumira. Okkiriza okwagala kuno okukangavvula okw’Omulimi, era omwesiga n’okukulembera n’okufuga obulamu bwo? Ai, singa olekeraawo okukwatirwa obuggya oba okweraliikirizibwa abantu abakwetoolodde! Olunaku lumu olisanyukira okutendekebwa n’omukisa bye bakuleetedde.

Juuni 9

“Mmwe muli musana gwa nsi” (Matayo 5:14).

Tuyitibwa emisana gy’ensi, abasitula ekitangaala, endabirwamu, ebikondo by’ettaala, ettaala. Tuteekwa okukoleezebwa ffe bennyini, olwo tunaayaka ne tuwa abalala ekitangaala. Ffe kitangaala kyokka ensi ky’erina. Mukama yandisobodde okukka ye yennyini n’awa ensi ekitangaala, naye yalonda bulala. Ayagala okukiyisa mu ffe, era bwe tutakiwa ensi terikifuna. Twandibadde tuwa baliraanwa baffe ekitangaala buli kiseera. Katonda tateeka mmunyeenye egwa mu ggulu kututegeeza ddi lwe tuba twaka. Tuteekwa okuwa ekitangaala buli kiseera wonna we tuba, awaka, oba mu bantu, oba mu kifo kyaffe mu kkanisa. Twandiwulidde bulijjo nti tuyinza obutaddamu kufuna mukisa mulala ogw’ekyo, bwe tutyo twandibadde bulijjo twaka era tumasamasa ku lulwe. Ettaala zaffe zibeere nga ziseeseddwa, nga zaaka era nga zijjudde amafuta g’Omwoyo. Okusinga byonna, tubeere ekitangaala ekinywevu eri abo ababuze.

Ka mbeere mu Timunasusera, Enjuba gy’eyakira emirembe gyonna, Ekiro n’ekizikiza gye bitajja, N’obudde gye butakyaggwaako.

Juuni 10

“Kitammwe ali mu ggulu amanyi ng’ebyo byonna mubyetaaga” (Matayo 6:32).

Kristo okwesiga kwaffe mu bintu eby’ensi eno takutwala nga kwa muwendo mutono okusinga okwesiga kwaffe mu by’omwoyo. Akussaako essira ddene. Lwaki? Kubanga bubwo kizibu okwesiga Katonda mu byo. Mu by’omwoyo tuyinza okwerimba, ne tulowooza nti twesiga so nga tetwesiga; naye tetuyinza kukikola ku by’obusuulu bw’ennyumba n’emmere, n’ebyetaago by’omubiri gwaffe. Ebyo biteekwa okujja, oba nga okukkiriza kwaffe kulemereddwa. Kyangu okugamba nti tumwesiga mu bintu ebiri ewala ennyo, naye tewayinza kubaawo kuzannyira ku bintu awali okukkiriza okuteekwa okuleeta eby’okuddamu ebirabika. Kyangu okuba n’okukkiriza olw’ebyetaago byaffe, n’okumwesiga enjuba bw’eba eyaka. Naye wabeewo ebintu ebituyimbula, ne bitusiinya ne bituteganya, mangu ddala tukizuula oba tulina okwesiga okwa nnamaddala oba nedda. Bwe kityo ebintu eby’obulamu obwa buli lunaku bye bigezesa okukkiriza kwaffe okwa nnamaddala mu Katonda, era emirundi mingi atuteeka we tuteekwa okwesiga olw’ebintu ebikwatibwako—olwa ssente n’obusuulu, n’emmere n’ebyambalo. Bw’oba nga wano tomwesiga n’omutima gwonna, bw’oteekebwa mu bigezo ng’ebyo ojja kugwa. Owesiga Katonda mu buli kintu mu nnaku omukaaga eza bulijjo ez’omu wiiki?

Juuni 11

“Abavubuka bo, nga bali mu by’ekitiibwa ekitukuvu, balikukuŋŋaanirako ng’omusulo bwe gulabika ng’obudde bwakakya” (Zabbuli 110:3).

Woowe, singa ofuna okumulaba okw’engeri eyo nga kufuula ekitasoboka obutonotono okuddamu okukuteganya! Emitawaana emitono n’obutonotono obw’obusirusiru obukuteganyizza ennyo, bwandikujjuzza okwewuunya nti osobola okubirowoozaako ennyo bwe kityo. Woowe, singa olina omusulo gw’obuvubuka bwe, wanditambudde ng’enkya n’otuukiriza ekisuubizo ky’olunaku olw’ekitiibwa! Enjawulo nga nnene mu bulamu kasookedde tulaba nti kisoboka okukola kino! Kaakano nga kirabika kyangu, emitawaana emitono bwe gijja, okusembera katono eri Kristo, okunywa katono okusingawo ku nsulo ey’obulamu eyo, okusemberera katono omutima ogwo ogwagala, n’okusenamu ebinene eby’okuzzibwamu amaanyi n’obugumu okuva mu gwo. Nga kitangaaza obwongo olw’omulimu! Bw’ojja gy’ali bw’otyo, ng’ozitowereddwa era ng’oyongobedde era ng’okooye, nga owummula, n’osobola okubuuka nga weetegefu okukola. Nga kizzaamu amaanyi okulowooza nti Omutwe gwaffe omulamu takoowa! Akyali mugumu era mupya nga bwe yabanga bulijjo; muwanguzi ow’ekitiibwa; bulijjo ye Kristo awangula. Muleke akutwale leero, era ajja kukulaba mu ye Omukulembeze atawangulwa!

Juuni 12

“Twagala kulaba Yesu” (Yokaana 12:21).

Agulumizibwe olw’ebintu byonna ebituterekeddwa mu nnaku ezijja. Agulumizibwe olw’okwolesebwa kwonna okw’okuweereza mu biseera eby’omu maaso; emikisa egy’okukola obulungi egiri ewala n’egiri okumpi. Omulokozi waffe yasobola okunyooma omusaalaba olw’essanyu eryali mu maaso ge. Tumutunuulire, era tulinnye tumusemberere okutuusa lwe tutuuka waggulu ne tusobola okulengera okuva ku lusozi olw’okwolesebwa ensi yonna ey’ewala. Tewali kintu na kimu ekirituujjira mu biseera byonna eby’omu maaso mwe tutalisobola kulaba Kabaka mu bulungi bwe. Twekakase nnyo nti tewali kirala kye tulaba. Emmunye z’amaaso gaffe zirisigalako ekifaananyi nga zitunuulira okwolesebwa kuno, ne zitasobola kwolesa kirala kyonna. Omwana wange omuto lumu yajja gye ndi n’agamba nti: “Taata, tunuulira akabonero ka zaabu kali okulaba oluguudo okumala akaseera; kaakano tunuulira ekisenge ky’amatoffaali kiri ombuulire ky’olaba.” “Ndaba akabonero ka zaabu ku kisenge ky’amatoffaali.” N’aseka nnyo. Bwe kityo, singa tutunuulira Yesu ekiseera ekiwanvu, tetuyinza kutunuulira kintu kirala kyonna nga tetulaba kifaananyi kye mu kyo. Buli kye tulaba kirifuuka ekitundu kye.

Juuni 13

“Enjogera ennungi eyongera okuyamba okutegeera” (Engero 16:21).

Obulamu ekitundu kyabwo ekinene bwe bigambo. Oboolyawo tebiriimu maanyi nga ebikolwa. Ebikolwa byoleka ebirowoozo mu ngeri etegekeddwa okusingawo. Omu ku bawandiisi b’Endagaano Empya abasinga okwewuunyisa yagamba nti, “Omuntu yenna atasobya mu kwogera, aba muntu eyatuukirira.” Emirundi mingi kino kye kigezo ky’obuwanguzi mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo. Obuwanguzi bwaffe mu kino emirundi mingi businziira ku kye twogera, oba kye tutayogera. Yakobo agamba ku lulimi nti, “Lwo omuliro luguggya mu ggeyeena.” Omukristaayo ow’amazima, noolwekyo, mutuukirivu mu makubo ge era mwesimbu mu bigambo bye. Ebikolwa bye byogera eri abantu; naye mu kwogera atunula waggulu, kubanga Katonda awuliriza. Ebigambo bye biweerezebwa waggulu ne biwandiikibwa olw’omusango. Nzikiriza nti kino kituufu ddala, era kumpi ne ndowooza nti eggulu eriri waggulu, erirabika nga litangalijja ennyo, ebbanga eddungi erya bbululu eriri waggulu w’emitwe gyaffe, liri ng’ekipande ky’envumbo ekirina engulu ekwata ebintu mangu ennyo, era nga likwata ekifaananyi kya buli kigambo kye twogera, era nti oluvannyuma ebipande ebyo bikaluba ne biterekebwa olw’omusango ogw’emirembe n’emirembe. Kale twogerenga, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, ng’amaaso gaffe gatunula waggulu bulijjo, nga tetwerabira nti olunaku lumu tulisisinkana ebigambo bye twayogera.

Juuni 14

“Mikwano gya Mukama be bo abamugondera; anaababikkuliranga ekyama eky’endagaano ye” (Zabbuli 25:14).

Waliwo ebyama eby’obulabirizi bwa Katonda abaana be abaagalwa bye bayinza okuyiga. Engeri gy’abakwatamu emirundi mingi erabika, mu maaso agatunula kungulu, ng’ekizikiza era ng’etiisa. Okukkiriza kutunula wansi ennyo ne kugamba nti, “Kino kyama kya Katonda. Ggwe otunuulira kungulu kwokka; nze nsobola okutunula wansi ennyo ne ndaba amakulu agakwekeddwa.” Oluusi dayimanda zisibibwa mu bisibibwamu ebikalubo, omuwendo gwazo ne gutalabika. Eweema ey’Okukuŋŋaanirangamu bwe yazimbibwa mu ddungu, tewaali kya bugagga mu ndabika yaayo ey’okungulu. Ebintu eby’omuwendo omungi byonna byali munda, era ekibikkako kyayo eky’okungulu eky’amaliba g’ente ey’omu nnyanja tekyalaga kabonero konna ak’ebintu eby’omuwendo ebyali munda mu yo. Katonda ayinza okubaweereza, abaagalwa, emigugu egimu egy’omuwendo omungi. Temweraliikirira singa gisibiddwa mu bisibibwamu ebikalubo. Musobola okukakasa nti waliwo eby’obugagga eby’okwagala, n’ekisa n’amagezi ebikwekeddwa munda. Temuba basirusiru okusuula ekitole kya zaabu olw’okuba mulimu ejjinja erimu. Bwe tukkiriza ky’atuweereza, ne tumwesiga olw’obulungi obuli mu kyo, ne mu kizikiza, tujja kuyiga amakulu g’ebyama eby’obulabirizi bwe.

Juuni 15

“Tukulire mu Kristo mu byonna” (Abaefeso 4:15).

Amakungula kye kiseera eky’okwengera. Mu kiseera ekyo ebibala n’eŋŋaano biba bikuze ddala, mu bunene ne mu buzito. Ekiseera kigonzezza obukaawu bw’ekibala ekibisi. Kigonzeddwa ne kiwoomezebwa enkuba n’ebbugumu ly’ekyeya. Enjuba ekisiize amabala amalungi, era ku nkomerero kiba kyetegefu era kyengedde okugwa mu ngalo. Bwe butyo obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo bwe busaanidde okuba. Waliwo ebintu bingi mu bulamu ebyetaaga okugonzebwa n’okwengezebwa. Abakristaayo bangi balina ennimiro ezijjudde ebibala, naye byonna bibisi era bikaawa mu kamwa. Mulimu ebirungi bingi, naye tebituukiridde, era bikaawa nnyo era bikaatuuse. Oboolyawo ekintu ne kikyama mu bulamu bwo obw’awaka, n’oteganyizibwa n’onyiiga, n’ofiirwa obwesige bwo mu Katonda, n’oluvannyuma, mazima, n’essanyu lyo ery’Ekikristaayo. Ebintu ebyo bireeta okwejjusa n’ennaku eza buli ngeri. Waliwo ebintu bingi olunaku ku lunaku by’osaalirwa. Omanyi nti tokuze era togonze, era toyinza kufuuka bw’otyo lwa kugezaako. Toyinza kuyingiza buwoomi. Buteekwa okukolebwa okuva munda.

Juuni 16

“Toyinza kuweereza Katonda na mamona” (Matayo 6:24).

Tagamba nti tosobola bulungi kuweereza Katonda na mamona, wabula nti toyinza kuweereza bakulu babiri n’akatono. Ojja kukkakkana ng’oweereza omu. Omuntu alowooza nti aweereza Katonda katono aba alimbiddwa; taweereza Katonda. Katonda tajja kukkiriza kuweereza kwe. Setaani ajja kumutwalira ddala nga tannatuuka ku nkomerero. Omutima ogwawuddwamu gufiirwa ensi zombi. Sawulo yakigezaako. Balamu yakigezaako. Yuda yakigezaako, era bonna baalemererwa mu ngeri ey’entiisa. Maliyamu yalina okulonda kumu kwokka. Pawulo yagamba nti: “Ekintu kimu kye nkola.” “Nze mba mulamu lwa Kristo.” Ku bulamu obw’engeri eyo Katonda agamba nti: “Olw’okuba nga njagala kyendiva muwonya; nnaamukuumanga, kubanga amanyi erinnya lyange.” Katonda alina okwenyumiriza okw’enjawulo mu kulaga okwagala kwe eri omutima ogumulonda ddala. Eggulu n’ensi byandiggwaawo nga obwesige bwagwo tebunnaswazibwa. Tumulonze yekka ne tumuwa omutima gwaffe gwonna?

Gamba, byonna bya Yesu, Nga bw’oyimba emirundi mingi? Ye Mukama wo ow’obwakabaka? Ye Kabaka w’omutima gwo omwagalwa?

Juuni 17

“Ekitiibwa kya Katonda kikuveeko emabega” (Isaaya 58:8).

Ajja ku mabbali gaffe ng’omuyambi waffe; naye si ekyo kyokka, asingawo. Ajja okubeera munda mu ffe; okuba obulamu mu musaayi gwaffe, omuliro mu birowoozo byaffe, okukkiriza munda mu ffe, mu ntandikwa ne mu kutuukirira. Bw’atyo afuuka si mpeera ya muwanguzi yokka, wabula n’ensibuko y’obuwanguzi. Ye Muduumizi era Omuwanguzi mu bulamu bwaffe. Bwe tuba tufunye obuyambi bwonna obutuwummuzizza ku nkya eteganyizibwa, buvudde gy’ali. Ayimusa amaaso gaffe eri ye yennyini n’atununula okuva mu butafaayo, mu butamatira ne mu kutya. Bulijjo ye muyambi mu mpaka zino ez’eggulu, era y’aliba empeera ennene mu mirembe gyonna egijja. Obulamu bwaffe bwe buba bukwekeddwa mu ye tuliteekwa okuyita mu bigezo bye bimu bye yayitamu, naye tetulibisanga nga bizibu nnyo. Bwe tumukkiriza omulundi gumu ddala ng’amaanyi g’obulamu bwaffe, era nga ye byonna mu byonna, tujja kusobola okuteeka wabbali ebintu byonna ebituziyiza ebitunyigiriza olunaku ku lunaku.

Mpangudde, mpangudde, Mpangudde ku lulwo, Oliwangula, oliwangula, Oliwangula okuyita mu Nze.

Juuni 18

“Nnina omulimu munene, siisobole kuserengeta gye muli” (Nekkemiya 6:3).

Omulimu bwe guba mungi, waliwo obuntu obutono bungi obujja ne bulabika ng’obwetaaga okulabirirwa. Awo nno kiba kya mukisa nnyo okusirika n’okutereera, n’okweyongerayo n’omulimu, n’okukwasa Katonda obuntu obwo obutono. Addamu okwesiga okw’engeri eyo mu ngeri ey’ekitalo. Omwoyo bwe guba tegulina budde bwa kweraliikirira na kuteganyizibwa na kusiba kweraliikirira mu mutima, guba guyize ekyama ky’okukkiriza mu Katonda. Okwegomba okw’amaanyi okuggyawo obuzibu obumu kuggya eriiso ku Katonda ne ku kitiibwa kye. Abaagalwa abamu babadde beeraliikirivu nnyo okuwona, era bamaze obudde bungi nga bagezaako okwetwalira obuwonyi, ne bafiirwa omukisa gwabwe ogw’omwoyo. Katonda oluusi ateekwa okuyigiriza emyoyo egy’engeri eyo nti wateekwa okubaawo okukkiriza okulwala nga tebannaba kwewaayo ddala okutuuka ku kufuna omukisa gwe ogusingayo obujjuvu.

Omulabe emirundi mingi taleka mulimu guno. Sanubalaati yajja emirundi ena eri Nekkemiya era buli mulundi n’afuna eky’okuddamu kye kimu. Kirungi okunywerera ku ky’okuddamu ekirungi. Okutya kumeka kwe tuyimiridde okulwanyisa okwakkakkana nga si kintu ku nkomerero! Nekkemiya yategeera nti okutya kyali kibi, era teyaguma kukugondera.

Juuni 19

“Oba ani eyali asoose okumuwa ekintu, alyoke amuddizeewo?” (Abaruumi 11:35).

Abakazi Abakristaayo ab’ensi yonna balina obuyinza, nga bawaayo akantu katono ennyo, okwongera obukadde n’obukadde ku ggwanika lya Mukama. Bannyinaze abaagalwa, mwafuna essanyu ery’okwewaayo ku lwa Yesu? Waliwo kye mwawaayo mulyoke mukimuwe? Muwaayo ebintu byammwe eri Yesu? Alibitwala, era alibaddizaawo emirundi lukumi. Nnandisinze okwegatta ku mulimu ogwazimbibwa ku kwewaayo okunene okusinga ogwazimbibwa ku bugagga obungi obwaweebwayo. Ensonga lwaki Katonda yayagala ekifo yeekaalu ye ey’edda gye yayimirira mu kitiibwa, kwe kubanga eyo Ibulayimu gye yawaayo mutabani we ne Dawudi gye yawaayo eby’obugagga bye. Ensonga lwaki okununulibwa kwa muwendo nnyo eri Kitaffe n’eri ensi ey’omu ggulu, kwe kubanga ejjinja ery’omusingi gwakwo gwe Musaalaba ogw’e Kalvaali. Era obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo obusinga okwagalibwa mu mutima gwa Katonda, era obulirinnya mu kitiibwa n’omugaso ebisingayo, bwe bulwo omusingi gwabwo gwe kwewaayo n’okwefiiriza. Kyekyava Mukama waffe atuyigiriza okugaba, kubanga okugaba kitegeeza okwagala, ate okwagala liba linnya ddala eddala ery’obulamu.

Juuni 20

“Buli omu abeerenga mu kuyitibwa Katonda kwe yamuyitiramu” (1 Abakkolinso 7:20).

Mmwe abeemulugunya olw’okuyitibwa kwammwe oba abeeraliikirira olw’enkyukakyuka n’ebigezo eby’obulamu, mumanyi mutya obanga enkyukakyuka zino zennyini ze nkola za Katonda ez’obwakatonda, z’akozesa okutuukiriza ebigendererwa bye eby’omukisa n’omugaso ku mmwe? Singa Akula teyawalirizibwa kuva Ruumi n’okusaanyaawo amaka ge n’obusuubuzi bwe, oboolyawo teyandiyagganye na Pawulo, era teyandiyitiddwa mu kumanya n’okuweereza Kristo olw’okusisinkana kuno okwa Katonda. Singa teyali musajja akola, ng’akola omulimu gwe ogwa bulijjo, teyandireeteddwa kumpi n’omutume. Kyali mu lubu lw’okuyitibwa kwabwe, mu buvunaanyizibwa bwabwe obwa bulijjo, ne mu nkyukakyuka za Katonda ez’obulamu bwabwe, Katonda mwe yabayitira. Era bw’atyo bw’atusisinkana. Temufubanga nnyo kudduka kukwo, naye, nga omutume bwe yakyogera bulungi, “Buli omu abeerenga mu kuyitibwa Katonda kwe yamuyitiramu, era mwe yayitirwa abeere mu ekyo ne Katonda.” Mukozese bulungi emikisa gy’ofuna mu kayita.

Juuni 21

“Katonda yabateekawo mu kkanisa ... n’okuyamba abali mu kwetaaga” (1 Abakkolinso 12:28).

Mu lukalala lw’omutume olw’abakulu ab’omu kkanisa, “abayambi” boogerwako nga tebannatuuka ku “abakulembeze.” Nga tuyita mu buweereza obw’okusaba, obw’okugaba, obw’okuzzaamu amaanyi, mu maaso agamasamasa n’okunyweza omukono awatali kwogera, n’akaboozi akatono ak’okusanyusa, ne mu ngeri ezitabalika mwe tuyinza okuyamba, oba wolekaawo obutaziyiza, ffenna tusobola okuzuula ebigere bya Akula ne Pulisikira, bwe tuba twagala okubagoberera. Kisa kinene okusobola okusanyukira omulimu gw’omulala n’okufuka obulamu bwaffe, ng’emigga egijjudde, mu migga eminene. Naye Katonda amanyi buli ttondo gye lubuvudde, era ku lunaku olukulu olw’empeera abayambi bangi balifuna empeera esinga obukulu. Abaagalwa, muyamba? Muyamba omusumba wammwe, muganda wammwe, baze wammwe, maama wammwe, mukozi munnammwe, ne makungula bw’alituuka, asiga n’akungula balisanyukira wamu?

Oyinza okuyamba n’okusaba okutukuvu, Okwagala okuyamba n’oluyimba olw’essanyu, Ayi, emigugu gy’oyinza okusitula, Ayi, ennaku z’oyinza okugabana, Ayi, engule z’oyinza okwambala, Bw’oyamba mu maaso.

Juuni 22

“Eno ye mmere eva mu ggulu” (Yokaana 6:58).

Twalina ekiragiro ky’okufa mu ffe, tuleme kwetekamu bwesige mu ffe ffennyini, wabula mu Katonda azuukiza abafu; eyatuwonya mu kufa okwo okw’entiisa, era anaatulokolanga; era gwe tulinamu essuubi ery’okutuwonyanga. Kino kye kyali ekyama eky’okusukkuluma mu bulamu bwa Pawulo; yakima bulijjo mu mubiri gwe amaanyi aga Kristo, Omutwe gwe Omuzuukize. Omubiri ogwazuukira okuva mu ntaana ya Yusufu gwali gy’ali ekintu eky’omubiri ekituufu era ensulo etaggwaawo ey’amaanyi ge ag’obulamu. Okusinga omuntu omulala yenna, atugambye ekyama eky’amaanyi ge; “tuli bitundu bya mubiri gwe, eby’ennyama ye n’eby’amagumba ge”; “Mukama wa mubiri, n’omubiri gwa Mukama.” Amazima ag’ekitalo! Eddagala ery’Obwakatonda ery’Obulamu n’Ensulo ey’Obuvubuka Obutaggwaawo! Omusingo gw’Okuzuukira! Okutuukirira kwa zabbuli ez’edda n’ennyimba ez’okukkiriza! “Mukama ge maanyi ag’obulamu bwange; ani asobola okuntiisa? Omubiri gwange n’omutima gwange biyinza okulemwa; naye Katonda ge maanyi g’omutima gwange, era ye wange ennaku zonna.” Abaagalwa, ekyama kino tukiyize, era tuli mu kubeera n’obulamu bw’Oyo eyafuuka omubiri mu mubiri gwaffe?

Juuni 23

“Kaakano tuli baana ba Katonda, naye tetumanyi bwe tuliba” (1 Yokaana 3:2).

Tuli baana ba Katonda. Tetuyitibwa buyitibwa wadde okulangibwa mu mateeka kyokka, wabula ddala tuli baana ba Katonda olw’okufuna obulamu n’obuzaaliranwa bwa Katonda; era bwe tutyo tuli baganda ba Mukama waffe ddala; si mu buzaaliranwa bwe obw’obuntu kyokka, naye n’okusingawo mu nkolagana ye ey’obwakatonda. “Noolwekyo takwatibwa nsonyi kubayita baganda be.” Atuwa ekyo ekitusaanyiza omu ekyo, era ekitufuula abasaanira kimu. Tatuyingiza mu kifo kye tutayigirizibwako na kusaanira, naye atuwa obuzaaliranwa obusaanira embeera yaffe ey’ekitiibwa; era bw’alitutunuulira mu kugulumizibwa kwaffe okutuukiridde era okw’ekitiibwa nga tulaga ekifaananyi kye, nga twaka mu kitiibwa kya Kitaawe, tajja kuba na nsonga ya kutukwatirwa nsonyi. Ne kaakano asanyuka okututegeeza mu maaso g’obutonde bwonna n’okutuyita baganda be mu maaso g’ensi n’eggulu byonna. Ai, kino nga kigulumiza omutukuvu wa Katonda asinga obuwombeefu! Nga tetwetaaga kufaayo ku kutategeera kw’ensi obanga ye “takwatibwa nsonyi kubayita baganda be.”

Kale ka tugende leero okukiikirira olulyo lwe olw’obwakabaka.

Juuni 24

“Nnaakwambaza ebyambalo eby’omuwendo” (Zekkaliya 3:4).

Eri Pawulo buli mulimu ogw’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo gwali gwa kisa kya Yesu Kristo kyokka ekyamuweebwa era kye yakolera mu bulamu bwe, bwe kityo obutukuvu bwali kwambala Mukama Yesu n’ebyambalo byonna eby’obutuukirivu bwe obutuukiridde by’ayagala okwogerako emirundi mingi mu bbaluwa ze ennungi. “Mwambalenga, ng’abalonde ba Katonda abatukuvu era abaagalwa,” bw’agamba Abakkolosaayi, “omwoyo ogusaasira, n’ekisa, n’obuwombeefu, n’obuteefu, n’obugumiikiriza”; era, “okwagala kwe kusinga ebintu ebirala byonna, kubanga kwe kunyweza ebintu byonna.” Tewali na kimu ku bino ekitwalibwa ng’ekintu eky’omunda mu ffe, wabula nga bisa ebiweebwa okuva mu mukono gwa Yesu. Ne mu myaka egy’oluvannyuma egy’obulamu bwe, oluvannyuma lw’obumanyirivu obungi obw’ekitundu ky’ekyasa, tumusanga ng’aleekaana nti, “byonna mbiraba ng’okufiirwa, kubanga okutegeera Kristo Yesu Mukama wange, kusinga ebirala byonna. Olwa Kristo nafiirwa ebintu byonna, era mbiraba ng’ebisasiro, ndyoke ngobolole Kristo era ndabikire mu ye.”

Mukama, tusobozese leero okugenda, nga twambadde ebyambalo byo eby’obutuukirivu obutuukiridde era ng’emitima gyaffe gitereeziddwa n’okwagala kwo okutuukiridde.

Juuni 25

“Atuwanguzisa bulijjo mu Kristo Yesu” (2 Abakkolinso 2:14).

Buli awangula kimugwanira asooke okwewangula yekka. Naye engeri Yoswa gye yawangulamu kwali kuyimusa mukono gwa Musa ku Lusozi. Bwe yayimusanga emikono gye, Yoswa n’awangula, bwe yagissanga wansi, Amaleki n’awangula. Kyali lutalo lwa kukkiriza so si lwa maanyi ga muntu, ne bendera eyali eneewuubaawuuba ku mulabe eyawangulwa yali, “Yakuwa-nisi.” Kino nakyo kye kyama eky’okuwangula kwaffe okw’omwoyo. “Bwe tutambulira mu Mwoyo, tetulituukiriza kwegomba kwa mubiri.” “Temukkiriza kibi kwongera kubafuga, kubanga temukyafugibwa mateeka, wabula ekisa kya Katonda.”

Bwe tutyo twatandika olutalo ne mu maanyi ga Kristo tuteeka ebigere byaffe ku nsingo zaffe ffennyini, ne bwe tutyo nga tuwangudde omulabe mu kigo ky’omutima, twaddembezebwa okulwana olutalo lwa Mukama n’okuweereza abalala? Kwe kubulwako kuno kwaziyiza obulamu bwa Sawulo era kwazikiriza ebiseera bingi ebyali bisuubiza. Omulabe omu ali mu mutima wa maanyi okusinga omutwalo mu ttale. Mukama atuluŋŋamye ffenna mu kuwangula kwa Yoswa okusooka, era atulage ekyama eky’okwekomerera ku musaalaba ku bw’Oyo Yoswa Asingako, oyo yekka ayinza okutukulembera okutuusa ku butukuvu n’okuwangula!

Juuni 26

“Bwe yatunuulira ekibiina ky’abantu, n’abasaasira” (Matayo 9:36).

Asobola “okulumirwa awamu naffe mu bunafu bwaffe.” Ekigambo “okulumirwa” kitegeeza bingi. Kitegeeza nti ebizibu byaffe bizibu bye, era nti mu kubonaabona kwaffe kwonna naye abonaabona. Si kusaasira kwa nneewulira, wabula kusaasira kwa kubonaabona.

Mu kino mulimu obuyambi bungi eri omutima omukoowu. Gwe musingi gwa Bwakabona bwe, era Katonda yayagala bube nsulo ey’okusanyusibwa okutakoma gye tuli. Ka tutegeere obulungi obumu bwaffe ne Kabona waffe Asinga Obukulu, era tusuule emigugu gyaffe gyonna ku mutima gwe omunene ogw’okwagala. Bwe tuba tumanyi ekitegeeza okuluma mu buli musuwa olw’obulumi obumu n’obw’omwana waffe abonaabona, tuyinza okutegeerako engeri ennaku zaffe gye zikwatamu omutima gwe, ne zikanyuga omubiri gwe ogugulumizibwa. Ng’omuzadde bw’awulira obulumi bw’omwana we omuto, ng’omutima gw’omukwano bwe guddamu buli kaboozi akava mu nnaku y’omulala, bwe kityo mu ggulu, Omulokozi waffe agulumizibwa, ne mu ssanyu ery’ensi eyo ey’omukwano, abonaabona mu mwoyo gwe era ne mu mubiri gwe wamu ne byonna abaana be bye babonaabona. “Kale bwe tuba tulina Kabona Asinga Obukulu bw’atyo, ka tusembererenga entebe ya Katonda ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa n’obuvumu,” era ka tujje eri Kabona waffe Asinga Obukulu.

Juuni 27

“Omwoyo ajjulenga mu bulamu bwammwe” (Abaefeso 5:18).

Ebimu ku bivaamu olw’okujjuzibwa Omwoyo bye bino:

1. Obutukuvu obw’omutima n’obulamu. Buno si kutuukirira kwa buzaaliranwa bwa muntu, wabula bwe butukuvu bw’obuzaaliranwa obw’obwakatonda obubeera munda.

2. Okujjula essanyu ne kiba nti omutima gumasamasa bulijjo. Kino tekyesigamye ku mbeera z’omuntu mw’ali, wabula kijjuza omwoyo enseko entukuvu wakati mu mbeera ezisinga okuzibuwala.

3. Okujjula amagezi, ekitangaala n’okumanya, ekituleetera okulaba ebintu nga ye bw’abiraba.

4. Okugulumizibwa, okulongoosebwa n’okuzzibwamu obulamu kw’ebirowoozo olw’obuyinza okufuna okutuukirira kw’ekisuubizo nti, “Tulina endowooza ya Kristo.”

5. Okuzzibwamu obulamu okwenkanankana okw’obulamu obw’omubiri. Omubiri gwakolebwa ku lwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu, nga bwe kiri ku birowoozo n’emmeeme.

6. Obuyinza okusaba okusaba kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Bw’aba mu ffe walibaawo okukwatagana okw’ekyewuunyo n’omulimu gwa Katonda mu nsi etwetoolodde. Waliwo okukwatagana okw’obwakatonda wakati w’Omwoyo n’obulabirizi bwa Katonda.

Juuni 28

“Nga yeesigamye muganzi we” (Oluyimba 8:5).

Onookifuula ekintu eky’okukola ddala era eky’amazima n’oyeesigama nga Yokaana n’obuzito bwo bwonna ku kifuba kya Mukama? Eyo y’engeri gy’ayagala tukakaseemu okwagala kwaffe. “Bw’onjagala nyweera ku nze,” omukazi atamanyi Katonda bwe yagamba omuminsani we, bwe yali yeesigamya n’entiisa omubiri gwe omukoowu ku kifuba kye eky’amaanyi. Yawulira ng’anyoomeddwa olw’okwekuuma kw’entiisa, n’asaba obwesige obwandissizza obuzito bwabwo bwonna ku oyo gwe yeesiga. Era atugamba nti, “Mumutwalirenga byonna bye mweraliikirira kubanga abalumirwa era afaayo ku buli ekibatuukako.” Ayagala tukakaseemu okwagala kwaffe n’obwesige obutuukiridde obutalina kwekuuma. Asobola okusitula obweraliikirivu bwaffe bwonna, okulabirira ebitufaako byonna, n’okumalirira byonna bye twetaaga. Ka tugende nga tweesigamye ku kifuba kye era nga tulya ku bulamu bwe. Kubanga Yokaana teyeesigama kyokka naye era yalya. Yeesigamira ku kijjulo. Kino kye kyama eky’okulya ku ye, kwe kuwummulira ku kifuba kye. Kuno kwe kwetaaga kw’omutima gw’omuntu ogwokerera. Ka tumukaabirire nti, “Ntegeeza ggwe gwe njagala, gy’oliisiza ekisibo kyo, ne gy’owumuliza endiga zo mu ssaawa ez’omu ttuntu.”

Juuni 29

“Abeera nammwe, era anaabeeranga mu mmwe” (Yokaana 14:17).

Tolemwanga kwetegereza mitendera gino ebiri mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo. Ogumu gwe mulimu gw’Omwoyo mu ffe, ogundi kwe kujja kw’Omwoyo yennyini okubeera munda mu ffe. Abakristaayo ab’amazima bonna bamanyi ogusooka, naye batono, nga kya kutya, abategeera era abakkiriza ogwokubiri. Waliwo enjawulo nnene wakati w’okuzimba ennyumba n’okugenda okubeera mu nnyumba eyo ne ngifuula awaka wange. Era waliwo enjawulo nnene wakati w’omulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu ogw’okuzaalibwa obuggya kw’emmeeme—okuzimba ennyumba, n’okujja kwe okubeera, okusigala n’okufuga mu mwoyo gwaffe ogw’omunda ennyo ne mu bulamu bwaffe bwonna n’obubeerera bwaffe.

Twamusembeza ye yennyini si nga Omugenyi waffe, wabula nga Nnannyini, Nnyini bintu era Omukuumi wa yeekaalu gy’azimbye okuba “ekifo Omwoyo wa Katonda mw’abeera”?

Luno lwe lugero lwange olw’ekitalo, Kristo azze mu mutima gwange, Yesu Kabaka w’ekitiibwa, Asanga awaka mu mutima gwange. Nsanyuse nnyo kubanga namusembeza, Yesu, Kabaka w’omutima gwange omwagalwa, Nze, eyamunakuwaza emirundi mingi, Byonna nnandibireese ku bigere bye.

Juuni 30

“Kale nno londawo” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 30:19).

Abantu balonda buli lunaku eby’omwoyo oba eby’ensi. Era nga bwe tulonda, tuteeka ekifo kyaffe awatali kumanya n’emikwano gya Kristo, oba n’ensi. Si kye twogera kyokka, kye tusinga okwagala.
