Ettaka lyetaaga okutegekebwa, okwabikibwa okuyita mu kulima, okugonzebwa okuyita mu kuwera, amayinja gonna okuggyibwamu, emirandira gy’ebimera byonna ebya bulijjo okusimbulwa, kubanga ebintu ebirungi bye tunoonya si bimera bya bulijjo era tebijja kumerera mu ttaka lyaffe. Ffenna tutandikira ku musingi omukadde ne tugezaako okulongoosa obuzaaliranwa obukadde, naye ekyo si ke kkubo lya Katonda. Ekkubo lye kwe kuggyawo ffe ku nkomerero ddala, n’aleka ye okutonda obuggya okuva mu bwereere, buli kimu kiryoke kibe ekya Katonda; era tuteekwa okuzuula Yesu nga ye Alufa ne Omeega. Ekintu ky’oyagala okuyiga wano kwe kufa. Tewali bulamu bwa nnamaddala okutuusa ng’omuntu waffe afudde, era togezaako kwetta ggwe wennyini, wabula saba Katonda akutte, era ajja kukikola omulimu ogutuukiridde. Kino obutonde bwe bukisa mu kyama, Ekyeya kifa ate ne kizuukira, Ekiseera eky’okumera kiva mu ntaana ey’obunnyogovu, Amakungula gava mu mpeke eziziikiddwa.Julaayi 6 “Ndi wa muganzi wange” (Oluyimba 7:10). Bw’oba oyagala amaanyi, oteekwa okunyigiriza. Kwe kuggalira omukka gwe guyisa yingini. Obungi bw’olufuufu obuli ku lukalu obutereevu, obuweereza omupiira mu kifo we gulaga, bwe buggalirwa mu mmundu, ku lukalu bwokka bumyansa. Bw’oba oyagala okutwala amasannyalaze, oteekwa okwawulibwa. Yimiriza omuntu ku kifo ekya galaasi, omukuluze baatule, ajja kujjula amasannyalaze. Muleke ave ku galaasi, era mu kaseera k’akwata ku ttaka, afiirwa amaanyi. Tuteekwa okusibirwa mu ndagaano ye ey’emirembe n’emirembe. Eyo y’etunywezaako n’etukuuma tuleme okugwa. Ajja kuba bbugwe ow’omuliro okutwetooloola. Ajja yekka n’atwetooloola n’ekitiibwa ekya Shekina ekya edda, era ajja kuba kitiibwa wakati mu ffe. Ayagala tusibibwe—nga kino kikolwa kya njawulo eky’okwewaayo nga tumuweereddwayo ffenna ddala. Osibiddwa mu bikomera bye, mu mateeka ge, mu bisuubizo bye, mu ndagaano ye? Omutima gwo mazima era gwa Mukama yekka? Bw’oba nga si bw’oli, jjangu gy’ali kaakano, omuleke akwawule ku bintu byonna ebikutwalako obulamu bwo, era akwawulire gy’ali yekka, Omuwi w’obulamu. Julaayi 7 “N’ekitiibwa kya Mukama ne kijijjula” (Okuva 40:35). Mu ssuula esembayo eya Okuva tusoma byonna Mukama bye yalagira Musa okukola, era nti bwe yatuukiriza ebiragiro bino ekitiibwa kya Mukama ne kikka ne kijjuza Eweema okutuusa nga tewakyali kifo kya Musa, era okuva mu kiseera ekyo empagi ey’ekire n’ebibikka, ye muluŋŋamya waabwe, ye kukuuma kwabwe. Bwe tutyo tubadde tuzimba nga Mukama yennyini bwe yalagira, era kaakano yeekaalu eteekwa okuweebwayo gy’ali okugirya n’okugijjuza. Ajja kukujjuza bw’otyo, bw’onoomuganya, nti ggwe wennyini na buli kintu ekirala biryoke biggyibwewo, ekitiibwa kya Mukama ne kijjuza yeekaalu, nga kyetooloola, nga kisitula waggulu, nga kiluŋŋamya, nga kikuuma; era okuva mu kiseera kino omwezi gwo teguliggyawo kitangaala kyagwo, n’enjuba yo teegwa. Oyagala amaanyi? Olina Katonda ku ekyo. Oyagala obutukuvu? Olina Katonda ku ekyo; era bwe kityo ku buli kintu. Era Katonda akutamira okuva ku ntebe ye ey’obwakabaka leero akusitule akuteeke mu kifo kyo ekituufu mu ye. Okuva mu kiseera kino, ekire ery’ekitiibwa kye kitwetooloole era kitujjuze bwe kityo nga tulyoka tetukyalabika emirembe gyonna. Julaayi 8 “Abaatandikira mu Mwoyo, kaakano mutuukirizibwa mu mubiri” (Abaggalatiya 3:3). Ekisa mu bwakyo kitegeeza ekyo kye tutalina kuweebwa lwa mulimu gwaffe. Kirina amakulu abiri amakulu bulijjo; kijja bwereere era kijja nga tetuliiko kye tusobola; tekiyamba busa muntu eyeeyamba yekka—eyo si Njiri; Enjiri eri nti Katonda ayamba omuntu atasobola kweyamba. Ate era waliwo n’ekintu ekirala; Katonda ayamba omuntu okwesobozesa okweyamba, kubanga buli kintu omuntu ky’akola kiva eri Katonda. Ekisa kiweebwa omuntu anafuye era atalina maanyi ennyo n’okutuula nga tasobola kutambula kigere kisooka. Ago ge makulu g’ekisa—akatundu ako ku makulu gaakyo; tetuyinza kutegeera bujjuvu bwe kirina. Kaakano, omugga guno gwa buwa nga bwe gujjudde, naye omanyi abantu abamu balina endowooza nti bwe batambulako katono baba bateekwa okusasula omusolo gw’okuyingira, era entebe eziterekeddwa za bbeeyi nnyo, ne baddirira ne bava ku mikisa emikulu egy’Enjiri; Abakristaayo aba bulijjo tebaguma na kugyetwalira. Bwe ntegeera amakulu ga kino, Katonda taateekawo mikisa emikulu ku bbali eri ekika ekyawuddwa eky’abo abali ng’abasinga okumpi naye. Katonda tasosola mu bantu. Julaayi 9 “Ebizibu byo byonna bireete eri Mukama” (Zabbuli 55:22). Mikwano gyange abaagalwa, oluusi tuleeta omugugu eri Katonda, ne tugusinda nnyo, era tuba ng’abalowooza nti ne Katonda gumuteganya nnyo, naye mu butuufu tegumuzitoowerera n’akatono. Katonda agamba nti: Kyangu gye ndi okukukolera kino. Omugugu gwo, wadde nga gukuzitoowerera, gye ali si muzito. Kristo agutwala gwonna ku kibegabega kimu, si ku bibegabega bibiri. Obufuzi bw’ensi buli ku kibegabega kye. Takaluubirirwa so tagusinda. Omukono gwe ogw’amaanyi gusobola okwetikka emigugu gyo gyonna. Waliwo amaanyi mu Kristo ag’okutukuzibwa kwaffe. Asobola okukutukuza. Weewaawo, weewaawo, Mukama asobola okutukuza, Mukama asobola okuwonya, Mukama asobola okukola buli kimu. Oteekwa okuba n’okukkiriza mu Katonda. Bw’ojja ku mugga guno ku makya gano, gujja kukutwala nga Niagara yo bw’anditutte akaato akatono, ne gukuserengesa—okukutuusa ku bbanga? Nedda, wabula ku kifuba eky’okwagala n’omukisa emirembe gyonna. Emirundi mingi wajja obubaka obw’ekitalo, Essuubi lyange bwe liba lizikira, Nsobola okubuwulira nga buyita mu kizikiza Ng’oluyimba oluwoomerevu olw’ewala. Tewali kizibu eri Yesu, Tewali muntu ayinza kukola nga ye.Julaayi 10 “Tulyoke tumanye ebintu Katonda bye yatuwa obuwa” (1 Abakkolinso 2:12). Emikisa emikulu ennyo egy’Enjiri gya buwa nga bwe gityo n’egisembayo wansi; era bw’oba omaze okumuweereza emyaka kkumi, toyinza kutuula n’ogamba nti, “Kaakano nfunye obumanyirivu era ku obwo kwe nneesigamya.” Nga bwe tukikola emirundi mingi; tugamba nti, “Kaakano mmanyi nti ndokoledde, nkiwulira.” Bwe tutyo tuba tuzimba omusingi ogw’enjawulo—tuzimba ku kintu ekiri mu ffe. Bulijjo twekkirize ekisa nga kintu ky’otosaanira, ekintu ekiweebwa obuwa. Omugga omuwanvu, omuziba, ogutaliiko kkomo guli gwa buwa; guli gwa buwa ku kamwa nga bwe guli gwa buwa mu kagga akatono, era guli gwa buwa mu lugendo lwagwo lwonna, era buli muntu ayinza okujja n’okunywa, na buli muntu ayinza okujja n’okunaaba mu mazzi gaagwo agatabalika. Ojja kukikkiriza? Katonda atuwadde Omwoyo we Omutukuvu tulyoke “tumanye ebintu Katonda bye yatuwa obuwa.” Kizibu nnyo eri omwana omwavu okulingiza mu ddirisa n’alaba omuliro, n’ab’omu maka abasanyufu nga batudde okwetooloola emmeeza, so nga ye ali mu njala. Kirungi ki okumanya nti waliwo ebbugumu, n’okwagala, n’ekitangaala, singa tebiri bya buwa? Katonda awadde obuwa obulungi bwonna obw’ekisa kye n’okwagala kwe. Julaayi 11 “Kubanga Katonda yakolera mu mmwe” (Abafiripi 2:13). Olunaku wamu ne Yesu. Ka tunoonye enteekateeka yaalwo n’obulagirizi okuva gy’ali. Ka tutwale ekirowoozo kye ekisingayo n’okwagala kwe gye tuli mu lwo. Ka tumutunuulire olw’okwegomba kwaffe, n’ebye tusuubira, n’ebye twesunga mu lwo. Kale lulituleetera ebisukkiridde okusukka byonna bye tuyinza okusaba oba okulowooza. Ka abeere Omulagirizi waffe n’Ekkubo lyaffe. Ka tuleme okwewaza mu kulowooza ku nteekateeka ye n’ekkubo lye okusinga okulowooza ku ye nga Omulagirizi ayo w’obuli kaseera, gwe twesigama bulijjo okutuluŋŋamya buli kigere kyaffe. Ka abeere era okumala n’amaanyi mu lunaku lwonna. Ka tuleme okwerabira ekyama kino: “Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi.” Ka tubeere ne Yesu Kristo yennyini mu ffe akole emirimu, era buli kaseera ka twesigame ku ye, alyoke atwagazise era atusobozese okukola by’ayagala olw’okumusanyusa. Obutukuvu bwaffe ka bubeere “etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo Yesu.” Obulamu bwaffe obw’omubiri ka bubeere “obulamu bwa Yesu bulabisibwe mu mibiri gyaffe.” Okukkiriza kwaffe ka kubeere “okukkiriza Omwana wa Katonda eyanjagala.” Emirembe gyaffe n’essanyu lyaffe ka bibeere emirembe gye n’essanyu lye. Era okuweereza kwaffe kaleme kubeera mirimu gyaffe, wabula ekisa kya Kristo ekiri mu ffe. Julaayi 12 “Buli kye munaasabanga, mukkirize nti mukiweereddwa” (Makko 11:24). Okwewaayo tukuyingira nga tuyita mu kikolwa ky’okukkiriza. Oteekwa okutwala ekirabo okuva eri Katonda, okukkiriza nti okifunye, n’okwatula nti okirina. Kikwatire ddala, era leka Setaani amanye nti okirina nga Mukama bw’akimanyi. Bw’omala okumugamba n’obuvumu nti, “Ndi wuwo,” addamu ng’asinziira mu ggulu waggulu nti, “Oli wange,” n’amaloboozi ne gavuumira mu bulamu bwo bwonna nga googera nti, “Wange! Wuwo!” Bw’oba oguma okwatula Kristo ng’Omulokozi wo n’Omutukuza wo, yeesibye yekka okukifuula ekituufu, naye oteekwa okuyimirira emabega w’Ekigambo kye eky’amaanyi. Kino kye kitundu ekikulu eky’obujulirwa: okwogera ku ekyo Yesu ky’akusuubizza okukufuukira. Kituufu okuba n’ebigambo eby’ekitiibwa eby’okwebaza, naye ebyo si bwe bujulirwa ddala. Katonda ayagala tuteeke akabonero kaffe ku bisuubizo, ne tuyimusa emikono gyaffe ne twatula nga byaffe. Kale oteekwa okutassaayo mwoyo ku bulamu obukadde n’okububala nga tebukyali bubwo bwe bulyeyongera okuvaayo. Buli lwe bulabika gamba nti, “Buno buva mu nsi ey’emmanga. Nze ntudde mu bifo eby’omu ggulu wamu ne Kristo.” Julaayi 13 “Ne Kristo teyeesanyusa yekka” (Abaruumi 15:3). Luno ka lubeere lunaku lwa kuweereza okwerabira nga tukolera Kristo n’abalala. Ka tuleme n’okulowooza ku kuweerezebwa, wabula ka tugambe naye bulijjo nti: “Ndi wano mu mmwe nga oyo aweereza.” Ka tuleme okuwalula emigugu gyaffe okuyita mu lunaku, wabula ka tusuule emigugu gyaffe gyonna egy’okweraliikirira tulyoke tube ba ddembe okwetikka ekikoligo kye n’omugugu gwe. Ka tukole enkyusaganya ey’essanyu, nga tuwaayo egyaffe ne tutwala egiye. Endagaano ka ebeere: “Onoobeeranga ku lwange, nange nnaabeeranga ku lwiyo.” Bwe tutyo tulifiirwa omugugu gwaffe ogusinga obuzito—ffe fennyini—era bwe tutyo tulifuna essanyu lyaffe erisingayo, okwagala kwa Katonda, nga “okugaba” kwa mukisa okusinga “okuweebwa.” Ka tukolere abantu bonna obulungi nga bwe tufuna omukisa. Tuleme okufiirwa mukisa gwonna ogw’okuwa omukisa, era ka twekenneenye engeri ez’amagezi ez’okuweereza n’okugasa. Naddala ka tunoonye okuwangula emmeeme. Ennaku ez’Eggulu nnaku za mulimu, Ziweereza obutayosa, Bwe zityo ka ziweebweyo ku lulwo ne ku bibyo, ennaku zaffe, Nga Ennaku ez’Eggulu bwe zaliba. Ennaku ez’Eggulu nnaku z’okwagala, Nga zonna bwe zikkiriziganya, Bwe zityo nga zisibiddwa mu bumu obw’okwagala Ka ennaku zaffe zibeere ng’Eggulu.Julaayi 14 “Abantu bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba” (Lukka 18:1). Luno ka lubeere lunaku lwa kusaba. Ka tutegeere nti obuweereza bwaffe obusingayo n’amaanyi gaffe kwe kwogeza Katonda ku lw’abantu. Ka tugondere amaloboozi gonna ag’okusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu g’ateeka mu ffe. Ka tubale buli kunyigirizibwa ng’okuyitibwa okusaba. Ka twagale omwoyo ogw’okusaba obutakoowa n’okussa ekimu okutaggwaawo. Ka tuyige amakulu g’obuweereza obw’okusaba. Ka tutuuke ku bantu leero be tutasobola kutuukako mu mubiri; ka twesunge ebivaamu bye tutayagalanga kwetwalira edda; ka tubale buli kizibu ng’akakisa akasingako obunene ak’okusaba, era ka tukoowoole Katonda, anaatulaga ebintu bingi ebikulu era eby’amaanyi bye tutamanyi. Era ka lubeere lunaku lwa ssanyu na kutendereza. Ka tubeere mu bisuubizo bya Katonda n’okusuubira okununulibwa kwe n’omukisa gwe. Ka tuleme okulowoolereza ku kugezesebwa, wabula bulijjo ku buwanguzi obuli mu maaso. Ka tuleme okubeera mu ntaana, wabula mu nnimiro ya Yusufu ne mu kitangaala eky’okuzuukira. Ka tukuume amaaso gaffe nga gatunuulira enjuba ng’evaayo. Yimuka, oyake. Musanyukenga ennaku zonna. Mwebazenga olwa buli kintu kyonna. Mutendereze Mukama. Mukama, tuwe essanyu lyo mu mitima gyaffe eritulisitula okusitula abalala, era otujjuze tulyoke tukulukutire abalala. Julaayi 15 “Muganzi wange, wange, nange ndi wuwe” (Oluyimba 6:3). Bwe mba nga ndi wa Mukama, kale Mukama wange. Kristo bw’ampeza nange mmupeza. Kale okukkiriza kuteekwa okugolola omukono ne kwetwalira omugabo gwakwo omujjuvu ne kutandika okukozesa eby’obugagga byakwo ebinene. Buli kaseera kaakano tuyinza okumutwala ng’ekisa kyaffe n’amaanyi gaffe, okukkiriza kwaffe n’okwagala kwaffe, obuwanguzi bwaffe n’essanyu lyaffe, byonna mu byonna. Era nga bwe tumwetwalira bwe tutyo tulisanga ekisa kye nga kitumala, ne tutandika okuyiga nti okugaba byonna kwe kuweebwa byonna. Weewaawo, okwewaayo kwe kumufuna mu bujjuvu mu kifo ky’obulamu bwaffe obwo obw’ennaku. Mazima ddala kulina embiriizi bbiri. Mu kwewaayo mulimu abantu babiri. Omu ku bo ye Mukama waffe omwagalwa yennyini. “Era ku lwabwe,” bw’agamba, “neetukuza, nabo balyoke batukuzibwe mu mazima.” Amangu ddala nga bwe twewaayo gy’ali, naye yeewaayo gye tuli, era okuva olwo, amaanyi gonna ag’obulamu bwe n’okwagala kwe n’obuyinza obutaggwaawo gawonge okukuuma n’okutuukiriza okwewaayo kwaffe, n’okufuna ekisinga obulungi n’ekisinga obungi mu bulamu bwaffe obwewaddeyo. Ani atandyewaayo eri Omulokozi afaanana bw’atyo? Mazima ddala tunaakikola leero, okusooka twewe ffe, n’oluvannyuma tumuwe buli kaseera nga bwe kajja, tulyoke tujjuzibwe era tukozesebwe. Julaayi 16 “Ng’empeewo bw’ewejjawejja olw’amazzi, n’emmeeme yange bw’etyo bwe wejjawejja ku lulwo, Ayi Katonda” (Zabbuli 42:1). Okusooka, okutuuka ku bulamu obwewaddeyo wateekwa okubaawo okuwulira obwetaavu, obwetaavu obw’obulongoofu, obw’amaanyi, n’obw’okusemberera Mukama okusingako. Emirundi mingi mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo wajja okulumirizibwa okw’okubiri. Kaakano si kuwulira musango na busungu bwa Katonda nnyo, wabula amaanyi n’obubi obw’ekibi eky’omunda, n’obutamatiza obw’obulamu emmeeme bw’etambulamu. Bulijjo kuva mu kubikkulirwa okw’ebuziba okw’amazima ga Katonda, mu kuyigirizibwa okw’omwoyo okusingako, mu byokulabirako n’obujulirwa obw’obulamu buno mu balala, era emirundi mingi kuva mu kufuna okugezesebwa okunene, n’okulwana, n’okukemebwa, omwo emmeeme mw’esanze ebyo bye yatuuka ku n’eby’obugagga byayo nga tebimala ku nsonga entuufu n’obwetaavu obw’obulamu. Ekivaamu ekisooka bulijjo kwe kuggwaamu amaanyi okunene n’okutyoboola essuubi, naye ekiwonvu kya Akoli lwe luggi olw’essuubi, era essuula ey’omusanvu eya Abaruumi n’okukaaba kwayo okukaawa nti, “Nga ndi muntu munaku!” ye mulyango ogutuusa ku ey’omunaana n’okuleekaana kwayo okw’obuwanguzi nti, “Etteeka ery’Omwoyo aleeta obulamu mu Kristo Yesu lyannunula okuva mu tteeka ly’ekibi n’okufa.” Julaayi 17 “Kubanga olw’ekiweebwayo ekyo ekimu, abaatukuzibwa yabawa obutuukirivu obw’emirembe gyonna” (Abaebbulaniya 10:14). Obulako ebyo ebibyo? Yakusuubiza okukutukuza. Yakusuubiza okutukuzibwa nga ye yennyini ajja gy’oli era ng’afuulibwa Katonda okutukuzibwa kwo. Yesu ye kutukuzibwa kwange. Bwe mba naye nnina obuwulize, n’okuwummula, n’obugumiikiriza, na buli kye nneetaaga. Mulamu emirembe gyonna. Bw’oba naye tewali kiyinza kukulwanyisa. Okukemebwa kwo tekulikulwanyisa; obusungu bwo obubi tebulikulwanyisa; obulamu bwo obuzibu, embeera zo, ne Setaani yennyini talikulwanyisa. Buli lw’ajja okukulumba, ajja kwongera kukusimba mu Kristo mu buziba. Ojja kufuuka omutiitiizi ng’olowooza ku kubeera bw’omu; ojja kusuulibwa ku Yesu buli kizibu lwe kikutuukako. Ebintu byonna okuva kaakano birikoleragana wamu okuleeta ebirungi eri emmeeme yo yennyini. Olwokuba Katonda ali ku ludda lwo, tewali kiyinza kukulwanyisa. Omugole wange ow’omu ggulu yannoonya n’ampita ku lunaku olumu olw’essanyu, “Golokoka, Owoomukwano, omulungi wange, ojje tugende,” Ne mpuliriza okwegayirira kwe, ne mmuwa omutima gwange gwonna, Era tuli bumu emirembe gyonna era tetuulyawukane emirembe gyonna.Julaayi 18 “Mwatuukirira mu ye” (Abakkolosaayi 2:10). Mu ye kaakano tuli batuukirivu. Ekifaananyi ekituukiridde eky’obulamu obw’okuweereza okutukuvu kye yatununulira n’atuyitira, kaakano kiri mu ye mu ggulu, nga bwe kiri n’ekifaananyi ky’omuzimbi ekiteekebwateekebwa ne kitegekebwa ne kituukirizibwa mu ofiisi ye. Naye kaakano kiteekwa okukolebwa mu ffe n’okuggyibwa mu bulamu bwaffe obw’oku nsi, era guno gwe mulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Atwala ebirabo n’ekisa kya Kristo n’abireeta mu bulamu bwaffe, nga bwe tubyetaaga era nga bwe tubifuna buli lunaku, nga bwe bityo ebitundu by’ekyombo bwe biddibwamu okukolebwa mu ssemazinga ali ewala, era bwe tutyo tuggya ku kujjula kwe, ekisa olw’ekisa, ekisa kye olw’ekisa kyaffe, okutuwa kwe olw’obwetaavu bwaffe, amaanyi ge olw’amaanyi gaffe, omubiri gwe olw’omubiri gwaffe, Omwoyo gwe olw’omwoyo gwaffe, era ye “eyafuuka amagezi gye tuli okuva eri Katonda, n’obutuukirivu, n’okutukuzibwa, n’okununulibwa.” Naye kino kisukka nnyo ku buyambi n’ekisa ebitalabika, kisukka n’okusinga Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutuleetera amaanyi, n’emirembe, n’obulongoofu. Kwe kubeera n’omukwano ogw’oku bwannaffe ne Yesu yennyini! Mukama, tuyambe okufuna okuva gy’oli leero, ekisa ekyo mu kugezesebwa kwonna ekitegeeza okutuukirira kwaffe mu ggwe. Julaayi 19 “Naye Dawudi n’awamba ekigo kya Sayuuni” (1 Ebyomumirembe 11:5). Bangi ku mmwe mulina okulwana okungi olw’ensonga nti temulina lutalo lumu olukakali era olw’amaanyi lwe mwandisoose. Kyangu nnyo okubeera n’olutalo lumu olukulu okusinga okusigala nga olwana obulwana obutono obulamu bwo bwonna. Mmanyi abasajja abamala emyaka amakumi ana nga balwanyisa kye bayita ekibi ekibeetooloola, era kwe bamalira amaanyi agandimaze okubuulira ensi yonna enjiri. Mikwano gyange abaagalwa, kigasa okusuula obulamu bwammwe? Mubeere n’olutalo lumu, obuwanguzi bumu, n’oluvannyuma mutendereze Katonda. Bwe batyo ne bawummula eri abalabe baabwe ababeetoolodde. Waliwo okutegana okuyingira. Okulinnya kuzibu nnyo. Ekkubo ery’omusaalaba si kkubo lyangu. Kizibu okuyingira, naye bw’omala okuyingira wabaawo okuwummula okutuukiridde. Katonda atuyambe atuwe okuwummula kwe okutuukiridde. Ojja oleke omuntu wo ow’ekibi emirembe gyonna Wansi w’oluzzi olw’omusaayi gw’Omulokozi; Ojja, omutwale ng’Omutukuza wo, Jjangu naffe tunaakukolera obulungi. Jjangu mu nsi abalabe bonna gye bawangulwa, N’ennaku, ekibi, endwadde n’okufa nga bimenyeddwa; Ggwe emmeeme ekooye! Setaani gy’abetenta n’agitabula, Jjangu naffe tunaakukolera obulungi.Julaayi 20 “Weerabire ab’ewammwe” (Zabbuli 45:10). Naffe, ng’Abaleevi ab’edda, tuteekwa “okwawulibwa eri Mukama, buli omu ku mutabani we ne ku muganda we,” era “okwerabira ab’ewaffe n’ab’omu nnyumba ya kitaffe” mu ngeri yonna gye bandiziyizizza eddembe lyaffe erijjuvu n’obuweereza bwaffe eri Mukama. Naffe tuteekwa okuleka emirimu gyaffe egy’ensi bwe giba giyimiridde wakati waffe ne Mukama, ne bwe kityo okuva kaakano gibeere mirimu gye era gigyo gyokka, egikolerwa ye, egifugibwa ye, n’amagoba gaagyo gonna gawongebwe gy’ali gyokka, era gakozesebwe nga bw’anaalagira. Era, nga Yakobo ne Yokaana, muteekwa okwagala okuleka ne “abapakasi” nabo. Kijja kukyusa nnyo engeri gy’obeeramu. Kijja kubeera enkyukakyuka okuleka okuwummula kwo n’obulamu obw’ebyengera, okuweerezebwa n’okusiimibwa mu buli kye weegomba, ojjire okwekolera omulimu gwo, okuleka okulabirirwa abalala, okugumira okwetaaga, n’ebizibu, n’okutoowazibwa, naye kijja kubeera kyangu okukikola ng’oli naye. Teyalina na katundu k’ettaka. Teyatambulira mu ggaali. Teyalina mupakasi gwe yapangisa. Ku nkomerero yagalamira mu ntaana eyeeyazikibwa. Naye kaakano mugagga nnyo, era naawe oliba bw’otyo olunaku olumu bw’onooyagala okubonaabona n’okulindirira. Julaayi 21 “Otunule ng’osinziira mu kifo mw’oli” (Olubereberye 13:14). Kaakano ka tulabe omukisa ogw’okukkiriza. Obutono bwaffe n’obutabaawo bwaffe emirundi egimu buleeta obuddu. Tuli batono nnyo mu maaso gaffe ne tutaganya kwetwalira bisuubizo bya Katonda eby’amaanyi. Tugamba nti: “Singa mbadde nkakasa nti ndi mu kkubo lya Katonda, nandisobodde okwesiga.” Kino kyonna si kituufu. Okwerowoozaako kwe kiziyiza ekinene eri okukkiriza. Ssa amaaso go ku ye, ku ye yekka; si ku kukkiriza kwo, wabula ku Mutandisi w’okukkiriza kwo; si okutunuulira okw’ekitundu, wabula okutunula okunywevu okuwangaazi, n’omutima omwesimbu n’ekigendererwa ekitanyeenyezebwa, ekitamanyi kusagaasagana, wadde okukubaganya n’omulabe awatali kabuubuutu k’okutya. Bw’otandika okutya, oba wa kumpi ddala okulemererwa. Abatambuze abaasomoka Alps bamanyi engeri ebifo eby’oku nsozi ezo bwe biri eby’akabi, engeri ekigere gye kirinnyirira bwe kiri ekitono, obuwanvu bw’ebiwonvu eby’enjazi n’engeri kye kyetaagisa olw’obukuumi nti oteekwa okutunula waggulu obutakoowa; okutunula omulundi gumu wansi mu buziba obuzunguza kyandireese okufa; era bwe tutyo bwe twagala okuwangula obugulumivu obw’okukkiriza tuteekwa okutunula waggulu—okutunula waggulu. Ggya amaaso go ku ggwe wennyini, ku mbeera ezikwetoolodde, ku by’oyinza okukozesa, ku birabo, obisse ku Muwi Omukulu. Julaayi 22 “Oba buweereza, mu buweereza” (Abaruumi 12:7). Abaagalwa, muweereza Kristo? Mukikola n’emikono gyammwe? Mukikola n’ebyobugagga byammwe ne bye mulina? Afuna ekisinga obulungi ku ebyo ebisinga okuba eby’amazima gye muli? Alina ekifo ku mmeeza yammwe? Era bw’atajja kutuula ku ntebe, eba ya bwereere eri omubaka we, abaana be abaavu era abawombeefu? Ebigambo byammwe n’okwegomba kwammwe tebiriimu makulu bwe bitalabika mu birabo byammwe eby’amazima. Ne Malyamu teyamumalako na bubaane bwa mutima gwe bwokka, wabula yateeka ebirabo bye eby’omuwendo omungi ennyo ku bigere bye. Mmwe abakazi abakola ennyo, abateganira okwambaza abaana bammwe n’okuwanika ennyumba n’emmeeza zammwe, emikono gyammwe gikoledde ki Mukama waffe, mukoze ki oba muwaddeyo ki ku lwa Yesu? “Osobola okukyeyimirira?” bwe kityo omukazi omukungu bwe yabuuzibwa, bwe yasuubiza ekiweebwayo eky’omuwendo omungi ku lw’omulimu gwa Mukama waffe. “Nedda,” bwe yaddamu n’ekitiibwa, “naye nsobola okukiwaayo nga ssaddaaka.” Ka tutunuulire okutwetooloola leero tulabe, kye tukola era tuwaayo ekisingako eri Omulokozi omwagalwa, eyawaayo obulamu bwe bwonna ku lwaffe. Julaayi 23 “Mubindetere wano” (Matayo 14:18). Lwaki temunnaweebwa bujjuvu bwonna obw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu? Era tuyinza tutya okufukibwako “amafuta agaasigadde?” Ekisinga okwetaagisa kwe kubaawo ekifo Katonda bw’akikola. Tunula weetooloole embeera yo. Toli weetooloddwa ebyetaago mu kaseera kano kennyini, era ng’oyitiriddwa ebizibu, ebigezo n’ebikakabala? Bino byonna bibya Katonda by’awadde okujjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era singa obitegeera obulungi amakulu gaabyo, byandifuuse emikisa egy’okufuna emikisa emipya n’okununulibwa, by’otoyinza kufuna mu ngeri ndala yonna. Leeta ebibya bino eri Katonda. Bikwatirire nga tebinyeenya mu maaso ge mu kukkiriza ne mu kusaba. Sirika, oleke okukola kwo okutakoowa okutuusa ye lw’anaatandika okukola. Tokola kintu kyonna ky’atakulagidde ku bubwe. Muwe akkisa okukola, era ddala ajja kukola, era ebigezo byennyini ebyakutiisa okukuwangula n’okukumalamu essuubi n’okukuleetera akabi, bijja kufuuka omukisa gwa Katonda okubikkulira ekisa kye n’ekitiibwa kye mu bulamu bwo, nga bw’otamumanyangako. “Mubindetere (byonna bye mwetaaga) wano.” Julaayi 24 “Eby’obutuukirivu mu mateeka biryoke bituukirire mu ffe” (Abaruumi 7:4). Mu kutandika kwaffe tumanya Omwoyo Omutukuvu nga tuli walako, mu bintu ebibaawo mu ngeri ey’obulabirizi bwa Katonda, oba mu Kigambo kyokka, naye oluvannyuma tumufuna ng’Omugenyi ali munda, era abeera wakati mu ffe ddala, era ayogera naffe mu bisenge eby’omunda ennyo eby’obulamu bwaffe. Naye olwo omulimu gw’amaanyi ge ogw’ebweru teguggwaawo, wabula gweyongera bwokka, era gulabika nga gugulumizibbwa n’okusingawo. Amaanyi agabeera munda mu ffe gakolera ebweru waffe, nga gaddamu okusaba, nga gawonya endwadde, nga gafuga obulabirizi, “nga gakola ebintu byonna okusinga byonna bye tusaba, ne bye tulowooza, ng’amaanyi ge bwe gali agakolera mu ffe.” Waliwo okubeerawo kwa Mukama okw’emirundi ebiri eri omukkiriza eyeewaddeyo. Abeerawo mu mutima, era abeerawo n’amaanyi mu bintu eby’obulamu. Ye Kristo ali mu ffe, Kristo ow’ennaku zonna, alina obuyinza bwonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi. Bw’atyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye mukozi waffe w’ebyamagero, Katonda waffe Amala byonna era Omukuumi waffe, era alindirira mu nnaku zino okukola n’amaanyi nga bwe yakola mu nnaku za Musa, eza Danyeri n’eza Pawulo. Julaayi 25 “Aweereza Kristo mu ebyo asanyusa nnyo Katonda” (Abaruumi 14:18). Katonda ayinza kutukozesa bwe tuba nga tuli batuufu. Setaani teyafaayo nnyo ku Peetero okwegaana Mukama we nga bwe yafaayo ku ky’akakozesa oluvannyuma okuzikiriza okukkiriza kwe. Yesu kyeyava amugamba nti: “Nkusabidde okukkiriza kwo kuleme kukuggwaamu.” Kwe kukkiriza kwa Peetero kwe yalumba, era bwe kityo kwe kukkiriza kwaffe Setaani kw’awakanya. “Okugezesebwa kw’okukkiriza kwaffe kwa muwendo mungi nnyo okusinga zaabu eguggwaawo.” Buli kirala kye tuleka, ka tunywerere ku bwesige bwaffe. “Kale munywererenga ku buvumu bwammwe,” era “tunywere ne twenyumiririza mu ssuubi lye tunywezezza okutuusa ku nkomerero.” Era bw’oyagala okunywerera ku bwesige bwo, nywerera ku buwoomu bwo, ku bwesimbu bw’omwoyo gwo, ku kugondera Kristo, ku buwanguzi bwo mu buli ngeri. Kyonna kye kijja, kitwale ng’ekitali kya makulu nnyo okusinga ggwe okuwangula n’okunywera, era ng’okkiriza buli mbeera Katonda gy’asiima okuleka ereetebwe, wuuba ebbendera ey’obuwanguzi bwo mu maaso ga buli mulabe, weeyongereyo, ng’oleekaanira mu linnya lye nti, “Katonda yeebazibwe atuwanguzisa bulijjo mu Kristo Yesu.” Julaayi 26 “Kaakano amaaso gange gakulabye” (Yobu 42:5). Tuteekwa okutegeera engeri ddala ey’obulamu bwaffe obw’okwefaako n’obukambwe bwabwo obw’amazima n’obugwenyufu bwabwo. Tuteekwa okukkiriza obuzikirizibwa bwabwo, era tuteekwa okwetwalira bwe ffe, nga Ibulayimu bwe yakola Isaaka, ne tubuteeka ku bigere bya Katonda nga ssaddaaka ey’okweyagalira. Guno mulimu muzibu eri omutima ogw’obuzaaliranwa, naye amangu ddala okwagala bwe kuweereddwayo n’okulonda bwe kukoleddwa, okufa okwo kuba kuweddeyo, obulumi buba buggwaawo, ne tweewuunya okusanga nti okufa kutuukiriziddwa. Emirundi mingi akaseera ak’okusalirawo mu bulamu mu mbeera ng’ezo kasinziira ku nsonga emu yokka. Katonda tayeetaaga kutukuba mu bifo kikumi asobole okutuleeta ekiwundu eky’okufa. Waliwo ensonga emu ekwata ku mutima, era y’ensonga Katonda gy’akuba bulijjo, ekintu ekitusinga okwagala mu bulamu bwaffe, ekintu ekisalirawo mu nteekateeka zaffe, ekigo eky’okwagala, wakati mu mutima, era bwe tuwaayo eyo, waba tewasigadde kya kuwaayo waliwo wonna, ate bwe tugaana okuwaayo ku nsonga eno, omwoyo ogw’okwewala n’okwekomako guyingira mu bulamu bwaffe obulala bwonna. Mukama, tukutwala olyoke otusobozese okwagala nti okwagala kwo kukolebwe mu bintu byonna mu bulamu bwaffe eby’ebweru n’eby’omunda. Julaayi 27 “Okuzimba omubiri gwa Kristo” (Enkyusa Empya, Abaefeso 4:13). Katonda ategeka abazira be, era omukisa bwe gujja asobola okubateeka mu kifo kyabwe mu kaseera buseera, era ensi eneewuunya gye baava. Leka Omwoyo Omutukuvu akutegeke, munnange omwagalwa, ng’ayita mu kutendekebwa kwonna okw’obulamu; era ekifaananyi eky’ejjinja bwe kimala okuweebwa okulongoosebwa okusembayo, kijja kubeera kyangu eri Katonda okukiteeka ku ntobo, n’akituula mu kifo kyakyo. Waliwo olunaku olujja, nga, nga Osunieri, naffe, tulisalira amawanga emisango, ne tufuga ne tulya obwakabaka ne Kristo ku nsi ey’emyaka olukumi; naye nga olunaku olwo olw’ekitiibwa terunnatuuka, tuteekwa okuleka Katonda atutegeke nga bwe yategeka Osunieri e Kiriasuseferi, wakati mu bigezo eby’obulamu bwaffe obwa kaakano, ne mu buwanguzi obutono, obw’amakulu gaabwo, oboolwo, kye tutamanyaako. Kkasita, ka tukakase kino, nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’aba ategese Osunieri, Mukama w’eggulu n’ensi aba amutegekedde entebe ey’obwakabaka. Nze nsobola okukozesebwa ekisa kye, Nga nnyamba okuleeta obwakabaka bwe, Nze nsobola okusikira ekifo, Ne ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka bwa Kabaka wange?Julaayi 28 “Si nga Nze bwe njagala, wabula ky’oyagala” (Lukka 22:42). Oyo eyabonaabona edda mu Gesusemane ajja kubeera amaanyi gaffe n’obuwanguzi bwaffe naffe. Tuyinza okutya, tuyinza n’okubbira, naye tuleme kutekemuka, era tuliba tukyamutendereza, ne tutunula emabega nga tumaze olugendo, ne twogera nti, “Tewali kigambo na kimu ekitatuukiridde ku ebyo ebirungi bye yasuubiza.” Naye okusobola okukola kino, tuteekwa, nga ye, okusisinkana olutalo, si na mwoyo gwa bujeemu, wabula ogw’okuwuliza. Kyamugwanira okwogera nti, “Si nga Nze bwe njagala, wabula ky’oyagala kye kiba kikolebwa”; naye bwe yakyogera, yafuna ekintu kyennyini kye yaweerayo. Bw’atyo okuwuliza okwa Gesusemane si kuwuliza kwa muzibe era okufu okw’omutima oguleka essuubi lyagwo lyonna; wabula kwe kuwuliza okw’eddembe okukutamya omutwe, okusobola okufuna amaanyi ag’emirundi ebiri okuyita mu kukkiriza n’okusaba. Tuleka, tulyoke tunywereze ddala. Tuwaayo, tulyoke tufune mu bujjuvu. Tuteeka Isaaka waffe ku lusozi Moliya, ne tumusaba atuddizibwe, nga takyali Isaaka waffe, wabula Isaaka wa Katonda, era ng’akuumiddwa n’okusingawo ennyo, kubanga aweereddwayo mu bulamu obw’okuzuukira. Julaayi 29 “Bwe tukola omulimu mu Kristo Yesu” (Abaruumi 16:3). Ekkanisa ya Kristo ejjudde abaduumizi. Yeetaaga nnyo abaserikale abaabulijjo abalala abatono okweyongerako. Emigga mitono egikulukuta ne giyingira mu nnyanja, naye egisinga obungi giyingira mu migga emirala. Ffenna tetuyinza kuba bakulembeze, naye ffenna tusobola okuba abayambi, era tewali muntu asaanira kugenda mu maaso okutuusa lw’aba amaze okuyiga bulungi okugenda ng’ow’okubiri. Omwoyo ogw’okwegulumiza guzikiriza emirimu gyonna egya Kristo. Omulabe omukulu ennyo ogw’amaanyi ag’omwoyo ag’amazima kwe kwerowoozaako mu by’omwoyo. Yoswa ateekwa okufa nga Yeriko tennagwa. Emirundi mingi Katonda kimugwanira okugezesa abaweereza be abalonde ng’abateeka mu bifo eby’emmanga nga tannabaleeta mu maaso. Yusufu ateekwa okuyiga okuweereza mu ffumbiro n’okubonaabona mu kkomera nga tannalinnya ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka, era Yusufu bw’amala okweteekerateekera entebe ey’obwakabaka, entebe ey’obwakabaka ebeera bulijjo emulindirira. Katonda alina ebifo ebisinga obungi abo abakkirizibwa. Tuleme kutya kuyingira mu kibiina eky’okutendekebwa, ne tutwala ekifo ekisembayo wansi, kubanga tunaatera okulinnya waggulu, bwe tuba nga ddala tukisaanira. Mukama, nkozese olyoke ogulumizibwe, nange nkwekebwe eri nze wennyini n’eri abalala. Julaayi 30 “Singa muwuliriza eddoboozi lya Mukama Katonda wammwe n’obwegendereza, era ne mugondera amateeka ge” (Okuva 15:26). Emirundi mingi abantu balemererwa kubanga tebalina bwesige mu Musawo. Ekisooka ddala Omusawo ono ky’ayagala kwe kumwesiga, era okumwesiga awatali kubuusabuusa, awatali kubuusabuusa nga bw’ogenda mu maaso ng’osinziira ku kigambo kye kyokka, era n’okola nga bw’oba ofunye okuwonya kwe amangu ddala lw’oba weetwalidde ekisuubizo kye. Naye tewali ayinza kusuubira kuwonyezebwa musawo wa ku nsi amangu ddala nga bw’agondedde ebiragiro bye. Oteekwa okukola Omusawo Omukulu ky’akugamba, bw’oba osuubira akuwonye ddala. Toyinza kusuubira kuwonyezebwa bw’oba obeera mu kibi, nga bw’otandisuubidde musawo asinga obulungi kukuwonya ng’obeera mu kifo ekirimu omusujja gw’ensiri, ng’ossa obutwa na buli mukka gw’ossa. Kale oteekwa okulinnya mu mpewo ennongoofu ey’okwesiga n’okugonda nga Kristo tannakuwonya. N’oluvannyuma, bw’onoomwesiga, n’ossaayo omwoyo ku biragiro bye, ojja kuzuula nti waliwo eddagala mu Gireyaadi, era nti waliyo Omusawo Omukulu. Julaayi 31 “Twetooloddwa ebibonoobono ebya buli ngeri” (2 Abakkolinso 7:5). Lwaki Katonda amugwanira okutukulembera bw’atyo, n’akkiriza okunyigirizibwa okubeera okuzibu ennyo era okutakoma? Kale, okusooka, kiraga amaanyi ge amamala byonna n’ekisa kye obulungi okusinga singa twali tetunyigirizibwa era nga tetugezesebwa. “Ekyobugagga kino kiri mu bibya eby’ebbumba, obuyinza bwonna bulyoke bube bwa Katonda, so si bwaffe.” Kutuleetera okwongera okutegeera nga bwe twesigama ku ye. Katonda bulijjo agezaako okutuyigiriza okwesigama kwaffe, n’okututereka ddala mu mukono gwe nga tulyesigamye ku kutulabirira kwe. Kino kye kifo Yesu we yayimirira yekka era gy’ayagala naffe okuyimirira, si n’amaanyi ge twekoledde ffe, wabula n’omukono ogwesigamye ku gugwe bulijjo, n’obwesige obutaganya kutambula kigere na kimu kyokka. Kutuyigiriza okwesiga. Tewali ngeri ya kuyiga kukkiriza wabula okuyita mu kugezesebwa. Y’essomero lya Katonda ery’okukkiriza, era kirungi nnyo gye tuli okuyiga okwesiga Katonda okusinga okusanyukira obulamu. Essomo ery’okukkiriza, bwe limala okuyigibwa, kintu kya lubeerera ky’ofunye era bugagga bwa mirembe gyonna obukoleddwa; ate awatali bwesige, wadde obugagga bulituleka nga tuli baavu.

fields.title: Agusito
fields.body_html:
Agusito 1

“Kubanga ffe ffenna kitugwanira okulabika mu maaso g’entebe ya Kristo ey’okusalirako omusango, buli muntu asalirwe olw’ebyo bye yakola ng’akyali mulamu, okusinziira ku ebyo bye yakola oba birungi oba bibi” (2 Abakkolinso 5:10).

Si bulijjo luliba lunaku lwa kufuba na kubonaabona. Olunaku lumu, tuliwulira amannya gaffe nga galangirirwa mu maaso g’ensi yonna, n’ebyawandiikibwa ku bintu bye twali twerabidde edda nga bisomebwa. Emitima gyaffe nga giryedeekereza, n’emitwe gyaffe nga gikutama, bwe tuliwulira amannya gaffe nga gayitibwa, ne Mukama waffe n’alyoke ajjukize obuwanguzi n’obuweereza bwe twali twerabidde ffe fennyini! Ate, oboolyawo, okuva mu bibinja by’abaalokolebwa aliyita mu maaso emyoyo gye twafunira Kristo n’emyoyo nagyo gye baafuna, era bwe tuliraba ebivaamu eby’ebintu ebyalabika ng’ebitono ekiseera ekyo, tuligwa mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka, ne twogera nti, “Si ffe, Ayi Mukama, si ffe. Wabula erinnya lyo lye ligwana okuweebwanga ekitiibwa!”

Abaagalwa, empapula ez’ebyafaayo by’obulamu bwaffe zeeyongera buli lunaku. Ffe fennyini tuteekateeka ennukuta, nga tuyita mu buli kikolwa kya buli kaseera. Emikono egitalabika giteekateeka ebipande, era mu bbanga ttono ebyawandiikibwa birirondoolwa, ne bisomebwa mu maaso g’abantu b’ensi yonna. era wakati mu bivaamu eby’emirembe n’emirembe.

Agusito 2

“Weetoowazizza n’ongulumiza” (Zabbuli 18:35).

Omubudaabudi ow’omukisa muwombeefu, wa kisa, era ajjudde obugumiikiriza n’okwagala. Nga Katonda bw’ayisa n’aboonoonyi n’obuwombeefu! Nga bw’agumiikiriza n’obulwewombeefu! Nga bw’akangavvula abaana be abeekyusa n’obuweke! Nga bwe yakulembera Yakobo, Yusufu, Isirayiri, Dawudi, Eriya, n’abaweereza be bonna ab’edda, okutuusa lwe baayinza okwogera mu mazima nti, “Weetoowazizza n’ongulumiza.”

Omutima Omwoyo Omutukuvu mw’abeera bulijjo gulyawulibwa obuwombeefu, obwetoowaze, obusirifu, obukkakkamu, n’obugumiikiriza. Omwoyo omukambwe era ogusekerera, empisa ez’ekyejo, okuddamu n’obukambwe, okusala ebigambo eby’ettima—ebyo byonna bya mubiri, naye tebirina kye bigabana n’okuyigiriza okuwombeefu okw’Omubudaabudi.

Ejjiba Ettukuvu lyewala omwoyo ogw’oluyoogaano, ogw’akasasamalo, ogusiikuuse, n’ogw’eggwanga, ne lifuna eky’okubeeramu mu kifuba eky’omwetoowaze eky’omwoyo ogw’emirembe. “Ebibala eby’Omwoyo bye bino: ekisa n’obuwombeefu.”

Mukama, nfuula omuwombeefu. Sirisa omwoyo gwange. Longoosa empisa zange. Onsobozese okuba ne Kristo mu nneeyisa yange ne mu ddoboozi lyange, era ne mu mutima gwange.

Agusito 3

“Noolwekyo mwewombeeke wansi w’omukono gwa Katonda ogw’amaanyi” (1 Peetero 5:6).

Okunyigirizibwa okw’ebifo ebizibu kutuyigiriza okussa ekitiibwa mu bulamu. Buli lwe tuddizibwa obulamu bwaffe okuva mu kugezesebwa ng’okwo, kiba ng’entandikwa empya, era tuyiga obulungi omuwendo bwe buli, ne tubukozesa ekisingako olwa Katonda n’olw’omuntu.

Okunyigirizibwa kutuyamba okutegeera okugezesebwa kw’abalala, era kutufuula abatuufu okuyamba abalala n’okuwulira nabo obulumi bwabwe.

Waliwo obuntu obutali bwa buziba, obw’oku ngulu obwokka, obukwata endowooza oba ekisuubizo mu bwangu, ne bwogera n’obwewaawaze ku butakkiriza bw’abo abeewala buli kugezesebwa; naye omusajja oba omukazi eyabonaabona ennyo talikola bw’atyo, wabula muwombeefu nnyo era wa kisa, era amanyi obubonaabona bye butegeeza mu mazima.

Kino Pawulo kye yategeeza bwe yagamba nti, “Okufa kukolera mu ffe, naye obulamu bukolera mu mmwe.” Okugezesebwa n’ebifo ebizibu byetaagisa okutusindika mu maaso; nga bwe kityo omuliro ogw’ekyoto oguli munda mu kyombo ekyo eky’amaanyi gwe guwa amaanyi agakyusa piston, ne gutambuza yingini, ne gusindika ekyombo ekyo ekinene okuwunguka ennyanja, mu maaso g’empewo n’amayengo.

Agusito 4

“Naye mmwe temufugibwa mubiri wabula mufugibwa Mwoyo, kubanga Omwoyo wa Katonda abeera mu mmwe. Era omuntu yenna bw’ataba na Mwoyo wa Kristo, oyo si wa Kristo” (Abaruumi 8:9).

Omuntu ow’omwoyo si nnyo muntu alina empisa ey’omwoyo ey’amaanyi, wabula muntu ajjudde Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Bw’atyo omutume yagamba nti, “Naye mmwe temufugibwa mubiri wabula mufugibwa Mwoyo, kubanga Omwoyo wa Katonda abeera mu mmwe.”

Ekitiibwa eky’ekitonde ekiggya, kale, si kwokka nti kizza buggya omwoyo gw’omuntu, wabula nti kigufuula ekifo Katonda yennyini mw’abeera, era kigufuula okwesigama ku njuba, ng’omwana bw’eyesigama ku maama we. Noolwekyo, obw’omwoyo obusinga obwa waggulu, kwe kuba nga toyinza kukola kintu na kimu, okwesigama okutuukiridde n’okubeeramu Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutuukiridde. Noolwekyo, ekikolwa kya Kristo ekirungi eky’okufuuwa ku bayigirizwa be, n’abawa okuva ku mimwa gye Omwoyo gwennyini ogwali gumaze okubeera mu ye, kyayoleka mu ngeri esookuuka ekitiibwa eky’engule eky’ekitonde ekiggya. Era Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’atyo bw’atwetwala, ajjuza buli kitundu ky’obulamu bwaffe.

Agusito 5

“Buli awulira eddoboozi lyange n’aggulawo, nnaayingira omumwe ne tuliira wamu ffembi” (Okubikkulirwa 3:20).

Abamu ku ffe tuli mu njala, nga twebuuza lwaki Omwoyo Omutukuvu tatujjuza. Tulina bingi ebituyingiramu, naye tetubigaba. Gaba omukisa gw’olina, tandika enteekateeka ennene ez’okuweereza n’okuwa omukisa, era mangu ojja kulaba nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu akukulembedde, era “alikukwaniriza n’emikisa egijjudde ebirungi,” n’akuwa byonna by’ayinza okukwesiga okugabira abalala.

Waliwo ekintu ekirungi mu butonde ekiriko ne bye kifaananako mu by’omwoyo. Tewali nnyimba ya ggulu nga ennanga ya Aeolian, ate ennanga ya Aeolian tekyali kintu wabula nsinga z’ennyimba ezitegekeddwa mu maloboozi agakwatagana, ne zirekebwa okukwatibwako engalo ezitalabika ez’empewo eziyita. Ne nga omukka gw’eggulu bwe guyita ku nsinga, kigambibwa nti amaloboozi agaali ng’aga Katonda gawulikika mu bbanga, ng’ekibiina kya bamalayika nga bali okwetooloola nga bakwata ku nsinga.

Bwe kityo kisoboka okukuuma emitima gyaffe nga miggule eri okukwatako kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ne kisoboka okugivugako nga bw’ayagala, nga ffe tulindirira mu kasirise mu kkubo ery’okuweereza kwe.

Agusito 6

“Abo bonna abakulemberwa Omwoyo wa Katonda be baana ba Katonda” (Abaruumi 8:14).

Omwoyo Omutukuvu ow’omukisa ye Muluŋŋamya waffe, Mukulembeze waffe, era ye Kifo kyaffe eky’okuwummuliramu. Waliwo ebiseera lw’atusindika mu maaso mu kusaba, mu kuweereza, mu kubonaabona, mu bintu ebiggya, mu mirimu emiggya, mu kwetwalira okuggya okw’okukkiriza, n’essuubi, n’okwagala, naye waliwo ebiseera lw’atuyimiriza mu mirimu gyaffe, n’atuwummuza wansi w’ekiwaawaatiro kye ekitusiikiriza, n’atusirisa mu kifo eky’ekyama eky’Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo, ng’atuyigiriza amasomo agamu amaggya, ng’atufuuwamu amaanyi oba okujjula okw’omunda ennyo, n’oluvannyuma n’atukulembera nate, ku kiragiro kye kyokka. Ye Muluŋŋamya ow’amazima ow’omutukuvu, era Mukulembeze ow’amazima ow’Ekkanisa, Omuwi waffe w’amagezi ow’ekitalo, Mukwano gwaffe atakyama; ate oyo ayagala okwegaana okuluŋŋamya kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku bubwe olwo asobole okussa ekitiibwa mu Kigambo kya Katonda ng’omuluŋŋamya waffe yekka, ateekwa okumenya ekigambo ekirala eky’ekisuubizo, nti endiga ze zirimanya eddoboozi lye, era nti abaana be abawulize era abagondera baliwulira eddoboozi emabega waabwe nga ligamba nti, “Lino ly’ekkubo, litambuliremu.”

Agusito 7

“Tumanyi kino nti omuntu waffe ow’edda yakomererwa” (Abaruumi 6:6).

Kya kukkiriza kyokka, ate okukkiriza n’okulaba bulijjo tebifaanana, ne kiba nti eri amagezi go tekirabika nga bwe kiri, naye okukkiriza kwo kuteekwa okukibala nga bwe kityo. Eno nneeyisa nzibu nnyo okunywerera, era olwokubanga tukkiririza Katonda ddala, kwe tuyinza okubalira bwe tutyo ku Kigambo kye ne ku mirimu gye, naye bwe tukola bwe tutyo, okukkiriza kulikifuula amazima, era kiribeera bwe kityo.

Ebigambo bino ebibiri, “okwewaayo” ne “okubala,” bye bigambo eby’ekyama ebituyingiza mu bulamu obw’okuzuukira. Biri ng’obwogi obubiri obw’“Ekitala ky’Omwoyo” mwe tuyita okuyingira mu kukomererwa wamu ne Kristo.

Ekikolwa kino eky’okwewaayo n’okubala kuno okw’okukkiriza bikkirizibwa mu Ndagaano Empya ng’ebiraga akaseera akalungamu ennyo mu bulamu obw’omwoyo. Tekitegeeza nti tusuubirwa okuyita mu kufa okutasala, wabula nti wateekwa okubaawo ekikolwa kimu eky’okufa ekikakafu, n’oluvannyuma omuze ogutasala ogw’okwebala nga tufudde, ne tusisinkana buli kintu nga tuyima ku ntobo eno.

“Mwerowoozenga okuba abaafiira ddala eri ekibi, naye abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu.”

Agusito 8

“Mubeere ng’ejjiba” (Yeremiya 48:28).

Okuba omuteefu ng’ejjiba, y’engeri Kristo gy’ategeeza akabonero kano akalungi. Bw’atyo Omwoyo wa Katonda bwe buli obulongoofu bwennyini. Tayinza kubeera mu mutima omujama. Tayinza kubeera mu magezi ag’obuzaaliranwa. Ku mafuta ag’edda kyayogerwa nti, “Tegajjanga kufukibwa ku bantu ba bulijjo.”

Obulongoofu Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’aleeta buli ng’akati akato akatukula era akataliiko bbala akamera okuva mu ntuumu y’obusa, oba mu ttaka eddugavu, awatali kamersegere na kamu ka bucaafu akakwatidde ku ngulu yaakyo eyakaayakana, nga tekaliiko bbala ng’ekiwaawaatiro kya malayika.

Bw’atyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu awa obulongoofu bw’omutima obwerinda bwennyini, kubanga mu butonde bwabwo tebufaanana n’ebintu ebibi ebibumeramu okwetooloola. Buyinza okuba nga bwetooloddwa ebibi ku njuyi zonna, naye tebuyonoonebwa era buba bulongoofu kubanga obutonde bwabwo mu ntobo bwe butukuvu era bwa Katonda. Ng’ebyoya by’ejjiba, tebuyinza kwonoonebwa, wabula buva mu kidiba eky’ettosi nga tebuliiko bbala era nga tebwonooneddwa mazzi ga kizikiza, kubanga bukuumibwa ekibikka eky’amafuta ekigoba buli bucaafu ne kifuula obutakwatibwako bbala lyonna.

Agusito 9

“Anaateekanga emikono gye gyombi ku mutwe gw’embuzi eyo ennamu n’agikwatako, n’agyenenyerezaako ebyonoono by’abaana ba Isirayiri, n’obujeemu bwabwe, n’ebibi byabwe byonna” (Ebyabaleevi 16:21).

Buli ekibi bwe kivaayo, ate okutegeera kw’ekintu kyonna ekitali kitukuvu ne kukoona ku magezi gaffe ag’omunda, kye kisa kyaffe okukukwasa amangwago Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’okukiteeka ku Yesu, ng’ekintu ekimaze okukomererwa wamu naye, era nga bwe kyali edda, mu nsonga ey’ekiweebwayo olw’ekibi, kirisindikibwa ebweru w’olusiisira ne kyokebwa ne kifuuka evvu.

Wayinza okubaawo okubonaabona okw’amaanyi, wayinza okubaawo obulumi obuwanvu, buyinza okuba obw’amazima ennyo; naye mu byonna waliba okuwulira okuwoomerera era okutukuvu okw’okubeerawo kwa Katonda, n’obulongoofu obw’amaanyi mu mwoyo gwaffe gwonna, n’okwawukana kwaffe okuva ku kibi ekyokebwa. Mazima ddala, kirituusibwa ebweru w’olusiisira, era n’akawunyiro k’ennimi z’omuliro tekaliba ku ngoye zaffe.

Kya mukisa nnyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutta ebintu. Tewali bitala okuggyako ebibye ebiyinza okuyita bulungi bwe bityo wakati waffe n’ekibi, ne kizikiriza ekibi awatali kukwata ku mwoyo.

Mukama Yesu, Ekiweebwayo kyange olw’ekibi, nteeka ekibi kyange, nze kennyini, obuntu bwange bwonna, ku Musaalaba gwo. Nzikiriza n’omuliro gwo omutukuvu, era ondeke nfiire buli kimu okuggyako Ggwe!

Agusito 10

“Toliiko bbala na limu” (Oluyimba 4:7).

Omwoyo Omutukuvu ow’omukisa abeera mu mutima ogwewaddeyo, afaayo nnyo ku bulamu bwaffe obusinga obukulu, era atukuuma n’okwagala okuweefu, era n’okwagala okujjudde obuggya. Enkyusa ey’amazima ey’ekifo ekyo ekya bulijjo ekiri mu Bbaluwa ya Yakobo nnungi nnyo, egamba nti, “Omwoyo gwe yassa mu ffe, atulabirira n’okwagala okujjudde obuggya.”

Omutima gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu gufaayo nnyo okutukuuma tuleme okubaako buli bbala na buli kamogo, era okututuusa ku bisinga obukulu byonna ebisoboka mu kwagala kwa Katonda.

Omugole Omusajja ow’Eggulu ayagala Ekkanisa ye ebeere nga terina bbala lyonna lyokka, wabula n’“akamogo oba ekintu kyonna ekikyamu.” Ebbala ke kabonero k’ekibi, naye akamogo ke kabonero k’obunafu, obukadde, n’okuvunda; era tayagala kukwatibwako kwonna okwonoona okw’engeri eyo ku nfaanana entukuvu ey’Omwagalwa we. Bw’atyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu, atuukiriza okwagala kwe, era omubaka ow’Obwakatonda gw’atuma okuyita, okwawula, n’okuleeta eka Omugole we, afaayo n’obuggya okutuukiriza mu ffe okwagala kwa Mukama waffe kwonna.

Mukama, nzigyako buli kamogo na buli kabonero k’obunafu n’okuvunda, ompindule Omugole wo atalina bbala.

Agusito 11

“Ensi gy’olaba” (Olubereberye 13:15).

Ebiweebwa eby’amazima eby’ekisa kye biva mu kwolesebwa okw’omunda.

Oyo ateeka mu kifuba ky’ekinyonyi kiri omuze ogw’obuzaaliranwa okusomoka ssemazinga nga kinoonya omusana ogw’ekyeya mu nsi eri ey’obukiikaddyo, mulungi nnyo n’atayinza kukirimba; era nga bw’ateeka omuze ogwo mu kifuba kyakyo mu butuufu, bw’atyo era ateeseeteese eyo empewo eweweevu n’omusana ogw’ekiseera eky’okumera okukyaniriza nga kituuseeyo.

Oyo eyawa Ibulayimu okwolesebwa okw’Ensi ey’Ekisuubizo, era yayogera mu mazima n’okwagala okutaliiko kkomo nti, “Ensi gy’olaba ndigikuwa ggwe.” Oyo assa mu mitima gyaffe essuubi ery’omu ggulu, taalitulimba wadde okutulekulira nga tweyongerayo okukituukiriza. Tewali butali bwesigwa mu oyo eyagamba nti, “Singa tekiri bwe kityo nandibagambye,” era tuyinza okumanya nti talitulimba era talituleka, wabula byonna by’atubikkulira mu Mwoyo we Omutukuvu alibitufuula ababyo, nga tweyongerayo era nga tuyingira mu kutuukirira kwabyo.

Mukama, sooka ompe okwolesebwa n’oluvannyuma obuwanguzi. Ndaga obusika bwange bwonna, n’oluvannyuma obumpe bwonna mu Kristo Yesu.

Agusito 12

“Tetweyogerako wabula Kristo Yesu” (2 Abakkolinso 4:5).

Obuyinza bwo obw’Ekikristaayo, ettutumu lyo ng’omukozi wa Katonda, n’ekifo kyo mu booluganda bo, biyinza okuba ekifaananyi ekisinzibwa ky’oteekwa okufiira, nga tonnaba wa ddembe okubeerera Ye yekka.

Bw’oba nga wali weetegerezezaako ennukuta eziri ku lupapula olukubiddwa, oteekwa okuba nga wali olabye nti akannukuta akatono “i” bulijjo kaliko akatonko waggulu waako, era akatonko ako ke kakagulumiza okusinga ennukuta endala eziri ku lunyiriri.

Kaakano, buli omu ku ffe ali ng’akannukuta akatono i, era ku buli omu ku ffe kuliko akatonko akatono ak’okwegulumiza, okwagala kwaffe ffe, okwenoonyeza, okweyesiga, okwematira, oba ekintu kye tunywerera era kye tulwanirira, ekiraga obulamu obw’okwefaako mu butuufu, ng’obulamu obwo bwe bwandibadde olusozi olw’obukulu obw’amazima.

Akannukuta i kano ke omuvuganyi wa Yesu Kristo, era omulabe w’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, n’ow’emirembe gyaffe n’obulamu bwaffe; kyekivudde Katonda asalawo okufa kwako, era Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ng’akutte ekitala kye ekyaka omuliro, alindirira okukazikiriza, tulyoke tusobole okuyingira mu miryango ne tutuuka ku Muti ogw’Obulamu. Mukama, njjuza n’okujjula kwo okutuusa lwe ndiggwaamu ekifo, nga ekitiibwa kya Mukama bwe kyabulako Musa ekifo mu Eweema ey’Okukuŋŋaanirangamu.

Agusito 13

“Ebire n’ekizikiza bimwetooloola” (Zabbuli 97:2).

Okubaawo kw’ebire ku ggulu lyo, n’okugezesebwa mu kkubo lyo, bwe bujulizi obusinga obulungi nti ogoberera empagi ey’ekire, era ng’otambulira mu maaso ga Katonda. Baalina okuyingira mu kire nga tebannaba kulaba kitiibwa ky’Okufuusibwa, ate oluvannyuma akaseera ekire kye kimu ne kifuuka eggaali okwaniriza Mukama eyali ayambuka mu ggulu, era kikyalindirira nga eggaali erireeta okulabika kwe okw’ekitiibwa.

Ne kaakano kya mazima nti “ebire n’ekizikiza bimwetooloola entebe ye ey’obwakabaka, okwagala n’obwesigwa” bulijjo biri wakati mu bo, era “binaakumukulemberanga.”

Oboolyawo omugaso ogw’ekire ogusinga obulungi n’ekisa gwali okubasiikiriza eri omusana ogwokya. Ng’ekyokwesiikiriza ekinene, empagi eyo ey’ekitiibwa yabikka ekisiikirize kyayo waggulu w’olusiisira, ne kifuuka ekisiikirize ekiwonya eri ebbugumu eryokya mu ddungu eritaliimu miti. Tewali n’omu atawuliddeko musana gwa mu Buvanjuba ayinza okutegeera bulungi ekintu kino eky’omugaso bwe kiri—ekisiikirize okuva ku bbugumu.

Bw’atyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ajja wakati waffe n’emisana egyokya, egisiiya, egy’ennaku n’okukemebwa.

Agusito 14

“Abalonde bange, ne bannabbi bange temubakolangako kabi” (Zabbuli 105:15).

Nnandisinze okuzannya n’eggulu erimyansa erisensebbuka, oba okukwata mu ngalo zange emiguwa gy’amasannyalaze emiramu, egirimu amaanyi g’omuliro, okusinga okwogera ekigambo eky’obutalowooza ku muweereza yenna wa Kristo, oba okuddiŋŋana obutamanyi obusaale obw’obuwaayizi Abakristaayo enkumi n’enkumi bwe basuula ku balala, ne bwe buleeta okulumizibwa kw’emyoyo n’emibiri gyabwe.

Oyinza obulijjo okwewuunya, oboolyawo, lwaki obulwadde bwo tebuwona, oba omwoyo gwo tegujjula ssanyu lya Mwoyo Omutukuvu, oba obulamu bwo tebuweebwa mukisa na kukulaakulana. Kiyinza okuba nti akasaale konna ke wasuula n’eddoboozi ery’obusungu, oba mu kiseera eky’obwereere eky’olugambo olutalowoozebwako, kakugoberera mu lugendo lwako, nga bwe kakuba ekkulungo eridda bulijjo eri ensibuko gye kaava, nga kikomyawo buli kasaale ak’obukyayi na buli kigambo eky’obwereere n’ekibi.

Tujjukire nti bwe tuyigganya oba okulumya abaana ba Katonda, tuba tuyigganya Ye yennyini, era tuba tweruma ffe fennyini okusingako nnyo.

Mukama, ompe okufaayo ku nneewulira n’eddembe ly’abalala nga bwe njanga okufaayo ku byange, era onsobozese okubeera n’okwagala nga Ggwe.

Agusito 15

“Alibaluŋŋamya mu mazima gonna” (Yokaana 16:13).

Omwoyo Omutukuvu tajja kutuwa bya kyewuunyo bya njawulo, wabula kutuwa bulamu bwe n’ekitangaala kye, era gye tusingako okumusemberera, gye kusingako okuba okwangu kw’okumulisa kwe n’okukulembera kwe. Ajja “okutuluŋŋamya mu mazima gonna.” Ajja okwakisa ekitangaala mu mitima gyaffe ffennyini, n’okutulaga ffe bennyini. Ajja okubikkula Kristo, okuwa, n’oluvannyuma okumulisa, Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu, n’okufuula ebintu eby’Obwakatonda okulabika bulungi era nga bitegeerekeka eri okutegeera kwaffe okw’omwoyo. Ajja ng’Omwoyo ow’amagezi n’okubikkulirwa mu kumanya Kristo, “okumulisa amaaso g’emitima gyaffe, tulyoke tumanye essuubi ly’okuyitibwa kwaffe, n’obugagga obungi bwe tulina mu ye, ffe awamu n’abantu ba Katonda bonna, era tutegeere amaanyi ge agasukkiridde agakolera mu ffe abakkiriza, ng’okukola kw’obuyinza bw’amaanyi ge bwe kuli.”

Ggwe Mwoyo ow’Amaanyi! n’omuliro ogw’omu ggulu, Ojjuze emyoyo gyaffe, oleetere ennimi zaffe okwogera; Golola Omukono gwo ogw’amaanyi, Ebirabo byo ebya Pentekooti obikomyewo, Ebyamagero eby’amaanyi go nate Byolese mu nsi zonna.

Agusito 16

“Ndi nammwe bulijjo” (Matayo 28:20).

Ayi, nga kituyamba era kitubudaabuda mu kutegana kw’obulamu okumanya nti tulina naffe Kristo eyamala emyaka amakumi asatu egisooka egy’obulamu bwe mu dduuka ery’obubazzi mu Nazaaleesi, ng’akuba ennyondo, ng’abikkiddwa entuuyo n’enfuufu ey’enziro, ng’akooye mu mubiri nga ffe bwe tutera okukoowa, era ng’asobola okutegeera byonna bye tuyita mu eby’emirimu emizibu n’okutegana! era Oyo akyayagala okwetaba mu mirimu gyaffe egya bulijjo n’okutuwa amaanyi ku mirimu gyaffe emizibu egy’emikono n’obwongo!

Yee, mwannyinaffe ow’obwetoowaze, ajja kukuyamba ku lubaawo olw’okwoza ne ku ssinki ey’omu ffumbiro n’essanyu nga bw’akuyamba mu ssaawa ey’okusaba. Yee, ggwe fundi akola ennyo, ajja kugenda naawe n’akuyamba okukuba ennyondo, oba okukozesa omusumeeno, oba okukwata ekyuma ekirima mu kutegana kw’obulamu, era onoobeera fundi omulungi okusingawo, omukozi omukugu okusingawo, n’omusajja omuwanguzi okusingawo, kubanga otwala amagezi ge mu bintu bya bulijjo eby’obulamu. Tewali kifo wadde kiseera Ye w’atasobola era w’atayagalira kutambulira ku lusegere lwaffe, okukolera mu mikono gyaffe n’obwongo bwaffe, n’okwegatta naffe mu bumu obw’okwagala era obw’okumala byonna mu byetaago byaffe byonna n’emirimu n’okugezesebwa, n’atulaga nti ye Amala byonna byaffe mu bintu byonna.

Agusito 17

“Lagira olwazi” (Okubala 20:8).

Omwoyo Omutukuvu akwatibwako amangu, nga okwagala bwe kutera okubeera bulijjo. Osobola okuwangula ensolo enkambwe n’ebikonde n’enjegere, naye toyinza kuwangula mutima gwa mukazi mu ngeri eyo, wadde okufuna okwagala kw’omuntu akwatibwako amangu; ekyo kiteekwa okusembezebwa n’okukwatako okuweefu okw’obwesige n’okwagala. Bw’atyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ateekwa okwanirizibwa n’okukkiriza okuweefu era okukwatibwako amangu ng’omutima omuwombeefu gw’akwatagana nagwo. Ekirowoozo kimu eky’obutakkiriza, akaddoboozi kamu ak’obutakkiriza akatagumiikiriza oba akw’okutya, kajja kuziyiza mangu eddembe erituukiridde ery’emirimu gye, ng’omukka gw’empewo ey’obunnyogovu bwe gwandiwotosezza ebiwaawaatiro by’ekimuli ekisinga obuweefu, ekya roozi oba eddanga.

Yogera n’olwazi, tolukuba. Kkiriza Omwoyo Omutukuvu era omuyise n’obwesige obusinga obuweefu n’obwesige obutasagaasagana, era ajja kukusisinkana mangu n’okuddamu awamu n’obwesige.

Omwagalwa, otuuse ku lwazi olw’e Kadesi? Oyanjuluzza obulamu bwo bwonna eri okujjula kw’Omwoyo, ne kaakano, n’obwesige ng’obw’omwana eri nnyina, ng’omugole eri bba, ng’ekimuli eri omusana, wafunye lwa kukkiriza, era onywa ku bulamu bwe obw’omukisa?

Agusito 18

“Amakondeere ebikumi ebisatu bwe gaafuuyibwa” (Balam 7:22).

Emirundi egimu, tetulowooza nnyo ku kye kiyinza okukola ekigambo eky’amangu, enjogera etalowoozebwako, ekikolwa eky’obutagenderera, oba okwatula okw’obutakkiriza n’okutya, mu kuziyiza omugaso gwaffe ogusinga obukulu, oba mu kugukyusa okuguggya ku mukisa omukulu Katonda gw’abadde atuteekerateekera.

Wadde ng’Omwoyo Omutukuvu akozesa abantu abanafu, tayagala kubeera banafu ng’amaze okubalonda n’okubayita. Wadde ng’akozesa ebintu eby’obusirusiru okuswaza ab’amagezi, tayagala ffe kubeera basirusiru ng’amaze okujja okutuwa amagezi ge n’ekisa kye. Akozesa obusirusiru obw’okubuulira, naye si lwa nsonga obusirusiru obw’ababuulizi. Ng’amasannyalaze, agasobola okuwa amaanyi g’abantu lukumi, kyetaagisa okuba n’ekigayisaamu ekituufu, era waaya entono ennyo esinga obulungi omuguwa omunene ennyo.

Katonda ayagala ebikozesebwa ebisaanira amaanyi ge—okwagala okwewaddeyo, emitima egyesiga, obulamu obutakyukakyuka, n’emimwa egigondera okwagala kwe; olwo n’asobola okukozesa ebyokulwanyisa ebisinga obunafu, n’abifuula eby’amaanyi mu Katonda okumenya ebigo.

Agusito 19

“Mukkiririze mu Katonda” (Makko 11:22).

Atwetaagisa okukkiriza okutuukiridde, era atugamba nti bwe tukkiriza ne tutabuusabuusa, tujja kufuna kyonna kye tusaba. N’akatono ak’obutakkiriza kadibya obwesige bwaffe.

Naye tunaafuna tutya okukkiriza okutuukiridde bwe kityo? Kisoboka eri obuntu? Nedda, naye kisoboka eri obuntu obw’Ekikatonda, kisoboka eri Kristo ali mu ffe. Kisoboka Katonda okukuwa; era Katonda akuwa. Naye Kristo ye Nnannyini kukkiriza kwaffe era y’akutuukiriza, era atulagira okuba n’okukkiriza kwa Katonda, era nga bwe tukufuna okuyita mu kuweebwa Omwoyo wa Kristo, tukkiriza nga naye bw’akkiriza.

Tusaba mu linnya lye, era mu buntu bwe bwennyini, era tuba balamu olw’okukkiriza kw’Omwana wa Katonda eyatwagala ne yeewaayo ku lwaffe. Okwagala kw’atwetaagisa si kwagala kwa buntu bwokka, wadde ekipimo eky’okwagala ekyasabibwanga mu Ndagaano Enkadde, wabula ekintu ekisingako nnyo waggulu. Etteeka eriggya lye lino nti, Mwagalanenga, si nga bwe mwagala emyoyo gyammwe, wabula nga nze bwe mbaagadde.

Okwagala okufaanana kwatyo kunaasoboka kutya? Mu kino okwagala kwaffe kwe kutuukirira, kubanga nga bw’ali, era naffe bwe tuli bwe tutyo mu nsi eno. Okwagala kwaffe kwe kwagala kwe okukolebwa mu ffe, era okutuweebwa okuyita mu Mwoyo.

Agusito 20

“Mu kino Kitange agulumizibwa” (Yokaana 15:8).

Ekkubo ery’amazima ery’okugulumiza Katonda kwe kuleka Katonda okwolesa ekitiibwa kye ng’ayita mu ffe, okwaka ng’ayita mu ffe nga ebibya ebyereere ebiraga obujjuvu bwe obw’ekisa n’amaanyi.

Enjuba egulumizibwa bw’efuna omukisa okwolesa ekitangaala kyayo ng’eyita mu ddirisa ery’endabirwamu, oba okukyaka nga kiva mu ndabirwamu etaliiko bbala oba mu nnyanja etangalijja.

Tewali kigulumiza Katonda okusinga omusajja oba omukazi omunafu era ataliiko amaanyi okusobola okuwangula, ng’ayita mu maanyi ge, mu bifo empisa z’omuntu ez’ekitalo we zituleremba, n’okuyingiza mu maanyi ag’Ekikatonda ng’ayita mu buli ngeri ey’okutegana n’okubonaabona, omwoyo ogutonderwa okunafuwa, ogutali gunywevu, ogw’omululu, era ogw’ekibi, ne gufuulibwa obuwoomu, obutukuvu, amaanyi ne guyimirira nga guwangula wakati mu mbeera empisa zaagwo ez’obuzaaliranwa ze zitagusaanyiza n’akatono. Omutwe ogutalina magezi wadde amaanyi ag’obuzaaliranwa, nga guluŋŋamizibwa amagezi ag’Ekikatonda, ne gutwalibwa ku lunyiriri lw’enteekateeka ennene era ey’amaanyi, ne gukozesebwa okutuukiriza ebibala eby’ekitalo eri Katonda n’omuntu—kino kye kigulumiza Katonda.

Kale leka ngulumize Mukama wange olunaku luno era nnyonje enjigiriza ya Katonda mu bintu byonna.

Agusito 21

“Olutalo si lwammwe” (2 Ebyomumirembe 20:15).

Ekigendererwa kwe kubala olutalo nga lwa Katonda. “Olutalo si lwammwe, naye lwa Katonda.” Temwetaaga kulwana mu lutalo luno. Ekiseera kyonna gye tubalira akabi n’obuvunaanyizibwa nga byaffe, tujja kutabulwa okutya, naye bwe tutegeera nti alina okutulabirira, ng’ebintu bye era ababaka be, tujja kuwulira eddembe n’obukuume obutakoma.

Bwe ntuma omuweereza wange olugendo oluwanvu, nze nvunaanyizibwa ku nsaasaanya ye n’obukuume bwe, era Katonda bw’antuma wonna, ye avunaanyizibwa. Bwe tuba aba Katonda, ne tuteeka obulamu bwaffe, ab’omu maka gaffe, ne byonna bye tulina mu mikono gye, tuyinza okumanya nti ajja kutulabirira.

Omubiri gwaffe bwe guba gugwe, kiba kya mugaso gy’ali okutukuuma nga tuli balamu bulungi, nga bwe kiri eky’omugaso eri omusumba okuba n’endiga ze nga zirya bulungi era nga zirabiriddwa bulungi, era nga ze zimuweesa ekitiibwa.

“Katonda yeebazibwe atuwanguzisa bulijjo.”

Yimirira, yimirira ku lwa Yesu, Yimirira mu maanyi ge gokka; Omukono gw’omubiri gulikulemererwa, Toteekwa kwesiga gugwo.

Agusito 22

“Nze Mukama ow’olubereberye era ow’enkomerero” (Isaaya 41:4).

Abantu enkumi n’enkumi basanyeewo oluvannyuma lw’okusaabala mu lugendo olukulu olw’obutukuvu, kubanga beesiga okumanyiira okwo mu kifo ky’oyo akuleeta. Baalowoozanga nti baali balokoddwa ddala era ennaku zonna okuva mu kibi kyonna, era mu ssanyu ery’okumanyiira kwabwe okusooka, balowooza nti tebaliddayo kugezesebwa wadde okukemebwa nga bwe kyali edda, era bwe bavaayo ne bayingira mu bikolwa eby’amazima eby’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo, ne beezuula nga balemererwa era nga bagwa, ne beewuunya era ne basobera, ne basalawo nti baali bakyamu mu kumanyiira kwabwe, ne bagezaako obuggya ekintu kye kimu, ne baddamu ne bagwa, okutuusa oluvannyuma, nga bakooye olw’okugezesa, ne basalawo nti okumanyiira kwe kulimba, oba, waakiri, nti tekwabateekerwateekerwa, ne baddayo mu kkubo ery’edda, era embeera yaabwe ey’oluvannyuma esinga embi okusinga eyasooka.

Abasajja n’abakazi kye beetaaga leero kwe kumanya, si kutukuzibwa nga mbeera, wabula Kristo ng’Omuntu omulamu.

Mukama Yesu, mpa omutima gwo, okukkiriza kwo, obulamu bwo, ggwe kennyini.

Agusito 23

“Nga Katonda bw’ali omutukuvu” (1 Yokaana 3:3).

Katonda kaakano agenderera okuzza obuggya mu ffe ekifaananyi ekyamaze okulabika mu Yesu Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda. Obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo si kukoppa Kristo, wabula kutondebwa buggya butereevu mu Kristo, era okwegatta ne Kristo kutuukiridde nnyo ne kutuusa lw’atuwa obuntu bwe ye era n’abeera obulamu bwe ye mu ffe, ne kiryoka kiba si kukoppa, wabula okumera obuntu obwasimbibwa munda.

Tuba balamu nga Kristo kubanga tulina obulamu bwa Kristo. Katonda tamatira na kintu kyonna ekitatuukiridde. Ekyo yakyetaaga eri Omwana we. Akyetaaga gye tuli, era mu nkola y’ekisa, takendeeza kipimo, wabula atulinnyisa ku kyo. Takkakkanya butuukirivu bwa mateeka, wabula atwetaagisa obutuukirivu obusinga nnyo obutuukirivu bw’Abawandiisi n’Abafalisaayo, era n’alyoka abutuwa. Atubala nga tutuukirivu mu kutukuzibwa, era ayogera ku kitonde ekiggya nti, “Buli akola eby’obutuukirivu aba mutuukirivu, nga Katonda bw’ali omutuukirivu.”

Mukama, beera obulamu bwo ddala mu nze.

Agusito 24

“Mubeere n’okuzibiikiriza eri abantu bonna” (Abafiripi 4:5).

Ekigezesa ddala okwewaayo bwe kwagala kwaffe, si kwewaayo bintu ebikyamu byokka, wabula n’okuwaayo eddembe lyaffe, okwagala okugonda. Katonda bw’atandika okukakkanya emmeeme, emirundi mingi atwetaagisa okuwaayo ebintu ebitali bya mugaso munene mu byo byennyini, bw’atyo n’amenya ensingo yaffe n’akakkanya omwoyo gwaffe.

Tewali mukozi wa Kikristaayo asobola okukozesebwa Katonda okutuusa okwagala kwaffe okw’amalala lwe kumenyeka, n’omutima ne guba mwetegefu okugonda buli kwe akwatako kwa Katonda, ne bwe kuyita mu buli muntu yenna.

Abantu bangi baagala Katonda okubakulembera mu kkubo lyabwe era tebagumiikiriza buyinza bwonna wadde okuziyizibwa kwonna. Bawaayo ssente zaabwe, naye baagala okulagira engeri gye ziba zikozesebwamu. Bakola nga bwe mubaleka okwesanyusa, naye ka wajje okunyigirizibwa kwonna era amangwago otomera, si kisa ky’okugonda, wabula ebbaluwa ey’okuwummula mu mulimu, nga bava mu buvunaanyizibwa obumu obukulu, ne baleeta ekibiina kyonna eky’emikwano abanenya, nabo abeetegefu okuba n’endowooza zaabwe n’okwagala kwabwe ku nsonga eyo. Kizikiriza buli maanyi ga mazima.

Agusito 25

“Era ndibawa Omwoyo wange alibakubiriza okugoberera ebiragiro byange n’okukuuma obulungi amateeka gange” (Ezeekyeri 36:27).

Kino kisinga nnyo omutima omuggya. Guno mutima ogujjudde Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Omwoyo ogw’Ekikatonda, amaanyi agatuleetera okutambulira mu biragiro bya Katonda.

Kino kye kizibu ekisinga obunene ekijjira obulamu obw’Omukristaayo, Katonda yennyini bw’ajja okubeera mu mwoyo ogwazzibwa obuggya mu kukyuka, n’agufuula ekifo kye eky’okubeeramu, n’agunywerezaako n’amaanyi ge amangi mu butukuvu ne mu butuukirivu.

Kaakano, bino bwe bimala okubaawo, omuntu yandirowoozezza nti twandisitulibbwa okuyingira mu mwoyo ogujjudde essuubi n’essanyu okusingawo, naye nnabbi awa ekifaananyi eky’enjawulo ennyo. Agamba nti kino bwe kirituukirira tulyekyawa mu maaso gaffe ffennyini.

Okwolesebwa kwa Katonda kutuwa okutegeera okw’obuziba obw’obutabaawo bwaffe n’obutagasa bwaffe, era kutugalamiza ku maaso gaffe mu nfuufu mu kwefiiriza.

Okujja kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu kuggyawo obwaffe era kuswaza obwaffe emirembe gyonna, era obutukuvu obusinga waggulu kwe kutambulira mu kwefiiriza.

Agusito 26

“Omuweereza wo ky’alinawo kyokka mu nnyumba twe tufuta otutono ennyo” (2 Bassekabaka 4:2).

Yamubuuza nti, “Olina ki mu nnyumba?” N’addamu nti, “Sirina kintu mu nnyumba wabula otufuta otutono ennyo.” Naye amafuta ago gaali gamala byonna bye yali yeetaaga, singa yali amanyi engeri y’okugakozesaamu.

Mu mazima gaakiikirira Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era essomo ekkulu ery’olugero lwe lino nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu amala byonna bye twetaaga, singa tumanya engeri y’okumukozesaamu.

Kyonna kye yali yeetaaga kwe kufuna ebibya ebimala okugegga ku byo ebiyiika, n’alyoka afuka okutuusa nga byonna bijjudde.

Bw’atyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu akomebwa kkomo lyokka olw’obusobozi bwaffe okumusembeza, era Katonda bw’ayagala tube n’obujjuvu obusingawo, ateekwa okukolawo ebbanga eryo ng’atonda obwetaavu obusingawo.

Katonda atuweereza ebibya ebiggya okujjuzibwa Omwoyo we Omutukuvu mu bwetaavu obutujjira, ne mu kugezesebwa okutusanga. Bino mikisa Katonda gy’akozesa okwongera okwewaayo gye tuli, era nga bwe tubisanga ajja gye tuli mu bujjuvu obusingawo olwa buli kwetaaga okuggya.

Mukama, nnyamba okukulaba mu mbeera zange zonna ezinzitawaanya era okuzifuula ebibya okugegga ku kisa kyo ekisingawo.

Agusito 27

“Temweraliikiriranga bya bulamu bwammwe” (Matayo 6:25).

Mukama akyakozesa ebintu ebinyoomebwa. Amannya ag’Omunnazaaleesi n’Omukristaayo edda gaali mannya ga kunyooma. Tewali muntu ayinza okuba n’endowooza ya Katonda esingayo waggulu n’aba wa ttutumu mu mulembe gwe ogumwetoolodde. Abasajja abavumibwa ennyo be batera okukozesebwa ennyo.

Waliwo ebikangabwa ebisinga obunene okusinga okutaba wa ttutumu n’okutategeerekeka. Waliwo ebintu ebisinga obubi okusinga okulabika mu bantu abatono. Emikisa gya Katonda emingi egisinga obunene gyekwese emabega w’ebitiisa bya Setaani eby’okusaliriza n’okwogera obulimba. Omwoyo Omutukuvu takwatibwa nsonyi kukozesa bantu abatali ba ttutumu. Era bw’abakozesa, kiki kye baalina okufaayo ku bantu?

Ayi, ka tufune okukkirizibwa kwe kwokka, kale okwetegereza kw’abantu kunaaba tekugasa nnyo, era ajja kutuwa byonna bye twetaaga eby’obuyambi n’ettendo ery’abantu. Ka tunoonye kwagala kwe kwokka, ekitiibwa kye, n’okusiima kwe. Ka tumugendere ku mirimu egisinga obuzibu era tukole emirimu egy’ekivve ennyo. Kya kitiibwa kimala nti atukozesa era n’atutuma. Tuleme kutya ku lunaku luno kumugoberera ebweru w’olusiisira, nga twetikkidde okuvumibwa kwe, era mu bbanga tettwali ajja kwatula erinnya lyaffe eritagasa mu maaso g’enkumi n’enkumi ez’oku nsi n’eby’omu ggulu.

Agusito 28

“Ng’amaanyi ge bwe gali agakolera mu ffe” (Abaefeso 3:20).

Bwe tutuuka mu kifo eky’okwegatta ne Katonda, ng’Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe, tuyingira mu busika obw’omukisa ogw’ebweru era tuyingira mu nsi yaffe ey’obwannannyini. Olwo obulamu bwaffe obw’omubiri n’amaanyi bituweebwa okuyita mu maanyi g’obulamu bwaffe obw’omunda; olwo okusaba kwe kutuukirira, nti tunaabeeranga balamu era nga tugaggawala, ng’emmeeme yaffe bw’egaggawala. Olwo, ng’obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe biri mu ffe, ebintu byonna bituleeterwako.

Okukola kwa Katonda okw’ebweru bulijjo kutambulira wamu n’amaanyi agakolera mu ffe. Katonda bw’atuuzibwa ku ntebe mu mwoyo gw’omuntu, olwo Setaani n’ensi mangu ne bakizuula. Tetwetaaga kulanga maanyi gaffe. Yesu teyasobola kukwekebwa, era omwoyo ogujjudde amaanyi n’obutukuvu obw’Ekikatonda gusaanidde okufuuka ekisikiriza emitima egirumwa enjala n’obulamu obubonaabona.

Ka tumusembeze era tumutegeere mu kitiibwa kye eky’okubeera mu ffe, olwo ne tulyoka twetwalira byonna bye kitegeeza eri obulamu bwaffe mu bujjuvu bwabwo bwonna. Mukama, mpa “okukwekebwa kw’amaanyi go,” era leka Kristo agulumizibwe mu nze.

Agusito 29

“Okugonda kusinga ssaddaaka” (1 Samwiri 15:22).

Okuwonyezebwa kwaffe bwe kutyo kukiikirirwa ng’empeera ey’enjawulo ey’okugonda. Kale, bwe tuba twagala okusanyusa Mukama era okufuna empeera y’abo abamusanyusa, tewali kuweereza kumusanyusa nga ettendo lyaffe.

Ka tumusisinkanenga bulijjo n’omutima ogusanyufu era ogw’okwebaza, era ajja kukizzaayo mu bulamu obulungi obw’amaaso gaffe ne mu bulamu obulaajjana n’obulamu obweyongera, obutali kirala wabula okuddamu okw’omutima omusanyufu.

Ate era, okwebaza kwe kwetegekera okusinga obulungi eri okukkiriza. Obwesige bwekulira bwokka mu mutima ogutendereza. Okwebaza kutwala oluuyi olw’enjuba ku luguudo era kutunuulira oluuyi olwa Katonda olumasamasa, era mu ngeri eyo yokka mwe tuyinza okumwesiga. Obutakkiriza butunuulira ebizibu byaffe, era mazima ddala, birabika ng’ensozi, era okukkiriza kumalibwamu amaanyi olw’ekyo kye kirabika. Omuntu ow’omutima ogw’okwebaza bulijjo alizuula ensonga ey’okusanyuka, ate ow’ennaku alizuula ekire mu ggulu erisinga okumasamasa n’ensowera mu mafuta agasinga okuwoomerera. Ka tulundenga omwoyo ogw’essanyu, era tujja kuzuula ebingi mu Katonda ne mu bulamu bwaffe ebituzzaamu amaanyi ne tuleme kubeera na kifo kya kubuusabuusa wadde okutya.

Agusito 30

“Muba n’omukisa bwe mubikola” (Yokaana 13:17).

Tomanyi kuwummula okuva mu kwagala okuweddeyo, mu kulonda okwewaddeyo, mu nsi eyalekebwa, mu mutima omuteefu era omwetoowaze oguleka ensi n’eyita, era ogumanyi nti gulisikira ensi gwe gwagaanye! Tomanyi kuwoomerera okuleeta eri omukisa ogw’okulumwa enjala n’ennyonta ey’obutuukirivu, n’okujjuzibwa okumatira essanyu ery’ensi kwe lutasobola kuwa, n’olyoka olinnya mu mukisa ogusingako ogw’abasaasizi, ogw’abasonyiwa, ogw’emitima egyayiga nti “Okugaba kwa mukisa okusinga okuweebwa,” n’obulamu obuzuula nti “okuleka kwe kunyweza emirundi ebiri,” era okuwa abalala omukisa kwe kuweebwa omukisa emirundi ebiri!

Nedda, waliwo n’ejjinja ery’omuwendo erimu erimasamasa okusinga amalala gonna mu ngule eno ey’emikisa. Kwe kutonnya kw’ezziga okukwatiddwa ne kufuuka daayimanda, ettondo ly’omusaayi okufuusibwa ne lifuuka lubiini olw’engule ey’olubeerera ey’omu ggulu. Kwe ssanyu ery’okubonaabona ne Yesu, n’olyoka weerabira ennaku zonna mu ssanyu eryamba, okutuusa wamu ne Pascal ow’omu ggulu ne tutamanya kya kwogera kisooka, era ne twogera byombi wamu nti, “Amaziga ku maziga, essanyu ku ssanyu”.

Agusito 31

“Onkulembere mu kkubo erintuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo” (Zabbuli 139:24).

Emirundi mingi walabika ng’awali enjawulo ntono mu bulamu bubiri obw’enjawulo wakati w’okuwangula okutasalako n’okuwangula okw’ebbanga n’ebbanga. Naye enjawulo eyo entono eleeta ensi yonna ey’obuwanguzi oba obulemererwa. Obumu bwa Kikatonda, obulala bwa buntu; obumu lye kkubo ery’olubeerera, obulala lya kiseera buseera era terituukirira. Katonda ayagala okutukulembera mu kkubo ery’olubeerera, n’okutunyweza n’okutufuula abatasiguukululwa nga ye. Tetumanyi bunene bw’okwewaayo okusinga obutono. Lwe lutambulo olusooka mu lugendo olukka wansi, era Katonda yekka y’amanyi we lulikoma.

Ka tubeere “si ba kudda mabega mu kuzikirira, wabula abalina okukkiriza okunywevu okutuleetera okulokoka.”

Obuwanguzi bwo obwa leero butegeka bugya kkubo lya buwanguzi busingawo bwa nkya, ate okwewaayo kwo okwa leero kuggulawo luggi lwa kuwangulwa okusingako obubi mu nnaku ezijja. Kale, buli kye twetwalidde okuva eri Mukama waffe ow’omukisa, ka tukikwase okukuuma kwe, era tumutwale okutunyweza n’okutunywerezaako mu kusanyuka olw’essuubi erinywevu okutuusa ku nkomerero.
fields.body_text: Agusito 1 “Kubanga ffe ffenna kitugwanira okulabika mu maaso g’entebe ya Kristo ey’okusalirako omusango, buli muntu asalirwe olw’ebyo bye yakola ng’akyali mulamu, okusinziira ku ebyo bye yakola oba birungi oba bibi” (2 Abakkolinso 5:10). Si bulijjo luliba lunaku lwa kufuba na kubonaabona. Olunaku lumu, tuliwulira amannya gaffe nga galangirirwa mu maaso g’ensi yonna, n’ebyawandiikibwa ku bintu bye twali twerabidde edda nga bisomebwa. Emitima gyaffe nga giryedeekereza, n’emitwe gyaffe nga gikutama, bwe tuliwulira amannya gaffe nga gayitibwa, ne Mukama waffe n’alyoke ajjukize obuwanguzi n’obuweereza bwe twali twerabidde ffe fennyini! Ate, oboolyawo, okuva mu bibinja by’abaalokolebwa aliyita mu maaso emyoyo gye twafunira Kristo n’emyoyo nagyo gye baafuna, era bwe tuliraba ebivaamu eby’ebintu ebyalabika ng’ebitono ekiseera ekyo, tuligwa mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka, ne twogera nti, “Si ffe, Ayi Mukama, si ffe. Wabula erinnya lyo lye ligwana okuweebwanga ekitiibwa!” Abaagalwa, empapula ez’ebyafaayo by’obulamu bwaffe zeeyongera buli lunaku. Ffe fennyini tuteekateeka ennukuta, nga tuyita mu buli kikolwa kya buli kaseera. Emikono egitalabika giteekateeka ebipande, era mu bbanga ttono ebyawandiikibwa birirondoolwa, ne bisomebwa mu maaso g’abantu b’ensi yonna. era wakati mu bivaamu eby’emirembe n’emirembe. Agusito 2 “Weetoowazizza n’ongulumiza” (Zabbuli 18:35). Omubudaabudi ow’omukisa muwombeefu, wa kisa, era ajjudde obugumiikiriza n’okwagala. Nga Katonda bw’ayisa n’aboonoonyi n’obuwombeefu! Nga bw’agumiikiriza n’obulwewombeefu! Nga bw’akangavvula abaana be abeekyusa n’obuweke! Nga bwe yakulembera Yakobo, Yusufu, Isirayiri, Dawudi, Eriya, n’abaweereza be bonna ab’edda, okutuusa lwe baayinza okwogera mu mazima nti, “Weetoowazizza n’ongulumiza.” Omutima Omwoyo Omutukuvu mw’abeera bulijjo gulyawulibwa obuwombeefu, obwetoowaze, obusirifu, obukkakkamu, n’obugumiikiriza. Omwoyo omukambwe era ogusekerera, empisa ez’ekyejo, okuddamu n’obukambwe, okusala ebigambo eby’ettima—ebyo byonna bya mubiri, naye tebirina kye bigabana n’okuyigiriza okuwombeefu okw’Omubudaabudi. Ejjiba Ettukuvu lyewala omwoyo ogw’oluyoogaano, ogw’akasasamalo, ogusiikuuse, n’ogw’eggwanga, ne lifuna eky’okubeeramu mu kifuba eky’omwetoowaze eky’omwoyo ogw’emirembe. “Ebibala eby’Omwoyo bye bino: ekisa n’obuwombeefu.” Mukama, nfuula omuwombeefu. Sirisa omwoyo gwange. Longoosa empisa zange. Onsobozese okuba ne Kristo mu nneeyisa yange ne mu ddoboozi lyange, era ne mu mutima gwange. Agusito 3 “Noolwekyo mwewombeeke wansi w’omukono gwa Katonda ogw’amaanyi” (1 Peetero 5:6). Okunyigirizibwa okw’ebifo ebizibu kutuyigiriza okussa ekitiibwa mu bulamu. Buli lwe tuddizibwa obulamu bwaffe okuva mu kugezesebwa ng’okwo, kiba ng’entandikwa empya, era tuyiga obulungi omuwendo bwe buli, ne tubukozesa ekisingako olwa Katonda n’olw’omuntu. Okunyigirizibwa kutuyamba okutegeera okugezesebwa kw’abalala, era kutufuula abatuufu okuyamba abalala n’okuwulira nabo obulumi bwabwe. Waliwo obuntu obutali bwa buziba, obw’oku ngulu obwokka, obukwata endowooza oba ekisuubizo mu bwangu, ne bwogera n’obwewaawaze ku butakkiriza bw’abo abeewala buli kugezesebwa; naye omusajja oba omukazi eyabonaabona ennyo talikola bw’atyo, wabula muwombeefu nnyo era wa kisa, era amanyi obubonaabona bye butegeeza mu mazima. Kino Pawulo kye yategeeza bwe yagamba nti, “Okufa kukolera mu ffe, naye obulamu bukolera mu mmwe.” Okugezesebwa n’ebifo ebizibu byetaagisa okutusindika mu maaso; nga bwe kityo omuliro ogw’ekyoto oguli munda mu kyombo ekyo eky’amaanyi gwe guwa amaanyi agakyusa piston, ne gutambuza yingini, ne gusindika ekyombo ekyo ekinene okuwunguka ennyanja, mu maaso g’empewo n’amayengo. Agusito 4 “Naye mmwe temufugibwa mubiri wabula mufugibwa Mwoyo, kubanga Omwoyo wa Katonda abeera mu mmwe. Era omuntu yenna bw’ataba na Mwoyo wa Kristo, oyo si wa Kristo” (Abaruumi 8:9). Omuntu ow’omwoyo si nnyo muntu alina empisa ey’omwoyo ey’amaanyi, wabula muntu ajjudde Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Bw’atyo omutume yagamba nti, “Naye mmwe temufugibwa mubiri wabula mufugibwa Mwoyo, kubanga Omwoyo wa Katonda abeera mu mmwe.” Ekitiibwa eky’ekitonde ekiggya, kale, si kwokka nti kizza buggya omwoyo gw’omuntu, wabula nti kigufuula ekifo Katonda yennyini mw’abeera, era kigufuula okwesigama ku njuba, ng’omwana bw’eyesigama ku maama we. Noolwekyo, obw’omwoyo obusinga obwa waggulu, kwe kuba nga toyinza kukola kintu na kimu, okwesigama okutuukiridde n’okubeeramu Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutuukiridde. Noolwekyo, ekikolwa kya Kristo ekirungi eky’okufuuwa ku bayigirizwa be, n’abawa okuva ku mimwa gye Omwoyo gwennyini ogwali gumaze okubeera mu ye, kyayoleka mu ngeri esookuuka ekitiibwa eky’engule eky’ekitonde ekiggya. Era Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’atyo bw’atwetwala, ajjuza buli kitundu ky’obulamu bwaffe. Agusito 5 “Buli awulira eddoboozi lyange n’aggulawo, nnaayingira omumwe ne tuliira wamu ffembi” (Okubikkulirwa 3:20). Abamu ku ffe tuli mu njala, nga twebuuza lwaki Omwoyo Omutukuvu tatujjuza. Tulina bingi ebituyingiramu, naye tetubigaba. Gaba omukisa gw’olina, tandika enteekateeka ennene ez’okuweereza n’okuwa omukisa, era mangu ojja kulaba nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu akukulembedde, era “alikukwaniriza n’emikisa egijjudde ebirungi,” n’akuwa byonna by’ayinza okukwesiga okugabira abalala. Waliwo ekintu ekirungi mu butonde ekiriko ne bye kifaananako mu by’omwoyo. Tewali nnyimba ya ggulu nga ennanga ya Aeolian, ate ennanga ya Aeolian tekyali kintu wabula nsinga z’ennyimba ezitegekeddwa mu maloboozi agakwatagana, ne zirekebwa okukwatibwako engalo ezitalabika ez’empewo eziyita. Ne nga omukka gw’eggulu bwe guyita ku nsinga, kigambibwa nti amaloboozi agaali ng’aga Katonda gawulikika mu bbanga, ng’ekibiina kya bamalayika nga bali okwetooloola nga bakwata ku nsinga. Bwe kityo kisoboka okukuuma emitima gyaffe nga miggule eri okukwatako kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ne kisoboka okugivugako nga bw’ayagala, nga ffe tulindirira mu kasirise mu kkubo ery’okuweereza kwe. Agusito 6 “Abo bonna abakulemberwa Omwoyo wa Katonda be baana ba Katonda” (Abaruumi 8:14). Omwoyo Omutukuvu ow’omukisa ye Muluŋŋamya waffe, Mukulembeze waffe, era ye Kifo kyaffe eky’okuwummuliramu. Waliwo ebiseera lw’atusindika mu maaso mu kusaba, mu kuweereza, mu kubonaabona, mu bintu ebiggya, mu mirimu emiggya, mu kwetwalira okuggya okw’okukkiriza, n’essuubi, n’okwagala, naye waliwo ebiseera lw’atuyimiriza mu mirimu gyaffe, n’atuwummuza wansi w’ekiwaawaatiro kye ekitusiikiriza, n’atusirisa mu kifo eky’ekyama eky’Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo, ng’atuyigiriza amasomo agamu amaggya, ng’atufuuwamu amaanyi oba okujjula okw’omunda ennyo, n’oluvannyuma n’atukulembera nate, ku kiragiro kye kyokka. Ye Muluŋŋamya ow’amazima ow’omutukuvu, era Mukulembeze ow’amazima ow’Ekkanisa, Omuwi waffe w’amagezi ow’ekitalo, Mukwano gwaffe atakyama; ate oyo ayagala okwegaana okuluŋŋamya kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu ku bubwe olwo asobole okussa ekitiibwa mu Kigambo kya Katonda ng’omuluŋŋamya waffe yekka, ateekwa okumenya ekigambo ekirala eky’ekisuubizo, nti endiga ze zirimanya eddoboozi lye, era nti abaana be abawulize era abagondera baliwulira eddoboozi emabega waabwe nga ligamba nti, “Lino ly’ekkubo, litambuliremu.” Agusito 7 “Tumanyi kino nti omuntu waffe ow’edda yakomererwa” (Abaruumi 6:6). Kya kukkiriza kyokka, ate okukkiriza n’okulaba bulijjo tebifaanana, ne kiba nti eri amagezi go tekirabika nga bwe kiri, naye okukkiriza kwo kuteekwa okukibala nga bwe kityo. Eno nneeyisa nzibu nnyo okunywerera, era olwokubanga tukkiririza Katonda ddala, kwe tuyinza okubalira bwe tutyo ku Kigambo kye ne ku mirimu gye, naye bwe tukola bwe tutyo, okukkiriza kulikifuula amazima, era kiribeera bwe kityo. Ebigambo bino ebibiri, “okwewaayo” ne “okubala,” bye bigambo eby’ekyama ebituyingiza mu bulamu obw’okuzuukira. Biri ng’obwogi obubiri obw’“Ekitala ky’Omwoyo” mwe tuyita okuyingira mu kukomererwa wamu ne Kristo. Ekikolwa kino eky’okwewaayo n’okubala kuno okw’okukkiriza bikkirizibwa mu Ndagaano Empya ng’ebiraga akaseera akalungamu ennyo mu bulamu obw’omwoyo. Tekitegeeza nti tusuubirwa okuyita mu kufa okutasala, wabula nti wateekwa okubaawo ekikolwa kimu eky’okufa ekikakafu, n’oluvannyuma omuze ogutasala ogw’okwebala nga tufudde, ne tusisinkana buli kintu nga tuyima ku ntobo eno. “Mwerowoozenga okuba abaafiira ddala eri ekibi, naye abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu.” Agusito 8 “Mubeere ng’ejjiba” (Yeremiya 48:28). Okuba omuteefu ng’ejjiba, y’engeri Kristo gy’ategeeza akabonero kano akalungi. Bw’atyo Omwoyo wa Katonda bwe buli obulongoofu bwennyini. Tayinza kubeera mu mutima omujama. Tayinza kubeera mu magezi ag’obuzaaliranwa. Ku mafuta ag’edda kyayogerwa nti, “Tegajjanga kufukibwa ku bantu ba bulijjo.” Obulongoofu Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’aleeta buli ng’akati akato akatukula era akataliiko bbala akamera okuva mu ntuumu y’obusa, oba mu ttaka eddugavu, awatali kamersegere na kamu ka bucaafu akakwatidde ku ngulu yaakyo eyakaayakana, nga tekaliiko bbala ng’ekiwaawaatiro kya malayika. Bw’atyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu awa obulongoofu bw’omutima obwerinda bwennyini, kubanga mu butonde bwabwo tebufaanana n’ebintu ebibi ebibumeramu okwetooloola. Buyinza okuba nga bwetooloddwa ebibi ku njuyi zonna, naye tebuyonoonebwa era buba bulongoofu kubanga obutonde bwabwo mu ntobo bwe butukuvu era bwa Katonda. Ng’ebyoya by’ejjiba, tebuyinza kwonoonebwa, wabula buva mu kidiba eky’ettosi nga tebuliiko bbala era nga tebwonooneddwa mazzi ga kizikiza, kubanga bukuumibwa ekibikka eky’amafuta ekigoba buli bucaafu ne kifuula obutakwatibwako bbala lyonna. Agusito 9 “Anaateekanga emikono gye gyombi ku mutwe gw’embuzi eyo ennamu n’agikwatako, n’agyenenyerezaako ebyonoono by’abaana ba Isirayiri, n’obujeemu bwabwe, n’ebibi byabwe byonna” (Ebyabaleevi 16:21). Buli ekibi bwe kivaayo, ate okutegeera kw’ekintu kyonna ekitali kitukuvu ne kukoona ku magezi gaffe ag’omunda, kye kisa kyaffe okukukwasa amangwago Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’okukiteeka ku Yesu, ng’ekintu ekimaze okukomererwa wamu naye, era nga bwe kyali edda, mu nsonga ey’ekiweebwayo olw’ekibi, kirisindikibwa ebweru w’olusiisira ne kyokebwa ne kifuuka evvu. Wayinza okubaawo okubonaabona okw’amaanyi, wayinza okubaawo obulumi obuwanvu, buyinza okuba obw’amazima ennyo; naye mu byonna waliba okuwulira okuwoomerera era okutukuvu okw’okubeerawo kwa Katonda, n’obulongoofu obw’amaanyi mu mwoyo gwaffe gwonna, n’okwawukana kwaffe okuva ku kibi ekyokebwa. Mazima ddala, kirituusibwa ebweru w’olusiisira, era n’akawunyiro k’ennimi z’omuliro tekaliba ku ngoye zaffe. Kya mukisa nnyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutta ebintu. Tewali bitala okuggyako ebibye ebiyinza okuyita bulungi bwe bityo wakati waffe n’ekibi, ne kizikiriza ekibi awatali kukwata ku mwoyo. Mukama Yesu, Ekiweebwayo kyange olw’ekibi, nteeka ekibi kyange, nze kennyini, obuntu bwange bwonna, ku Musaalaba gwo. Nzikiriza n’omuliro gwo omutukuvu, era ondeke nfiire buli kimu okuggyako Ggwe! Agusito 10 “Toliiko bbala na limu” (Oluyimba 4:7).
